title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project at The National Institute of Public Health at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU)
description:
The National Institute of Public Health at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applicants for a 3-year PhD scholarship for a highly motivated candidate interested in working within the field of environmental epidemiology and public health. The project aims to investigate new and previously suspected toxicants to risk of Parkinsons Disease.

The PhD project is part of a larger collaborative research initiative “Connecting the environmental exposome to PD risk and disease pathology” funded by Michael J Fox Foundation. Through this grant, a 3-year PhD position has been funded. The larger project includes four work packages (WPs), where the PhD project is part of the WP with the title “Toxicant-wide association studies for PD”, which also includes funding for two part time researchers.


Research environment

The PhD project will be anchored at the National Institute of Public Health within the research group in Geographical and Register-based Epidemiology in Copenhagen. Professor Annette Kjær Ersbøll will be the principal supervisor, researcher Stine Kloster and researcher Kirstine Wodschow will be co-supervisors. The project will be conducted in close collaboration with the research team in the larger project. Together, the larger team provides an interdisciplinary research environment with close integration of public health, in vivo and in vitro experimental research, neurology, register-based research and environmental epidemiology. The teams are internationally oriented and offer a supportive and inclusive research culture.

You can read more about the research initiative here:  https://www.michaeljfox.org/grant/connecting-environmental-exposome-pd-risk-and-disease-pathology. 

 

Project description

The PhD project will focus on associations between toxicants and risk for Parkinsons Disease. The association between toxicant exposure at residential location and incidence of Parkinsons Disease will be investigated for the entire Danish adult population through access to Danish national registers. Toxicants will include pesticides in drinking water, airborne pesticides exposure from fields and larger chemical pollutions.

Together with the researchers in WP4 the PhD student will:

  • Establish the study population of the entire Danish adults 

  • Derive toxicant exposure at an individual level

  • Analyze associations between toxicant exposure and risk of Parkinsons Disease

  • Prepare and publish research findings in international peer-reviewed journals.

 

Qualifications

The applicant should possess the following qualifications:

  • The ideal candidate will have demonstrated an interest in research within epidemiology, environmental medicine, or data science

  • A master’s degree (MSc or equivalent) in public health, epidemiology, data science or related fields

  • Experience with programming using statistical software (such as SAS, Stata or R) is considered a strength but not a requirement

  • Preferably prior experience with register-based and/or environmental epidemiology

  • An interest in working with quantitative analyses and large datasets

  • Excellent communications skills in English, both written and spoken

  • A motivated, independent, and quality-oriented approach to research, with enthusiasm for learning new scientific disciplines and methodologies.

 

For further information about the project, please contact:
Professor Annette Kjær Ersbøll

The National Institute of Public Health 

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

Phone: +45 65507775   E-mail: ake@sdu.dk


Applications must include:

• At letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process.

Further information about the PhD-study can be found at the homepage of the University.


Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated. This also applies to reference letters.

 

Closing date October 9th, 2026


Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order).

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.


Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Assistant Professor in Operations and Supply Chain Digitalisation
description:
The Center for Supply Chain Digitalisation (CSD), at the Department of Technology and Innovation, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for an Assistant Professor in Operations and Supply Chain Digitalization with special focus on simulation and/or artificial intelligence applied to operations and supply chains.

The targeted start date is February 2027.

The successful candidate will be responsible for collaboratively building up the area of operations and supply chain digitalisation with a primary focus on quantitative methods such as discrete-event and agent-based simulation, process automation, data science, and machine learning.

Successful candidates will drive internationally recognized and competitive research, work closely with industry, and are expected to attract external research funding. The position has a strong focus on experimental and applied research in production systems and supply chain fields. The candidate will play a key role in providing outstanding education, supervising bachelor's and master’s students, and developing junior research staff.

SDU CSD is a highly international group of faculty members, embedded in a region with a strong network of companies, including some of Denmark's largest global industrial players (i.e. Danfoss, Linak, Siemens) and many manufacturing SMEs. Projects currently run by the group cover a range of topics within the field of operations and supply chain digitalization.

The successful candidate must have a background in engineering. PhD degree preferably in industrial engineering, supply chain, operations management, operations research, or the like.

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

 

We expect

A highly motivated, collaborative person, who can work in an international, interdisciplinary team, with documented research skills in the field of operations and supply chain. The candidate needs to be a team player and, at the same time, be able to work independently. The successful candidate is active in publishing in engineering journals.

The ideal candidate can connect research with practical technology application and has demonstrated skills and competencies in one or more of the following areas:

  • Discrete-event and/or agent-based simulation

  • Artificial intelligence, machine/deep learning applied to operations and supply chain (AI-applications in other fields are not relevant for this position) 

  • Agentic AI applied to operations and supply chain

  • Business and intelligent process automation

Further information is available from Associate Professor Elias Ribeiro da Silva elias@iti.sdu.dk.

 

We offer

  • A professional workplace culture that values equality, mutual respect, and is designed to accommodate and encourage work-life balance

  • A vibrant social environment with structured activities and informal routines that promote cross-disciplinary interaction and cultivate an inclusive, supportive atmosphere.

  • An engaging, dynamic, and international interdisciplinary environment with extensive collaboration opportunities across national, international, and industrial partners

  • Opportunities for continued professional development and education for all staff members.

  • Access to a well-developed research infrastructure

  • A strong institutional commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in all aspects of the workplace

 

About the workplace

The position is within the SDU Center for Supply Chain Digitalisation (CSD) at the Faculty of Engineering on the international campus Sønderborg. The center conducts research at the intersection of supply chain management, data science, and digital technologies. Our work applies quantitative, data-driven methods to analyse, design, and optimise complex supply chains.

In close collaboration with industry partners, the center focuses on the full data journey across the supply chain, developing tools and methods based on advanced analytics, simulation, and artificial intelligence to enable stronger coordination, end-to-end transparency, and more sustainable and efficient supply chain operations.

SDU CSD is situated in a region with a robust network of companies, including some of Denmark’s largest global industrial players as well as numerous SMEs. The group’s current projects mainly focus on building quantitative models and methods to support better decisions or on turning data-driven optimisation, simulation, and digital tools into practical use in operations. 

The SDU CSD is a highly international and interdisciplinary group of faculty members, with international students. The campus is in Sønderborg, an attractive coastal town with an open Scandinavian culture, and affordable housing and living costs.

 

Special benefits when working in Denmark

  • The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week

  • 30 days of paid holiday per year

  • The yearly salary for a full-time assistant professor is between DKK 502.905 and DKK 566.647 depending on the years of working experience. Postdoc experience may place you on a higher salary step. The salary includes a base salary, a position-related supplement and pension (18.07 %). Additional supplement(s) for special qualifications can be negotiated. Authorisation supplement(s) will be granted, if relevant for the position. Your local eligible trade union representative at SDU negotiates your salary on your behalf.

  • Subsidized preschool childcare and a free education system from primary school up to university level

  • Universal health insurance as a resident of Denmark, including family members officially residing in Denmark

  • In relation to childbirth, employees are entitled to a combined total of 52 weeks of parental leave, shared between parents, with full or partial salary depending on circumstances.

  • Researchers recruited from abroad are offered a special researcher tax scheme with a lower tax rate. 

  • Travel and moving expenses may be partially covered.

 

Living in Denmark

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. Among other things, the staff answers questions concerning salary, taxation, housing and accompanying family.

We recommend that international applicants also take the time to visit Work in Denmark.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

 

Application and assessment

Applications will be assessed by an expert committee. When the expert committee issues its assessment, applicants will receive the portion of the assessment pertaining to them personally.

The committee assesses candidates only based on the application materials. Please include the following documents in English: 

  • Brief motivation letter

  • Curriculum vitae

  • Full list of publications

  • Copies of the three publications on which the applicant wishes to be evaluated. Please attach one pdf-file for each publication

  • Diplomas/Certificates (Master and PhD degree)

  • Summary and documentation of teaching experience. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio.

  • Documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  An interview may be included as part of the overall evaluation of the applicant’s qualifications. If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support. Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply and specific faculty information for application at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period. The preferred start date is from February 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

title: Cleaning Supervisor
description:
Cleaning Supervisor – Full-Time Position in Copenhagen

We are looking for a responsible, well-organised and motivated Cleaning Supervisor to join our team in Copenhagen.

This is a hands-on position combining team supervision, customer communication, quality control and daily cleaning operations. We are looking for someone who enjoys working with people, takes responsibility and can effectively organise both their own work and the work of others.

Your responsibilities

  • Preparing and managing staff schedules and organising shift coverage

  • Maintaining regular contact with employees and coordinating their daily work

  • Communicating with clients and responding to their requests and needs

  • Training, onboarding and supporting new employees

  • Organising training and providing ongoing guidance to the cleaning team

  • Performing regular quality checks and ensuring that our cleaning standards are maintained

  • Ordering cleaning products, equipment and other necessary supplies

  • Cleaning at client locations when required

  • Handling day-to-day operational issues and finding practical solutions

  • Supporting and motivating employees in their daily work

  • Ensuring good communication between employees, management and clients

  • Supporting the company in acquiring and onboarding new clients

We are looking for someone who:

  • Speaks English confidently

  • Is willing and motivated to learn Danish

  • Has strong organisational and communication skills

  • Is comfortable communicating with both employees and clients

  • Is responsible, reliable and able to work independently

  • Can make decisions and solve problems in a busy working environment

  • Is flexible regarding working hours and willing to work in shifts

  • Is available to work every second weekend

  • Is willing to take part in cleaning duties when necessary

  • Living in Denmark is an advantage, but not a requirement. However, you must be willing and able to relocate to Copenhagen for the position

  • Has, or is able to obtain, the legal right to work in Denmark

  • Previous experience in cleaning, supervision, team coordination or a similar position is an advantage

What we offer

We offer a responsible and varied position in a stable and established cleaning company in Copenhagen, where you will play an important role in our daily operations and future development.

Salary: DKK 37,500 gross per month
Working hours: 38 hours per week
Schedule: Shift work, including every second weekend
Location: Copenhagen, Denmark
Employment: Full-time

The work will primarily take place at different client locations across Copenhagen, so flexibility and the ability to organise your working day are important.

We are looking for someone who is not afraid to take responsibility, enjoys working with people and is committed to maintaining high standards of cleaning and customer service.

How to apply

If you are interested in joining our team, please send your CV together with a motivation letter or a short video introducing yourself to:

info@teamclean.dk

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Enterprise Architect (m/w/d) (Software-Architect)
description:
DLG befindet sich auf einer ambitionierten digitalen Transformationsreise und entwickelt sich von einer fragmentierten, historisch gewachsenen IT-Landschaft hin zu einer modernen Architektur, die konsequent an geschäftlichen Fähigkeiten und Unternehmenszielen ausgerichtet ist. Als Enterprise Architect (m/w/d) spielst du eine zentrale Rolle dabei, die zukünftige Enterprise Architecture von DLG zu definieren und starke, unternehmensweite Architekturpraktiken zu etablieren.

Über das Unternehmen

Die DLG-Gruppe zählt zu den führenden Genossenschaften Europas in den Bereichen Lebensmittel, Energie und Baustoffe. Unser Auftrag ist es, langfristigen Mehrwert für unsere landwirtschaftlichen Eigentümer und für die Gesellschaft zu schaffen – durch verlässliche Produkte, innovative Lösungen und nachhaltiges Wachstum in all unseren Geschäftsbereichen. Mit rund 7.000 Mitarbeitenden in 18 Ländern und auf Basis unserer genossenschaftlichen Struktur gestalten wir unsere Zukunft durch gemeinsame Werte, nachhaltige Ziele und den festen Glauben an die Kraft der Zusammenarbeit.

Die team SE mit Sitz in Flensburg ist ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der DLG-Gruppe. Unsere zentralen Unternehmensfunktionen sind standortübergreifend zwischen Flensburg und dem DLG-Hauptsitz in Fredericia organisiert. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir die Geschäftsbereiche über Ländergrenzen hinweg und tragen zu einer effizienten, integrierten und zukunftsfähigen Organisation bei, die Skaleneffekte und Synergien optimal nutzt.

Aufgaben

Du übernimmst die Hauptverantwortung für unser Enterprise‑Architecture‑Repository und fungierst als zentrale Ansprechperson, die Transparenz über die aktuelle sowie die zukünftige Applikationslandschaft sicherstellt. In dieser Rolle agierst du als vertrauenswürdige Beratungsperson für Group IT und die Fachbereiche und treibst die architektonische Governance, Prioritäten und strategische Ausrichtung voran.

Du leitest Initiativen zur Vereinfachung, Modernisierung und Verbesserung der Interoperabilität in unseren Geschäftsbereichen Landwirtschaft, Tierernährung, Energie und Wohnen – mit einem starken Fokus auf die nahtlose Integration zwischen Anwendungen und unserer unternehmensweiten Datenplattform**.**

In dieser Rolle wirst du:

- DLGs Zielarchitektur und Architekturprinzipien definieren und weiterentwickeln – und sicherstellen, dass sie konsequent mit der Geschäftsstrategie abgestimmt sind.
- Die Modernisierungsreise von Legacy‑Systemen hin zu einer composable Architecture vorantreiben, die auf einer starken Integrationsplattform basiert.
- Eine enge Integration zwischen Anwendungen und Plattformen sicherstellen – einschließlich der unternehmensweiten Datenplattform.
- Architekturprinzipien, Standards und Roadmaps definieren und steuern, abgestimmt auf die strategischen Prioritäten der DLG.
- Datengetriebene Architekturinitiativen unterstützen.
- Architektur-Governance und domänenübergreifende Abstimmung zwischen Group IT und den Geschäftsbereichen fördern.
- ERP‑, Daten‑, Integrations‑, Plattform‑ und KI‑Teams in Richtung der Zielarchitektur begleiten.

Profil

- Umfassende Erfahrung in Enterprise‑, Lösungs‑ oder Domänenarchitektur in großen oder komplexen Organisationen
- Fundierte Kenntnisse in Architektur-Frameworks wie TOGAF oder SABSA – und die Fähigkeit, sie pragmatisch zur Erzielung geschäftlicher Ergebnisse einzusetzen
- Tiefes Verständnis von Enterprise Architecture, Integrationsmustern, modernen Plattformen und komplexen IT‑Landschaften
- Erfahrung mit ERP‑Systemen (idealerweise SAP), CRM sowie API‑/Event‑getriebenen Integrationen
- Praktische Erfahrung mit Enterprise‑Architecture‑Management‑Lösungen, idealerweise LeanIX
- Analytische, strukturierte und pragmatische Denkweise, mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Konzepte zu vereinfachen
- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch (Dänisch und/oder Deutsch sind ein Plus)

Unser Angebot

Bei DLG übernimmst du eine strategische Rolle mit erheblichem Einfluss auf die zukünftige Digital‑ & IT‑Landschaft. Du erhältst ein klares Mandat, technologische Entscheidungen, Investitionsprioritäten und die übergeordnete architektonische Ausrichtung im gesamten Unternehmen mitzugestalten.

Du arbeitest eng mit dem CIO, der Group‑IT‑Führung sowie einer Vielzahl von Business‑Stakeholdern zusammen – in einer Organisation, in der Architektur auf Executive‑Level priorisiert und unterstützt wird.

Dich erwartet ein dynamisches, internationales Arbeitsumfeld mit kompetenten Kolleg*innen aus Architektur, Entwicklung und den Geschäftsbereichen. Zudem profitierst du von einem flexiblen Arbeitsort, mit der Möglichkeit, in unserem Büro in Fredericia oder Flensburg sowie anteilig mobil zu arbeiten.

Weitere Informationen

Kok på Center Parcs Nordborg Resort

fastansættelse eller sæsonjob

Siden juni 2025 har vi været en del af Center Parcs Nordborg Resort med mange forskellige gastronomiske koncepter, og vi søger dig som kok! Vi søger et fast medlem til vores team – ikke kun for en sæson.

Leder du efter et job, hvor du kan være med til at forme en positiv virksomhedskultur, spille en afgørende rolle for gæsternes oplevelse og være en del af et spændende eventyr fra starten? Så bliv en del af vores team!

- Attraktiv løn : En løn, der matcher dine kvalifikationer og din erfaring

Som kok er du en del af vores køkkenhold og sørger for, at vores gæster hver dag får et gastronomisk tilbud af høj kvalitet og med stor variation.

Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet:

- Tilberedning af retter til f.eks. morgenbuffet
- Kreativ tilberedning med både friske råvarer og convenience-produkter
- Planlægning og organisering af indkøb og opbevaring
- Tilberedning af à la carte-menuer

- En afsluttet uddannelse som kok eller tilsvarende erhvervserfaring inden for gastronomi
- Erhvervserfaring, f.eks. fra restaurant, hotel, kantine eller storkøkken, er en fordel

- Et køligt hoved – også i stressede situationer
- Teamånd, pålidelighed og en struktureret arbejdsmåde
- Kreativitet og interesse for forskellige køkkenretninger
- Fleksibilitet og villighed til også at arbejde i weekender og på helligdage
- Gode danskkundskaber; engelsk- eller tyskfærdigheder er en fordel

Mere end 24.000 mennesker i 11 lande er allerede en del af Areas-familien. Vi brænder for det, vi laver, elsker rollen som værter og byder vores gæster velkommen med lækker og indbydende mad

title: Forandringsstærk teamleder, der lykkes i fællesskab
description:
Vil du være med til at forme og understøtte Efter- og Videreuddannelsesområdet på Absalon? Vi søger en udviklingsorienteret teamleder, der kan omsætte ambitioner til resultater og skabe følgeskab i forandringer. Du skal kunne navigere mellem forskellige interesser og faglige perspektiver, være nysgerrig og lyttende – og samtidig have gennemslagskraft til at holde fast i retningen, når det er nødvendigt.

Du bliver en del af et tæt ledelsesmakkerskab, hvor du sammen med en erfaren teamlederkollega skal stå i spidsen for et nyt samlet team og skabe endnu stærkere sammenhæng mellem forretningsudvikling, administration og den samlede udvikling af vores efter- og videreuddannelsesområde.

Din profil
Vi søger dig, der kombinerer stærke ledelseskompetencer og en udviklingsorienteret tilgang. Området er komplekst, og derfor er der brug for god, sammenhængende ledelseskraft ind i området. Du skal sammen med en teamlederkollega lede EVU-teamet som et stærkt ledelsesmakkerskab, hvilket sætter store krav til samarbejde, stærke relationer og kommunikation. Sammen skal I skabe sammenhæng mellem de store ambitioner for området og hverdagens udfordringer. For at lykkes i dette er det væsentligt, at du kan genkende dig selv i følgende:

Dine relationelle kompetencer er helt i top. Til hverdag vil du få en bred samarbejdsflade med medarbejdere og ledere på tværs af Absalon. Din evne til at etablere relationer og samarbejde med mange forskellige kolleger er afgørende. Du har et stærkt strategisk perspektiv og med din gode gennemslagskraft, evner du at udvikle driften ud fra den strategiske linje.

Du har erfaring med styring af processer i en kompleks organisation. Det ligger dig naturligt at inddrage og samarbejde med relevante samarbejdspartnere i organisationen. Du er processtærk og har erfaring med at gennemføre udviklings- og forandringsprocesser i en kompleks organisation. Du har et helhedsblik og evner at procesplanlægge, optimere arbejdsgange, dataunderstøtte og udarbejde objektivt begrundede beslutningsoplæg. Du er optaget af både udvikling og implementering i hverdagspraksis.

Du har ledelseserfaring. Din ledelsesstil er inddragende, nysgerrig og dialogorienteret, og du formår at motivere samarbejdspartnere og medarbejdere mod fælles mål. Du har erfaring med at lede udviklingsprocesser, styre projekter og involvere de rette interessenter. Du spiller din lederkollega god, bringer egne perspektiver tydeligt i spil og kan stå på fælles beslutninger. Som personaleleder er du optaget af at styrke trivslen hos den enkelte medarbejder og teamet som helhed.

Derudover forventer vi os, at du:
  • har kendskab til eller interesse for uddannelsessektoren
  • kommunikerer enkelt og præcist på skrift
  • har en relevant uddannelse.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Du skal forvente, at du vil have opgaver, der knytter sig til følgende ledelsesroller: strategisk ledelse, drifts – og faglig ledelse, personaleledelse og - udvikling samt udvikling af dig selv og din måde at lede på. Konkrete arbejdsopgaver der skal løses, vil bl.a. være:

Udvikling af EVU-området. Vi har høje ambitioner for Absalons efter- og videreuddannelse og vi står over for en spændende udvikling, hvor både samarbejdsformer, processer og opgaveløsning skal udvikles. Sammen med din lederkollega skal du være med til at professionalisere understøttelsen af det samlede EVU-område og skabe sammenhæng mellem forretningsudvikling, administration og organisationens strategiske ambitioner. Det indebærer bl.a. udvikling af tydelig governance, stærkere beslutningsgrundlag baseret på data og sikker implementering af nye løsninger.

Kvalitetssikring af leverancer. I den daglige drift er det vigtigt, at du mestrer at driftslede, prioritere opgaveløftet og sikre den løbende dialog med uddannelsernes konsulenter og ledere, samt følger konstruktivt og systematisk op på tilbagemeldinger m.v.

Personaleledelse. Som personaleleder er du tillidsfuld og sikre rammerne for god trivsel i teamet. Derudover har du fokus på at skabe højt engagement, hvor opgavernes og samarbejdets formål er klart defineret. Du skal skabe overblik og tydelige rammer for medarbejdernes arbejde samt for opgavefordelingen.

Dine kolleger
Du bliver en del af Uddannelsesservices EVU-team, hvor vi dataunderstøtter, udvikler og administrerer efter- og videreuddannelse. Teamet består af mange forskellige fagligheder, og vi er tilsammen 20 medarbejdere. Din lederkollega og du vil begge have personaleledelse for hver jeres medarbejdergruppe, og tilsammen vil I have fælles ansvar for teamets opgaveløft og det strategiske ledelsesansvar.

Uddannelsesservice har 5 teams. Vi håndterer også al optagelse, administration og vejledning af studerende på vores professionsbachelor- og ingeniøruddannelser. Tilsammen er vi 94 kolleger i Uddannelsesservice, som er en velfungerende og uhøjtidelig afdeling, hvor vi løfter i flok. Vores kontorer ligger side om side med undervisningslokaler, og vi arbejder tæt på de studerende og tæt med hinanden. Vi vægter kollegial trivsel højt og har brug for, at du også er en holdspiller. Vi har en uformel omgangstone og har mange bolde i luften, som vi gør os stor umage med at gribe.

Vi holder til på vores Campus i Slagelse, som er nemt at komme til, da det er placeret lige ved stationen. Absalon har en dejlig frokostordning, adgang til motionscenter og en aktiv personaleforening.

Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid med ansættelse hurtigst muligt
  • Du kan forvente et lønniveau på 700.000 kr. - 800.000 kr. årligt inkl. pension.
  • Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte Chef for Uddannelsesservice Randi Mølager på telefon 7248 1280.
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her eller ved at klikke på ”Søg stillingen” til højre på denne side senest den 1. oktober 2026.
  • Vi forventer at afholde 1. ansættelsessamtale den 5.oktober og 2. samtale den 8. oktober 2026.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner – og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

title: Assistant Professor in High Frequency Switch-Mode Power Supplies
description:
The Digital and High-Frequency Electronics (DHFE) section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, based at the university campus in Odense, seeks outstanding individuals for full-time Assistant Professor positions in Power Electronics, focusing on power management for electronic and computing devices and systems. Successful applicants are expected to contribute to the development of academic programs and the research community. Applicants should have a PhD in Power Electronics or a closely related field. 

The DHFE section focuses on conducting research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communication, utilizing cutting-edge reconfigurable computing and sensors. The aim is to develop next-generation electronics and computing solutions that solve technology-related challenges in fields such as autonomous robots, drones, IoT, smart grid, and healthcare.

Applicants are expected to establish and maintain a research program in high-frequency power electronics and power management for computation, along with low-voltage electronic systems. The position emphasizes converter and power-management for computing platforms and resource-constrained applications, including battery-operated, energy-harvesting, mobile, autonomous, embedded, and sensor-based systems.

The section is a vital component of our Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Science, and Master of Science programs in Electrical and Electronics Engineering in Odense. Currently, the section focuses on three research fields: 1) Drones for Infrastructure Inspections and Interactions, 2) High-Frequency SMPS and power management for low-power electronic systems, and 3) Telecommunication Systems. The section has 15 academics, including professors, postdoctoral fellows, PhD students, and engineers, to support research, industrial collaboration, and educational activities, and is growing steadily.

The SDU campus in Odense contains six faculties and soon a large university hospital, creating a great concentration of academics and students facilitating interdisciplinary research and rich student life. The city of Odense is culturally rich, surrounded by a vibrant and growing robotics community, and highly livable with a green-banked meandering river cutting through the centre and attractive residential areas.

 

Job Description

The position focuses on power management for resource-constrained autonomous, mobile, and embedded electronic systems. Relevant research areas include high-frequency power conversion, battery-operated systems, energy harvesting, power management architectures, embedded control, and analog/digital control of converters. The application domain spans from ultra-low-power electronics and sensors to mobile platforms, robotics, drones, IoT devices, and power management for embedded, compact, and high-performance computing systems.

The role strengthens DHFE’s research profile at the interface between power electronics, microelectronics, embedded systems, and intelligent electronic devices. It is expected to support shared research themes across SDU, including energy-efficient electronics, autonomous systems, battery-powered platforms, sensor networks, health technology, and miniaturized or distributed devices.

The successful candidate should work constructively both with colleagues within DHFE and also with colleagues from other research units, such as SDU Microelectronics, SDU Centre for Industrial Electronics, the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, Faculty of Health (specifically Health Tech), Mechanical Engineering, and other relevant environments, translating power electronics competence into system-level contributions for electronic devices and platforms.

 

Duties

As a faculty member, you will be responsible for developing and delivering undergraduate and graduate teaching in Electronic and Electrical Engineering, with particular attention to strengthening control and power electronics within the BSc portfolio. This includes supervising students at Bachelor and Master’s level, mentoring students, integrating with the student body, and participating in education and outreach activities. Research duties include establishing an externally funded research agenda, publishing in leading journals and conferences, supervising early-career researchers, and contributing to the development of DHFE’s research environment. The candidate is also expected to contribute to external collaboration and perform service at the section, department, university, and professional levels.

 

Qualifications Required

  • The applicant should hold a doctoral degree (PhD) in Power Electronics, Electronics, or a related subject area. 

  • Demonstrated potential for teaching undergraduate and graduate courses at the university level. 

  • The applicant must have relevant research expertise in areas related to efficient and high-frequency power converters, converter control, and power management for computing or embedded electronic systems.

  • The applicant must have teaching skills that align with the content and responsibilities of the position. This includes possessing both pedagogical and professional skills essential for carrying out the tasks associated with the role. 

  • A strong track record for research fundraising is required. 

 

For further information about the position, please contact Associate Professor Tim McRae (mcrae@sdu.dk)  or the Head of the Digital and High-frequency Electronics Section, Professor Emad Samuel Malki Ebeid, e-mail: esme@sdu.dk.  

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

  • Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must be in English and include:

  • A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages). 

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information, describing the research, along with any other relevant information, e.g. teaching experience, computational skills, etc.

  • A research plan with a focus on the development of your research line and research team. 

  • List of funded projects. 

  • Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).

  • List of publications with the most relevant publications highlighted. 

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Up to three names and emails of researchers can provide an informed reference letter at short notice. (Reference letters and other relevant qualifications may also be included.) 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file).

 

The application deadline is November 1, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

  

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and the preferred start date is from January 1, 2027. The final start date will be agreed with the successful applicant.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation.

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

title: Welders Wanted at Lomac A/S  / Svejsere søges til Lomac A/S
description:
In English:

About Lomac A/S
Lomac A/S is a Danish manufacturing company specializing in steel constructions, working within areas such as marine, offshore, construction, and wind turbines. We currently have 50–60 employees, and due to a strong order intake and exciting customer projects, we need more skilled welders for our production.
We already have international employees on our team, so we know what it takes to give new international colleagues a good start — both professionally and socially.

We offer

  • Permanent position in a well-established and solid company
  • Modern machinery and good working conditions
  • Training and hands-on onboarding at the start
  • Free accommodation in a single room during your work periods in Denmark.
  • A working environment with experienced and dedicated colleagues
  • Opportunities for professional and personal development


Job content

  • MIG/MAG welding of steel constructions for marine, offshore, construction, and wind turbine projects, among others
  • Reading technical drawings and working according to work instructions
  • Quality control of your own work
  • Collaborating with other production staff to meet delivery deadlines


We expect that you

  • Are a qualified welder or have documented experience as a welder
  • Hold a valid welding certificate 136/138 H-LO45 D168, or equivalent documented qualification
  • Are reliable, punctual, and take a professional approach to the work
  • Can work independently and as part of a team
  • Are quality-conscious and detail-oriented


Requirements for applicants

  • Are a citizen of an EU/EEA country, or already hold a valid Danish work permit
  • Can communicate in English and/or German
  • Are willing to work in Denmark for set periods at a time (rotation scheme – see Terms of Employment below)


Terms of employment

  • Number of positions: 10–15
  • Start date: As soon as possible
  • Employment type: Permanent position
  • Working model: Rotation scheme – employees work a set period in Denmark, followed by a period at home, before returning to Denmark. The preferred rotation is 4 weeks of work followed by 2 weeks off. Travel to and from Denmark is at the employee’s own expense.
  • Working hours: 6–7 days a week x 10.5 hours – day and night shifts
  • Hourly pay: DKK 180/200 (approximately EUR 24/27) per hour
  • Overtime: We follow the current overtime pay rules of the Confederation of Danish Industry

Jonas Nielsen, Business Coordinator

Send your application and CV to jni@lomac.dk As soon as possible.

• Har sans for detaljer og præcisionsarbejde

Vi tilbyder

• Dygtige og hjælpsomme kolleger

title: Frøbjerg-Orte Friskole, Børnehave og Vuggestue søger pædagogmedhjælper/pædagogisk assistent til vores børnehave/vuggestue.
description:
Er du initiativrig, nysgerrig og drømmer du om at være en del af:

- en medarbejdergruppe, der har fokus på udvikling, og hvor der er plads til grin og forskellighed?

- et hus, hvor der er højt til loftet, skønne omgivelser og en kultur båret af højt fagligt niveau?

 Så er det dig, vi har brug for!

 Vores hus er opdelt i 2 grupper:

Yngstegruppen er vores vuggestue, og den er inddelt i tre grupper: Hoppelopperne, Løbebillerne og Springfrøerne.

Ældstegruppen er vores børnehave, og den er inddelt i Græshopperne, som er de ældste og kommende skolebørn, Mariehøns og Sommerfugle for de 3-4-årige.

Alle børn tilknyttes hver deres gruppe og primære voksne, samtidig med, at vi laver hverdagsaktiviteter på tværs af grupperne, når det giver mening.

 Vi har en ledig stilling i vores børnehave på 30-34 timer.

Vi ser værdien i at bringe de ansattes kompetencer i spil i for alle børn og da vi dagligt både morgen og eftermiddag arbejder på tværs af Yngste og Ældste, skal du være åben for at kunne se dig selv i hele huset.

 Vores pædagogik hviler på et fundament af grundmotorik og sanseintegration, altid bakket op af anerkendelse, nærvær, tilknytning og stjernestunder. Der skal være plads til udfoldelse og tid til fordybelse sammen med børnene og børnene imellem.

Vores naturskønne område med skov i baghaven og Frøbjerg Bavnehøj som nærmeste nabo, lægger op til en aktiv hverdag præget af aktiviteter både ude og inde. Kun fantasien sætter grænser…... også for de voksne.

 Vi lægger stor vægt på fællesskabets betydning for alle børn. Ved at understøtte den enkeltes udvikling, sikrer vi barnets mulighed for at føle sig inkluderet og som en del af en helhed.

Vi prioriterer et tæt forældresamarbejde, hvor vi i fællesskab altid sigter mod at vende vilkår til muligheder.

 Vi drømmer om at: 

·         Du elsker udelivet og ser uderummet som en integreret del af børnelivet.

·         Du har stor interesse for, og gerne erfaring med sanseintegration og børns motoriske udvikling.

·         Du er optaget af LEG og Langsom Pædagogik, og du understøtter naturligt børnenes egne initiativer og fordybelse.

·         Du har fagligheden i fokus og reflekterer gerne over egen og andres praksis.

·         Du kan se dig selv i en personalegruppe, hvor der er plads til livsglæde, humor, selvstændighed, fleksibilitet og gå på mod.

·         Du får øje på fordelene i at være en del af friskolelivet, -det tværfaglige samarbejde og den røde tråd på hele Frøbjerg-Orte Friskole, Børnehave og Vuggestue.

Frøbjerg-Orte Friskole, Børnehave og Vuggestue rummer tilsammen pt. 185 skoleelever, 47 børn på Ældstegruppen og 33 børn på Yngstegruppen. Stedet drives af en forældrevalgt bestyrelse, bakket op af forældreråd i børnehave/vuggestue.

Vi er ca. 48 medarbejdere fordelt mellem lærere, pædagoger, pædagogmedhjælpere, studerende, forretningsfører samt praktisk personale. Ledelsen består af Konstitueret Skoleleder og Pædagogisk Leder.

 Hvordan ansøger du?

 Stillingen er til ansættelse pr 1. december 2026.

 Vi ser meget gerne at du prioriterer at komme og besøge os, da det giver os mulighed for at vise dig alt det vi kan tilbyde og samtidig kan du mærke stemningen i huset. Ring til os for at lave en aftale om besøg.

 Ansøgningsfrist er senest d. 5. oktober 2026. Samtaler vil blive afholdt løbende.

 Ansøgning og bilag sendes som en PDF til: ansoegning@fofri.dk Skriv dit navn i emnefeltet. Du kan læse og se meget om os på vores hjemmeside http://www.fofri.dk

 Personlig kontakt til pædagogisk leder: Rikke Skovhøj tlf. 54552155 mail: bhleder@fofri.dk eller konstitueret skoleleder Kim Hedegaard tlf. 25143454 mail: viceleder@fofri.dk

Ansættelse sker i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst ”aftale om løn – og ansættelse for pædagogisk personale i de frie grundskoler”.

 Hvis du ikke har hørt fra os inden d. 30. oktober 2026, er stillingen besat til anden side.

Din ansøgning vil blive opbevaret i 6 mdr. Herefter bliver den slettet.

title: Team Leader - Night Shift Operations
description:
Team Leader - Night Shift Operations

Transport 24 Danmark ApS

Are you ready to lead a dynamic transport and distribution team in a fast-paced logistics environment?

At Transport 24 Danmark ApS, we are looking for three experienced and motivated Team Leaders - Night Shift Operations to ensure the efficient execution of our transportation and delivery services in association with DAO.

You will be responsible for leading employees, maintaining operational excellence, and ensuring high service quality while creating a positive and productive working environment.

Reporting directly to the Operations Manager, you will play a key role in achieving operational goals, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement across our night shift operations.

About the Role

As Team Leader, you will oversee the daily operation of our night shift transport and distribution activities. You will manage a team of postmen and operational staffconsisting of 15 persons, ensuring that deliveries are completed safely, efficiently, and on time.

You will work closely with management and operational support functions to optimize productivity, maintain service standards, and ensure effective resource planning.

Key Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Overall responsibility for the daily execution of night shift post operations

  • Planning and coordinating staffing, routes, and operational resources

  • Conducting onboarding and training of new employees

  • Monitoring and controlling delivery route quality, efficiency, and compliance with company standards

  • Ensuring adequate staffing by coordinating replacements during employee sickness, holidays, and other absences

  • Supporting recruitment and employee development in collaboration with HR

  • Investigating operational incidents and implementing corrective actions

  • Driving continuous improvement initiatives and process optimization

  • Collaborating closely with dispatch, customer service, and management teams

  • Participating in operational tasks when required and leading by example

Your Profile

We are looking for a hands-on leader who enjoys creating results through people.

You:

  • Have previous  experience within transportation, logistics, distribution, warehousing, or a similar operational environment

  • Are confident managing diverse teams and multicultural workplaces

  • Have strong organizational and planning skills

  • Can work independently and make decisions under pressure

  • Possess good communication and interpersonal skills

  • Are comfortable using IT systems and operational software

  • Have a proactive mindset focused on continuous improvement

  • Are fluent in English , both written and spoken

  • Hold a valid driving license

Experience within courier, delivery operations will be considered an advantage.

What We Offer

  • A key leadership position with significant responsibility

  • Opportunities for professional and personal development

  • Salary, pension, and employment conditions in accordance with the applicable 3F collective agreement

  • A diverse and inclusive workplace culture

Working Hours

This is a full-time position of 37 hours per week.

The role primarily covers night shift operations, with working hours scheduled according to a fixed roster. Flexibility is expected during periods of high operational demand, employee absences, holidays, and operational changes.

Location

title: Postdoctoral Position in Animal Welfare Risks of Feeding Red Seaweed to Dairy Cows
description:
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Aarhus University, calls for applications for a full-time postdoctoral position. The two-year position is available from 1 February 2027, or soon thereafter. The position will be in the research unit Behaviour, stress and welfare (BSW).

Dairy cattle contribute substantially to agricultural greenhouse gas emissions, primarily through enteric methane production, making the identification of effective nutritional mitigation strategies an important area of research. While the feed additive Bovaer has received considerable attention for its methane-reducing effects, concerns regarding animal health and welfare have led to increasing interest in alternative solutions, including seaweed-based feed additives. The seaweed Asparagopsis spp. has shown significant methane-mitigating potential; however, its use has also raised animal welfare concerns. Consequently, there is a need to evaluate the animal welfare effects of seaweed-based feed additives.

Research tasks
  • Evaluating the effects of seaweed-based feed additives on the behaviour and welfare of dairy cattle.
  • Investigating behavioural indicators of discomfort and pain associated with feed management.
  • Validating welfare assessment measures through experimental approaches, including pharmacological interventions.
  • Contributing to scientific publications and dissemination of research results.
  • Participating in knowledge exchange activities with public authorities and industry stakeholders.
  • Contributing to teaching and supervision of students at the bachelor's, master's, and PhD levels.


Qualifications
We are seeking a candidate who has:
  • A PhD degree or equivalent in biology, animal science, veterinary science, or a related field, and research experience in animal behaviour and welfare.
  • A strong interest in strategies aimed at reducing the climate impact of dairy production through feeding management.
  • At least a basic understanding of feeding management.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to communicate scientific research results effectively.
  • The ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a research environment.
  • For non-Scandinavian candidates, a commitment to learning Danish, including reading, writing, and speaking, is expected during the employment period.


Contact
Further information on the position may be obtained from Professor Margit Bak Jensen, phone: +4522365482, email: margitbak.jensen@anivet.au.dk

What we offer
  • A well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment and animal experimental facilities
  • An informal and multicultural research environment with high professionalism and close collaboration and networking activities
  • A workplace characterized by equality and a good work-life balance, and an open discussion across different fields of research.


The candidate will have the opportunity to be trained and gain experience in:
  • Teaching and supervision of students at the BSc and MSc level through active involvement in teaching in animal science and in the veterinary science programme.
  • Research-based consultancy to authorities, where it is relevant.


Who we are
Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences is well-known for its skilled and very innovative interdisciplinary research environments with high international impact. We perform world-class research, which contributes with solutions to solve essential societal challenges within the green transition: food production and veterinary medicine – nationally and globally.

The department generates novel research at the highest international level within sustainable food production, environment, climate, health and welfare for animals and humans. The activities form the basis for the research-based public sector consultancy and degree programs covering bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degree programs within animal science and veterinary medicine. We offer a lively, engaged and innovative learning and study environment, which is closely integrated in the research environment.

Our department has unique and advanced animal experimental research facilities and technologies, situated in close connection to the research environment, and a comprehensive national and international research network and good industrial and professional collaboration.

Please refer to Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences (au.dk) for further information about the department: https://anivet.au.dk/en

Place of work and area of employment
The place of work is the Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, AU Viborg,
Blichers Allé 20, DK-8830 Tjele, and the area of employment is Aarhus University (AU) with related departments.

Living in Denmark
Please visit the international staff website: https://internationalstaff.au.dk/prearrival/ for information about arriving to and living in Denmark for both the applicants and their potential families.



Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self.



Formalities and salary range
Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

title: Junior Software Developer
description:
Want to work with sustainability and software? Looking to be part of an innovative, fast-growing Danish greentech company with global reach? Then Explicit might be the place for you.

We are looking for a software developer to join us to develop and maintain our digital platforms as we scale.

We do drone-based emissions monitoring across oil & gas, maritime, waste management, and other industries. By helping operators safely identify methane leaks and quantify emissions, we're proud to be supporting industry efforts to improve environmental performance while enhancing operational efficiency and asset integrity. We measure greenhouse gas emissions data from various sources and combining them with atmospheric data. Based on scientific methods we then quantify emissions and visualize the data to provide emissions intelligence to operations enabling actions on emissions.

We have a strong focus on R&D, and we are exploring new cutting-edge technologies and ideas to innovate what we can do within emissions monitoring.

The job

You will be part of a small, talented tech developer team, responsible for designing, building and maintaining our digital platforms, which are the core of the products we deliver to customers.

As a Software Developer your responsibilities will include:

  • Co-development of our main applications Microsoft Azure, Blazor Server Application (C#)

  • Co-development of our calculation engine, Microsoft Azure Function (Python)

  • Develop new, more appealing user experiences aimed at different user groups to view products and services.

  • Maintain databases, application services and reporting landscape specific to the European maritime emission monitoring set-up.

  • Improve analysis tools and the user experience for the customers, the drone pilot and the internal project manager in collaboration with the project manager running the campaigns.

About you

We are looking for a candidate who meets the following criteria:

  • A bachelor's degree or master’s degree in engineering, data science, software design, computer engineering, mathematics, physics or similar

  • Experience with code development in C# and Python and preferable Rust

  • Experience with database design (SQL)

  • Familiar with software development processes in Azure DevOps

  • Experience with development of user interfaces and UX design is an advantage, but not a requirement

  • Fluent in English. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement

  • Genuine interest in technology and IT infrastructure

  • Structured and focused on delivering quality work and being a good team player.

 

What we offer

  • A permanent, full-time position in a fast-growing greentech company with real-world impact on cutting industrial emissions

  • Competitive benefits including paid pension, health insurance, parental leave and 6 weeks' holiday allowance

  • Software ownership early on, with senior developers to learn from

  • A flat hierarchy where ideas are heard, initiative is encouraged, and responsibility comes early

  • A supportive team that values collaboration, trust and learning

  • Job location is just north of Copenhagen in Virum, Denmark.

Application and information

We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we will be evaluating applications on an ongoing basis. Application deadline is 18 October 2026. Expected start date is 1 November 2026.

Please send your application, including your motivation and what a competence you bring, together with your CV to jobs@explicit.dk. Write “Software developer” in the subject field.

If you have any questions about the job, you are welcome to contact Rasmus Ebdrup, Chief Digital Officer at reb@explicit.dk

___________________________________________________________________________________

About Explicit

Explicit ApS is a pioneering Danish green tech company specialising in drone-based emissions monitoring across the energy, maritime, waste management, and other industries. We deliver reliable, transparent and actionable emissions data to some of the largest energy companies all over the world using our patented drone-based methodology.

We are headquartered in Virum, Denmark, with offices in Norway, Germany and Australia. Our international team of around 30 colleagues brings together engineering, data and environmental expertise, united by a shared mission to make a difference in emissions monitoring. Read more about what we do at explicit.dk

title: Smed/svejser søges til automotive virksomhed i Gedved
description:
Svejsning · Smedearbejde · Trailere og maskinkonverteringer – Fuldtid, fysisk tilstedeværelse, Gedved, Danmark

Er du typen, der læser en tegning, tænder for svejseapparatet og er stolt af det, der kommer ud i den anden ende? RENTEQ Automotive er en startup i vækst, og vi har brug for en dygtig smed til at svejse de trailere, rammer og dele, der indgår i hver eneste maskine, vi konverterer. Hvis du er praktisk anlagt, nysgerrig og har lyst til at sætte dit præg på noget, der virkelig betyder noget – så læs videre.

Om RENTEQ Automotive

RENTEQ Automotive er en ung dansk virksomhed med en ambition om at reducere CO₂-udledningen ved at elektrificere varebiler og entreprenørmaskiner. Vi holder til i Gedved og tager hele rejsen på os – fra ingeniørarbejde og udvikling helt frem til produktion.

Din rolle

Som vores smed vil du omsætte tegninger til de færdige dele, der går i vores produkter. Fra vores værksted i Gedved svejser og tilpasser du trailere, bærende rammer og de øvrige stålkomponenter, der udgør rygraden i vores maskinkonverteringer. Meget af materialet vil kommer fra egen cnc bukkemaskine og laserskærer.

Det her er ikke kun et samlebånd – der vil være mange forskellige projekter, og du skal kunne tænke selvstændigt. Du arbejder tæt sammen med ingeniør- og produktionsteamet, kan finde ud af bidrage til problemløsninger tidligt, og hjælper os med at bygge klogere fra gang til gang.

Dine opgaver

•     Svejse bærende rammer, chassisdele og konstruktioner – MIG og TIG afhængigt af materiale og specifikation

•     Bygge, svejse og tilpasse trailere og de øvrige dele, der indgår i konverteringen af maskinerne

•     Tilpasse og efterbearbejde svejsninger – opretning, slibning og kontrol af pasform

•     Læse og fortolke tekniske tegninger og omsætte dem til færdige dele

•     Kvalitetskontrollere eget arbejde – målkontrol, svejsekvalitet og pasform – inden det går til produktion

•     Samarbejde med ingeniørteamet om at identificere designproblemer og give praktisk feedback

•     Holde værkstedet organiseret, udstyr vedligeholdt og processer dokumenteret

•     Understøtte prototypeiterationer – forvent at der er hyppige designændringer og flere projekter kørende på én gang.


Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Har du praktisk erfaring inden for svejs/smedearbejde – det kan være fra en håndværksuddannelse, teknisk skole eller reel værkstedserfaring?

Det vil være en fordel, hvis du kan sætte kryds ved det meste af nedenstående:

•     Erfaren svejser – MIG og TIG

•     Erfaring med trailer-, chassis- eller konstruktionssvejsning er et stort plus

•     Fortrolig med almindeligt smedeværktøj – vinkelsliber, plasma-/gasskærer og opretningsværktøj

•     I stand til at læse og arbejde ud fra tekniske tegninger og 3D-modeller

•     Øje for detaljen: du måler to gange og er stolt af præcist, pænt arbejde

•     Trives i et team, hvor ingen dage er ens

•     Proaktiv – du identificerer problemer tidligt frem for at lade dem blive til andres problem

•     Dansk på højt niveau og velfungerende engelsk, da vi er et internationalt team.

Vi tilbyder

•     En central rolle i en startup i vækst, hvor dit arbejde er synligt i hvert køretøj, der forlader vores værksted

•     Et uformelt og rart team i en flad virksomhedsstruktur med variation i arbejdsdagene

•     Et sundt og attraktivt arbejdsmiljø med ordentligt svejse- og smedeudstyr

•     Reelle muligheder for at vokse med virksomheden, efterhånden som vi skalerer til fuld produktion.

Sådan søger du

Send dit CV og et par linjer om dig selv til Simon Steen Kristensen på email simon@ren-teq.com. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og inviterer relevante kandidater til en uformel første samtale – så vent ikke for længe med at tage kontakt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, inden du søger, er du meget velkommen til at skrive til os på samme adresse eller ringe på tlf. +45 21 94 21 43.

title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project in renal calcium transport
description:
Declaration of interest regarding PhD project in renal calcium transport

 

The laboratory of Henrik Dimke, Cardiovascular and Renal Research Unit at the Department of Molecular Medicine, University of Southern Denmark is seeking a highly motivated PhD student in the field of renal transport physiology. Particular emphasis will be placed on signalling through the calcium-sensing receptor and the regulation of renal calcium transport in transgenic models.

 

Research environment

The PhD student will join the laboratory of Professor Henrik Dimke in the Cardiovascular and Renal Research Unit. The laboratory studies epithelial ion transport and the mechanisms that maintain calcium, magnesium, and phosphate balance, with particular emphasis on renal calcium transport, the calcium-sensing receptor, claudins, and kidney stone disease. The Research Unit focuses on innovative molecular and biomedical research related to cardiovascular and renal physiology. We offer a stimulating, international research environment where English is the preferred language at meetings and seminars. You will work in the modern NytSUND building, which is directly connected to the new Odense University Hospital and provides state-of-the-art laboratory and animal facilities. You can read more about the department and institute here.

 

Project description

The project will investigate how altered calcium-sensing receptor (CASR) signalling disrupts the endocrine and renal control of calcium homeostasis. Particular attention will be given to autosomal dominant hypocalcaemia type 1, in which excessive CASR activity suppresses parathyroid hormone secretion and promotes renal calcium loss. The project will examine the signalling mechanisms linking CASR activation to renal calcium transport and whole-body calcium balance. The successful applicant will use clinically relevant genetic models, including inducible and cell-specific transgenic approaches, together with detailed physiological characterization, molecular and biochemical techniques, and imaging.

 

Qualifications

Qualified and highly motivated candidates from all nationalities are encouraged to apply. 

 

The successful applicant must have

  • A Master's degree (Danish: kandidatgrad) or another relevant degree that concludes a research-based study programme of minimum five years’ duration at an institution of higher education. If you do not have a Master's degree, the Graduate School will make an individual assessment of your academic qualifications.

  • Good oral and written English language skills

  • you must at the time of submission have documented research experience. E.g. be the author or co-author of an article in a peer-reviewed international journal (must at least be submitted) or of a published abstract from an international scientific conference, or have worked as research assistant full time for at least 6 months (after completing your masters degree). The research experience of each applicant is individually assessed by the Graduate School.

 

The successful applicant should have

  • The ability to work independently and in a structured manner. 

  • Good collaborative and interpersonal skills. 

  • Previous experience with experimental animal work or relevant molecular and biochemical techniques, such as western blotting or immunohistochemistry, is preferred but not required.

 

For further information about the project, please contact:

Professor Henrik Dimke

Department of Molecular Medicine

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

Tel. +45 65 50 83 10 E-mail: hdimke@health.sdu.dk


Applications must include:

• A letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)

• • Contact details for at least one professional reference who may be contacted during the assessment process.


Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. References will normally be contacted only for shortlisted candidates.

Further information about the PhD-program can be found at the homepage of the University.


Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated. 

 

Closing date: October 12th, 2026


Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

 

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order).

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.


Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

 

The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top‑class research, and a broad range of health‑related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.

 

As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. In Esbjerg and Copenhagen, strong academic communities provide the framework for research and education, while our modern faculty building in Odense brings research, education, and administration together under one roof and is directly connected to Odense University Hospital.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: 2 Mekanikere/montører søges til spændende automotive virksomhed i Horsens N, Gedved
description:
RENTEQ Automotive søger efter praktiske og dygtige mekanikere/montører, der kan tage hånd om den mekaniske/eltekniske montage på vores fabrik i Gedved, og som har det rette mindset til at arbejde i en produktion, hvor processerne løbende optimeres.

Om RENTEQ Automotive

RENTEQ Automotive er en ung dansk virksomhed med en ambition om at reducere CO₂-udledningen ved at elektrificere varebiler og entreprenørmaskiner og opbygge batteritrailere. Vi har udvikling i Dragør og produktion på vores fabrik i Gedved, og vi tager hele rejsen på os – fra ingeniørarbejde og udvikling helt frem til serieproduktion.

Jobbet

Som mekaniker/montør hos os arbejder du med den praktiske montage på produktionslinjen – primært opbygning af vores Vanteq, på sigt også entreprenørmaskiner og vores batteritrailer.

Produktionen er stadig ung, så der er masser af plads til at forbedre den. Du arbejder tæt sammen med ingeniør- og produktionsteamet, bidrager til problemløsning tidligt og hjælper os med at bygge klogere fra gang til gang. Du er med til at sikre, at hver eneste komponent behandles korrekt og dokumenteres præcist, idet dit arbejde er fundamentet for hele konverteringsprojektet.

Dine typiske opgaver vil være:

●      Montage af Vanteq på produktionslinjen – efter fastlagte arbejdsinstruktioner

●      Montering af elektriske komponenter, kabelføring og drivline i chassis og karosseri

●      Tilpasning og fejlfinding på komponenter i tæt samarbejde med elektronik- og software-teamet

●      Kvalitetskontrol og dokumentation af alle monteringssteps og fund undervejs i produktionen

●      Løbende forbedring af proces og arbejdsgange – du kan bidrage til de guider og checklister, vi udvikler

●      Primært arbejde med Vanteq – og også entreprenørmaskiner kommer nok også ind i Gedved

●      Sammen holder vi altid produktionen organiseret, udstyr vedligeholdt og processer dokumenteret for at sikre den højest mulige kvalitet.

Er det dig?

Vi leder efter en person med solid praktisk erfaring og en tilgang, der kombinerer præcision med fleksibilitet. Vigtigst er, at du kan arbejde selvstændigt, men også er dygtig til at samarbejde i et team, der hele tiden lærer og udvikler sig. Det vil være en fordel, hvis du kan nikke ja til nedenstående:

●      Erfaring med montering og demontering af motor, hydrauliksystem og brændstofkomponenter på landbrugsmaskiner, entreprenørmaskiner eller varebiler

●      Solidt kendskab til mekaniske systemer, væskesystemer og elektriske grundelementer

●      Ideelt set en stærk interesse for elektrificering

●      AC-kursus eller tilsvarende (ikke obligatorisk, men en stor fordel)

●      Evnen til at arbejde struktureret og dokumentere dit arbejde

●      Selvstændighed og ansvar, men også åbenhed over for feedback og samarbejde

●      Tålmodighed og en positiv tilgang til arbejde i et udviklingsmiljø, hvor vi hele tiden forfiner processen

●      Dansk på højt niveau; fungerende engelsk er en fordel, da vi er et internationalt team.

Vi tilbyder

●      En central rolle i vores produktionsteam, hvor din praktiske viden sætter direkte aftryk på, hvordan vi konverterer maskiner

●      Mulighed for at påvirke og udforme arbejdsprocesserne – dine idéer og erfaringer bliver hørt

●      En fast rytme i produktionen med arbejde på Vanteq og på sigt flere maskintyper

●      Tæt samarbejde med dygtige ingeniører og et uformelt, kollegialt team

●      Ordentlige faciliteter, godt værktøj og en støttende arbejdskultur

●      Løn: 190-240 kr./t afhængig af kompetencer og erfaring

●      Reelle muligheder for at vokse fagligt og personligt i takt med, at virksomheden udvikler sig.

Sådan søger du

Send dit CV og et par linjer om dig selv og din erfaring til simon@ren-teq.com. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og inviterer relevante kandidater til en uformel første samtale – så vent ikke for længe med at tage kontakt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Simon på simon@ren-teq.com eller på 21942143
