title: Assistant Professor in Operations and Supply Chain Digitalisation
description:
The Center for Supply Chain Digitalisation (CSD), at the Department of Technology and Innovation, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for an Assistant Professor in Operations and Supply Chain Digitalization with special focus on simulation and/or artificial intelligence applied to operations and supply chains.

The targeted start date is February 2027.

The successful candidate will be responsible for collaboratively building up the area of operations and supply chain digitalisation with a primary focus on quantitative methods such as discrete-event and agent-based simulation, process automation, data science, and machine learning.

Successful candidates will drive internationally recognized and competitive research, work closely with industry, and are expected to attract external research funding. The position has a strong focus on experimental and applied research in production systems and supply chain fields. The candidate will play a key role in providing outstanding education, supervising bachelor's and master’s students, and developing junior research staff.

SDU CSD is a highly international group of faculty members, embedded in a region with a strong network of companies, including some of Denmark's largest global industrial players (i.e. Danfoss, Linak, Siemens) and many manufacturing SMEs. Projects currently run by the group cover a range of topics within the field of operations and supply chain digitalization.

The successful candidate must have a background in engineering. PhD degree preferably in industrial engineering, supply chain, operations management, operations research, or the like.

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

 

We expect

A highly motivated, collaborative person, who can work in an international, interdisciplinary team, with documented research skills in the field of operations and supply chain. The candidate needs to be a team player and, at the same time, be able to work independently. The successful candidate is active in publishing in engineering journals.

The ideal candidate can connect research with practical technology application and has demonstrated skills and competencies in one or more of the following areas:

  • Discrete-event and/or agent-based simulation

  • Artificial intelligence, machine/deep learning applied to operations and supply chain (AI-applications in other fields are not relevant for this position) 

  • Agentic AI applied to operations and supply chain

  • Business and intelligent process automation

Further information is available from Associate Professor Elias Ribeiro da Silva elias@iti.sdu.dk.

 

We offer

  • A professional workplace culture that values equality, mutual respect, and is designed to accommodate and encourage work-life balance

  • A vibrant social environment with structured activities and informal routines that promote cross-disciplinary interaction and cultivate an inclusive, supportive atmosphere.

  • An engaging, dynamic, and international interdisciplinary environment with extensive collaboration opportunities across national, international, and industrial partners

  • Opportunities for continued professional development and education for all staff members.

  • Access to a well-developed research infrastructure

  • A strong institutional commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in all aspects of the workplace

 

About the workplace

The position is within the SDU Center for Supply Chain Digitalisation (CSD) at the Faculty of Engineering on the international campus Sønderborg. The center conducts research at the intersection of supply chain management, data science, and digital technologies. Our work applies quantitative, data-driven methods to analyse, design, and optimise complex supply chains.

In close collaboration with industry partners, the center focuses on the full data journey across the supply chain, developing tools and methods based on advanced analytics, simulation, and artificial intelligence to enable stronger coordination, end-to-end transparency, and more sustainable and efficient supply chain operations.

SDU CSD is situated in a region with a robust network of companies, including some of Denmark’s largest global industrial players as well as numerous SMEs. The group’s current projects mainly focus on building quantitative models and methods to support better decisions or on turning data-driven optimisation, simulation, and digital tools into practical use in operations. 

The SDU CSD is a highly international and interdisciplinary group of faculty members, with international students. The campus is in Sønderborg, an attractive coastal town with an open Scandinavian culture, and affordable housing and living costs.

 

Special benefits when working in Denmark

  • The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week

  • 30 days of paid holiday per year

  • The yearly salary for a full-time assistant professor is between DKK 502.905 and DKK 566.647 depending on the years of working experience. Postdoc experience may place you on a higher salary step. The salary includes a base salary, a position-related supplement and pension (18.07 %). Additional supplement(s) for special qualifications can be negotiated. Authorisation supplement(s) will be granted, if relevant for the position. Your local eligible trade union representative at SDU negotiates your salary on your behalf.

  • Subsidized preschool childcare and a free education system from primary school up to university level

  • Universal health insurance as a resident of Denmark, including family members officially residing in Denmark

  • In relation to childbirth, employees are entitled to a combined total of 52 weeks of parental leave, shared between parents, with full or partial salary depending on circumstances.

  • Researchers recruited from abroad are offered a special researcher tax scheme with a lower tax rate. 

  • Travel and moving expenses may be partially covered.

 

Living in Denmark

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. Among other things, the staff answers questions concerning salary, taxation, housing and accompanying family.

We recommend that international applicants also take the time to visit Work in Denmark.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

 

Application and assessment

Applications will be assessed by an expert committee. When the expert committee issues its assessment, applicants will receive the portion of the assessment pertaining to them personally.

The committee assesses candidates only based on the application materials. Please include the following documents in English: 

  • Brief motivation letter

  • Curriculum vitae

  • Full list of publications

  • Copies of the three publications on which the applicant wishes to be evaluated. Please attach one pdf-file for each publication

  • Diplomas/Certificates (Master and PhD degree)

  • Summary and documentation of teaching experience. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio.

  • Documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  An interview may be included as part of the overall evaluation of the applicant’s qualifications. If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support. Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply and specific faculty information for application at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period. The preferred start date is from February 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. title: Senior Controller
description:
Senior Controller

Work tasks: As part of the global bioeconomy, Stora Enso is a leading provider of renewable products in the areas of packaging, biomaterials and wooden construction, as well as one of the world’s largest privately owned forest owners. We believe that everything that is produced today from materials based on fossil raw materials can be made from wood in the future.
Our company employs approximately 19,000 people. Our global Finance Operations unit handles accounting activities and provides financial services across a range of areas. In the world of finance, we value accuracy, collaboration and innovation. Career for a better climate. Every day. Your Responsibilities as a Senior Controller Act as a Finance Business Partner for a business area/business unit, legal entity or group function. Lead or support controlling and financial reporting processes for the entity/function within your area of responsibility. Be responsible for the effective and accurate period-end closing, analysis and reporting activities of the entity/function. Contribute to and support the implementation and management of an efficient and accurate forecasting and budgeting process within the entity/function. Represent the entity/function in queries related to other Finance Operations processes, including Record to Report (RtR), Purchase to Pay (PtP) and Order to Cash (OtC). Ensure the implementation and compliance with Stora Enso’s financial processes and policies within the entity/function. Proactively identify opportunities for improvement, make recommendations and lead changes to continuously improve and harmonise end-to-end controlling processes. Lead and support process automation and other development projects. Ensure close collaboration and effective information flow between the entity/function, the Finance department and key stakeholders across other functions. Support and train stakeholders on controlling-related topics. What We Expect from You A Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field. At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in controlling, management reporting or accounting. A good understanding of controlling processes, including period-end closing, operational financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting and management reporting. Good knowledge of controlling tools and analytics platforms, such as Excel, SAP, OneStream and Power BI. Experience in leading process improvement and harmonisation initiatives. description:
Full-time, primarily onsite position in Tallinn. We welcome applications from both strong junior and mid-level Systems Engineers. Starting date as soon as possible or by agreement.

Work tasks: The Systems Engineer will support the definition, coordination, integration, verification and delivery of Golbriak Space’s optical communication systems.

* Meaningful technical ownership across requirements management, system integration, verification and engineering coordination * The opportunity to work across mechanical, optical, electronic, software, manufacturing and testing disciplines * Close collaboration with an international and multidisciplinary engineering team * The opportunity to develop your expertise in systems engineering, optical communications, telecommunications and aerospace * The ability to contribute to technical decisions, engineering processes and ways of working as the company grows * A gross monthly salary of €2100–€3000, depending on experience, skills and expected level of responsibility * Relocation support to Estonia if required * Reasonable flexibility in working hours, consistent with operational and team needs

Other requirements: We are looking for a candidate with strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, technical curiosity and the ability to understand complex systems as a whole. The person should be able to identify dependencies, constraints and potential conflicts between different engineering disciplines.

Strong communication and collaboration skills are required, together with the ability to explain complex technical information clearly. The company’s working language is English, so professional working proficiency in English is required. • Haldad olemasolevaid kliendikontosid – oled nende usaldusväärne ja püsiv kontaktisik. • Arendad aktiivselt vanu ja uusi ärisuhteid reisibüroode, reisikorraldajate ja ettevõtetega. • Käid messidel ja ärikohtumistel ning külastad kliente nii Eestis kui ka välismaal. • Planeerid marsruute ja tagad, et iga kliendi transpordilahendus oleks algusest lõpuni sujuv.

Omalt poolt pakume: • Stabiilse töökoha tuntud ja usaldusväärses ettevõttes.
• Iseseisva rolli, kus sinu tulemused on selgelt nähtavad. • Rahvusvahelise kogemuse – kliendikülastused ja messid välismaal. • Konkurentsivõimelise palga – täpsustame vestlusel.

Muud nõuded: Võtab oma töö eest täieliku vastutuse – sinu tulemused sõltuvad eelkõige sinust endast.
On iseseisev – sa ei vaja pidevat juhendamist ega kinnitust, et oma tööd hästi teha. On usaldusväärne ja järjepidev – kliendid teavad, et saavad sinu peale alati loota. Tunneb end mugavalt väljakujunenud süsteemide ja protsessidega töötades. Leiab rahulolu hästi tehtud tööst ja pikaajalistest kliendisuhetest, mitte pidevate muutuste otsimisest. Valdab eesti ja inglise keelt nii kõnes kui ka kirjas – lisakeelte oskus tuleb kasuks. Eelduseks on varasem töökogemus, eelistatult rahvusvaheliste klientide ja ettevõtetega suhtlemisel ning turismi-, logistika- või autorendivaldkonnas.

description:
Tööülesanded: Meeskonnajuht – tule juhi teenuste arengut Eesti ühes suurimas erihoolekande organisatsioonis.
Tallinna Erihoolekande ja Rehabilitatsiooni Keskus (TERK) on üks Eesti suurimaid erihoolekande teenuste osutajaid. Oleme arenev ja uuendusmeelne organisatsioon, kus töötavad pühendunud spetsialistid ning kus iga päev loob väärtust inimestele ja kogukonnale. Otsime oma meeskonda julget ja kogenud juhti, kes soovib kujundada suurt ja olulist teenusvaldkonda, kujundada selle arengusuunda ning tagada kvaliteetsed ja jätkusuutlikud teenused. Meil saad juhtida oma meeskonda usalduse ja vastutuse põhimõttel, katsetada uusi lahendusi ning olla osa kiiresti arenevast organisatsioonist. Sul on võimalus mõjutada teenusekasutajate igapäevaelu ning kujundada teenuseid, mis toetavad inimeste iseseisvust, heaolu ja arengut.
Sind ootavad: võimalus juhtida suurt ja olulist meeskonda kiiresti arenevas organisatsioonis; tähenduslik töö, mille mõju on päriselt nähtav; professionaalsed, toetavad ja säravad kolleegid; tugev meeskonnavaim ja kaasaegne töökeskkond; 35 kalendripäeva põhipuhkust ning 3 tervisepäeva aastas.

title: Senior Controller
description:
Senior Controller

Work tasks: As part of the global bioeconomy, Stora Enso is a leading provider of renewable products in the areas of packaging, biomaterials and wooden construction, as well as one of the world’s largest privately owned forest owners. We believe that everything that is produced today from materials based on fossil raw materials can be made from wood in the future.
Our company employs approximately 19,000 people. Our global Finance Operations unit handles accounting activities and provides financial services across a range of areas. In the world of finance, we value accuracy, collaboration and innovation. Career for a better climate. Every day. Your Responsibilities as a Senior Controller Act as a Finance Business Partner for a business area/business unit, legal entity or group function. Lead or support controlling and financial reporting processes for the entity/function within your area of responsibility. Be responsible for the effective and accurate period-end closing, analysis and reporting activities of the entity/function. Contribute to and support the implementation and management of an efficient and accurate forecasting and budgeting process within the entity/function. Represent the entity/function in queries related to other Finance Operations processes, including Record to Report (RtR), Purchase to Pay (PtP) and Order to Cash (OtC). Ensure the implementation and compliance with Stora Enso’s financial processes and policies within the entity/function. Proactively identify opportunities for improvement, make recommendations and lead changes to continuously improve and harmonise end-to-end controlling processes. Lead and support process automation and other development projects. title: Bartender
description:
We are looking for an adult employee for a DJ or bartender position at a karaoke bar located in Tallinn Old Town.

Work tasks: The role includes providing professional, friendly, and efficient service to customers in the karaoke bar and ensuring that the venue’s daily operations run smoothly. Depending on the shift and operational needs, the employee’s duties may include both bar work and tasks related to DJ and karaoke services.
Bartender duties include taking customer orders, preparing and serving alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, using the cash register system, accepting payments, and ensuring accurate transactions. The employee is responsible for keeping the bar area clean, organized, and ready for service, replenishing drink supplies and work materials when necessary, and maintaining a tidy workstation throughout the shift. When needed, the employee also helps with clearing tables, collecting glasses, serving customers in the seating area, and carrying out other daily tasks. DJ duties include operating the karaoke and music software, taking song requests from customers and managing the performance queue, selecting suitable background music, and ensuring that the karaoke evening runs smoothly. The employee uses the necessary sound and karaoke equipment, microphones, and computer programs, and assists customers in finding suitable songs when needed. The DJ is also responsible for creating a pleasant, lively, and positive atmosphere in the bar and communicating with customers in a polite and professional manner. The job also includes answering customer questions, introducing the bar’s services and offers, and assisting customers when needed. We expect the employee to be willing to cooperate with other team members and, when necessary, support colleagues with tasks in other areas in order to ensure fast and high-quality service.

We offer: We offer the opportunity to work in a karaoke bar located in Tallinn Old Town in an active and international working environment. The job is well suited to someone who enjoys communication, music, entertainment, and a varied working day.
We offer a flexible work schedule and the opportunity to work mainly in the evenings and on weekends. Previous work experience is not required, as all necessary training is provided on site. We will teach you how to use the cash register system, prepare and serve drinks, work with karaoke and music programs, and use the necessary sound and bar equipment. The employee will receive support from experienced colleagues in their daily work and will have the opportunity to develop customer service, sales, bartending, and communication skills. For a suitable and motivated employee, we offer the opportunity to take on more responsibility over time and develop within the company. Our working environment is youthful, friendly, and informal. The work is not monotonous — every evening brings different customers, songs, and situations. We value good teamwork, a positive attitude, reliability, and a willingness to learn. We offer: • on-site training and guidance; • a flexible work schedule; • an international and communication-focused working environment; • the opportunity to gain practical experience in bartending, customer service, and DJ/karaoke work; • a supportive and friendly team; • opportunities for long-term cooperation and development within the company; • internal employee discounts and benefits according to agreement.

Other requirements: The work takes place mainly in the evenings and at night, as well as on weekends, so the employee must be prepared to work according to a flexible schedule. The role requires good communication skills, friendliness, responsibility, accuracy, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Previous work experience as a bartender, DJ, or service employee is not required. All necessary working methods, including use of the cash register system, bar work, karaoke software, and equipment, will be taught on site. The employee will receive the necessary guidance and training when starting work and will be supported by experienced colleagues during the first working days. We are primarily looking for a motivated, reliable, and willing-to-learn person who wants to work in the entertainment and service industry and is comfortable communicating actively with a wide range of customers.

Option to work from home: No

Working load, shifts: 10-20 hours/week

We are looking for an insulation cladding installer (insulation sheet metal installer). Experience required.

Work tasks: JOB TASKS Installation of pipe insulation sheet metal covers – straight pipe covers, segment elbows, end covers and valve boxes (aluminum, galvanized and stainless sheet metal) Taking measurements on site and matching details to the pipeline Fixing cover sheets – screw, rivet and tape fastenings, sealing joints if necessary Minor adjustments to details on site (cutting, edge finishing) Compliance with work quality and occupational safety requirements Work takes place on sites in Paldiski and Rotterdam (offshore vessel); employees are on assignment.

We offer: Stable work and competitive salary with posting fees Transport and accommodation during posting organized and paid by the employer The employer organizes and pays for all safety training, certificates and health checks required on site Modern work tools and work clothes. Continuous work on projects in a growing field and development opportunities in our new sheet metal workshop.
Tax-free daily allowances for the mission are added; accommodation and transport during the mission are provided by the employer.

Other requirements: REQUIREMENTS FOR THE CANDIDATE
Proven work experience in insulation sheet metal covers, sheet metal or ventilation work Previous work experience as an insulator or sheet metal worker, including on sites in foreign countries, is a big plus Ability to read drawings and work independently Willingness to travel; starting work in October 2026 Estonian, Russian, Finnish or English language skills at a communication level. Accuracy and a sense of quality in finishing work; conscientiousness and independence - work is carried out on site without direct supervision; good physical shape (working at heights and in narrow spaces); teamwork skills in an international team; willingness to complete the safety training required on site and, if necessary, a health check.

Option to work from home: No

title: Tugiisik
description:
tugiisik 3-aastasele rõõmsale ja armsale poisile

Tööülesanded: Tugiisiku töö toimub peamiselt lapse abistajana heas eestikeelses tavalasteaias. Lapsel on kõne hilistumine, kuid vaatamata kõne puudumisele on ta kõigest huvituv, lustlik ja aktiivne. Ta on liikumisel ja tegevustes osav, ettevaatlik ning vaatlev-uuriv. Vahetevahel võib ta olla ka ulakas ja mitte kohe kuuletuda.
Laps vajab tugiisiku abi ja juhendamist eelkõige: • lasteaia tegevustest osa võtmisel; • lasteaia päevakava ja kodukorra järgimisel; • riietumisel; • söömisel; • hügieenitoimingutel; • turvalisuse ja järelevalve tagamisel. Tugiisiku jaoks on laps väga tore ja pigem kerge klient: ta on hästi kontakteeruv, rõõmsameelne ja koostöövalmis.

Omalt poolt pakume: Tugiisik võetakse tööle Tallina Perekeskuse poolt käsunduslepinguga. Töökoormus, tööaeg ja motivatsioonisüsteem on läbiräägitavad.

Muud nõuded: Tugiisikuks sobib täisealine inimene, kes on läbinud tugiisiku koolituse ja/või töötanud eelnevalt lastega.
Kandidaadilt ootame sobivaid isikuomadusi, head suhtlemisoskust, rahulikku meelt, usaldusväärsust ja valmisolekut lapse igapäevast toimetulekut toetada. Tugiisik peab: • oskama näha last tervikuna; • suutma suhelda lapse, tema pere ja lähedastega; • suutma kanda vastutust lapse ohutuse ja turvalisuse eest; • tegutsema vastavalt olukorrale; • järgima vastastikuse usalduse, lugupidamise ja konfidentsiaalsuse põhimõtteid. Tugiisik peab läbima korrapärase tervisekontrolli nakkushaiguste suhtes, sealhulgas iga kahe aasta järel kopsude röntgenuuringu. Tugiisikul peab olema tervisekontrolli läbimise kohta perearsti väljastatud tervisetõend. Tugiisikuks ei sobi inimene, kes on süüdi mõistetud tahtlikult toimepandud kuriteo eest või kes ei vasta muudele seadustes sätestatud nõuetele.

title: Automaalari ja koripeltiseppä
description:
AUTOMAALAREITA JA KORIPELTISEPPÄÄ

Etsimme tällä haulla ainoastaan valmiita ja itsenäiseen työhön kykeneviä alan asiantuntijoita. Jos sinulla ei ole alan ammatillista taustaa ja käytännön kokemusta korjaamo- tai maalaamotyöstä, ethän jätä hakemusta. Yrityskuvaus HS Kytkintien Automaalaamo Oy on vankalla ammattitaidolla toimiva, vakuutusyhtiöiden valtuuttama automaalaamo ja korikorjaamo. Palvelemme asiakkaitamme kattavasti kaikissa ajoneuvojen koritöissä, kolarikorjauksissa, hitsauksissa sekä vaativissa maalauspalveluissa. Henkilöautojen lisäksi erikoisosaamiseemme kuuluvat raskaan kaluston, veneiden sekä teollisuus- ja ratikkaosien kori- ja maalaustyöt. Työnkuvaus ja odotukset hakijalta Etsimme joukkoomme Automaalaria ja Koripeltiseppää (tai moniosaajaa, joka hallitsee molemmat osa-alueet) itsenäiseen ja vastuulliseen työhön. Odotamme sinulta: B-ajokortti (ehdottomasti välttämätön): Sinulla on oltava voimassa oleva ajokortti ajoneuvojen siirtoja, hallinhallintaa ja koeajoja varten. Vahvaa ammattitaitoa maalaamossa: Hallitset suvereenisti pohjatyöt (hionnat, kittaustyöt, suojaukset), pintamaalauksen, lakkauksen sekä haastavat häivytysmaalaukset. Väriosaamista: Kokemus digitaalisten väriskannerien käytöstä ja sävytarkkuudesta on välttämätöntä. Peltisepän ja kolarikorjauksen taitoja: Kokemusta peltiosien oikaisusta, korirakenteiden korjauksista, purku-/asennustöistä sekä varmasta hitsausosaamisesta (MIG/MAG). Cabas-osaaminen (suuri plussa): Kyky tehdä tai ymmärtää vakuutusyhtiöiden Cabas-vahinkotarkastuslaskelmia katsotaan merkittäväksi eduksi. Mitä tarjoamme? Vakituisen työpaikan vakaassa ja kasvavassa yrityksessä (työsopimukseen sovelletaan lakisääteistä 6 kk koeaikaa). Kilpailykykyisen, osaamisesi ja ammattitaitosi mukaisen palkan.(Palkka sovitaan kokemuksen mukaan) Laadukkaat materiaalit sekä nykyaikaiset laitteet ja olosuhteet työn tekemiseen. Miten haet? Täytämme paikat heti sopivien ammattilaisten löydyttyä, ja työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan nopeasti. Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi ja CV (ansioluettelosi) sähköpostitse liitteenä. description:

Töitä tehdään arkisin iltavuorossa klo 15-20 yrityksen autoliikkeessä.

Parhaiten onnistut tässä tehtävässä, jos sinulla on kiinnostusta autoalaa kohtaan ja autoalan koulutusta tai sinulla on työkalujen käyttökokemusta entuudestaan. Mahdollinen kokemuksesi asiakaspalvelutyöstä on eduksi.

Yritys tarjoaa asiakkailleen tuulilasien korjaus- ja vaihtopalveluja sekä autopesupalveluja. Tuulilaseja vaihdetaan erikokoisiin ajoneuvoihin, ja yritys toimii kaikkien vakuutusyhtiöiden kumppanikorjaamona.

Huomioithan hakiessasi, että työtehtävän annot ovat suomeksi, joten työssä vaaditaan suomen kielen taitoa.

title: Library Events, Development and Partnerships Coordinator
description:
**General Mission**

The Coordinator is responsible for the development and programming of the library. They organise activities and events, develop partnerships, and contribute to the librarys visitor numbers.

They are also responsible for monitoring the collections, handling returned books, and keeping the library organised.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Library Programming and Development**

- Increase the librarys visitor numbers and appeal, taking into account the expectations and needs of its audiences.

- Promote the librarys spaces and collections by developing projects and events.

- Develop a range of paid activities and services.

- Manage the library shop and coffee area.


**2\. Talks and Debates**

- Design and organise talks, debates, lectures and events.

- Identify and invite authors, experts, associations and other relevant speakers or personalities.

- Encourage discussion, participation and interaction among different audiences.


**3\. Partnerships and Collaborations**

- Identify, develop and maintain a network of partners.

- Build partnerships and joint projects with external organisations and stakeholders.


**4\. Library Space and Collection Management**

- Ensure the efficient day-to-day operation of the library and report any issues or malfunctions.

- Handle returned books and ensure that materials are properly shelved and organised.

- Maintain the collections, including classification, presentation, repairs and replacement of damaged or missing items.

- Select and order new books and other materials.


**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a dynamic, independent and curious person who is proactive and enjoys interacting with the public. The successful candidate will play an active role in the cultural and commercial development of a welcoming and open community space.

- Excellent interpersonal skills and confidence in interacting with the public and partners.

- Ability to create and develop partnerships.

- Initiative and ability to propose and deliver projects.

- Commercial awareness and ability to identify potential sources of funding.

- Strong organisational skills, autonomy and versatility.

- A passion for reading, discussion and the exchange of ideas.


**Practical Information**

- Contract: 6-month fixed-term contract, renewable

- Working hours: 80%, spread over 4 days per week

- **Salary :** €2,268 gross per month

- Start date : October 2026

- Languages: English at C1 level required; French at B2 level preferred; Knowledge of Finnish is an advantage.

- How to apply: Please send your CV along with a short cover letter to **sg-ac@france.fi by 27 September.**

- If you have not heard from us within 4 weeks, please consider that your application has been unsuccessful.

description:
Etsimme hydrauliikka-asentajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Turkuun! Asiakasyrityksemme on erikoistunut laivateollisuuteen ja he tarjoavat kattavasti hydrauliikkahuolto- ja korjauspalveluita toimipisteellään, telakoilla ja aluksilla.

Pääasiallisena tehtävänäsi on toimia asentajana hydrauliikkaan liittyvissä huolto- ja korjaustehtävissä esim. letkujen valmistus sekä huolto. Tehtäviä voi olla aika ajoin myös sylinterityöt, öljyjen vaihto tai vaativammatkin korjaustyöt. Töitä tehdään kokoaikaisesti 37,5h/viikko ja odotamme hakijalta reissuvalmiutta, sillä töitä tehdään asiakasyrityksen toimipisteellä, telakoilla ja aluksilla. Reissujen pituudet vaihtelevat aina muutamasta päivästä pariin viikkoon riippuen telakasta/aluksesta ja tämän sijainnista, mutta useimmiten nämä sijaitsevat Suomessa tai muualla Euroopassa. Ajoittaisen ulkomaanreissaamisen vuoksi edellytämme sinulta vähintään kohtalaista englannin kielen osaamista.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

\- Aikaisempi tehtävään soveltuva koulutus esim. raskaan kaluston koulutus, hydrauliikka ja/tai työkokemus vastaavista tehtävistä on eduksi tehtävässä menestymisen kannalta.

\- Oman ajoneuvon käyttömahdollisuutta asiakasyrityksen sijainnin vuoksi ja lisäksi C-ajokortti lasketaan eduksi.

\- Reissuvalmiutta aina muutamasta päivästä muutamaan viikkoon asti ajoittain.

\- Arvostamme myös kiinnostusta tekniikkaa ja koneita kohtaan, kyvykkyyttä sitoutua tehtävään, halua oppia ja omaksua uusia asioita, kykyä omatoimiseen ja tiimityöskentelyyn, joustavuutta sekä rehtiä ja reipasta työskentelyotetta.

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan ja paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Täytä hakemuksesi ohessa olevan linkin kautta ja kerro siinä mahdollisimman kattavasti itsestäsi, osaamisestasi sekä aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi. Kaikki yhteydenotot: Click Henkilöstöpalvelut Oy, Seniorikonsultti Riku Koski, puh. 0504110470, tiedustelut arkisin klo 9-16.

title: Raskaskalustomekaanikko pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen (Nummela)
description:
Etsimme nyt asiakasyrityksellemme raskaskalustomekaanikkoa pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Nummelaan!

Asiakasyrityksemme on monimerkkikorjaamo, joka palvelee pääasiassa kuljetusalan sekä rakennusalan yrityksiä. Raskaskalustomekaanikkona vastaat raskaankaluston, maanrakennus- ja rakennuskoneiden, sekä nostolaitteiden huolloista ja korjauksista. Työskentely tapahtuu itsenäisesti sekä toimipisteellä että asiakasyrityksissä Uudenmaan ja Kanta-Hämeen alueella. Työntekijälle tarjotaan työauto käyttöön ja liikkuva työpäivä on mahdollista aloittaa suoraan kotoa käsin.

Toivomme sinulta:

- alan koulutusta tai muuta soveltuvaa koulutusta, kuten metalli- tai sähköalan koulutusta

- aikaisempaa kokemusta kaluston / koneiden huolto- ja korjaustehtävistä

- hydrauliikan ja mekaniikan tuntemusta

- B-ajokorttia (C-ajokortti katsotaan eduksi)

- hitsaustaitoa tai halukkuutta tarvittaessa oppia


Tarjoamme sinulle:

- pitkäaikaisen työsuhteen, joka alkaa sopimuksen mukaan

- säännöllisen työajan arkisin kello 7-15:30 (ei päivystyksiä)

- työsuhteen yrityksessä, jossa aidosti arvostetaan työntekijöitä ja tuetaan ammattitaidon kehittymistä aktiivisesti

- kilpailukykyisen palkan osaamisesi mukaan

title: Kundskapsledningsexpert (Borgå)
description:
**Östra Nylands välfärdsområde söker en KUNSKAPSLEDNINGSEXPERT för en visstidsanställning för tiden 1.10.2026 – 31.12.2027. Arbetet placerar sig i början vid enheten för digitala tjänster inom koncern- och strategitjänsterna, i teamet för kunskapsbaserad ledning och analytik.**

Enheten för digitala tjänster erbjuder ICTtjänster och ansvarar för utvecklingen av digitala tjänster inom hela välfärdsområdet. Du arbetar i teamet för kunskapsbaserad ledning och analytik tillsammans med andra experter inom digitala tjänster och verksamheten.

Vårt team ansvarar för välfärdsområdets kunskapsbaserade ledning, datalagret och rapporteringslösningarna. Datalagret tar emot data från flera olika patient och kunddatasystem samt bl.a. från ekonomi och personaladministrativa system.

Som kunskapsledningsexpert fungerar du som huvudanvändare för datalagret samt för andra teknologier för kunskapsbaserad ledning. Du säkerställer att datalagerlösningen betjänar välfärdsområdets behov, är nationellt kompatibel och leverantörsoberoende. Du deltar i modelleringen av datalagrets data samt i att producera, utveckla och upprätthålla rapportering. Datalagret är ett Azure Databricks-datalager och rapporteringen genomförs med Power BI. Modelleringen görs med SQL- och Pythonspråk.

Datagrunden består av kund- och patientuppgifter, ekonomiförvaltningens uppgifter, personalförvaltningens uppgifter samt andra uppgifter som är väsentliga med tanke på välfärdsområdets verksamhet. Huvuddelen av uppgifterna har modellerats enligt medaljongarkitekturen. Som expert inom kunskapsbaserad ledning förstår du data och hur data kan utnyttjas för att uppnå organisationens mål. Du är med och definierar informationsbehov tillsammans med ledningen och genomför dem via datalagret till rapporterna.

Din centrala uppgift är att utveckla utnyttjandet av datalagerlösningen och produktiviteten tillsammans med vårt team. Datagrunden ska framöver möjliggöra utvecklingen av analytik, maskininlärning och artificiell intelligens samt förbättra produktiviteten och kvaliteten i välfärdsområdets tjänster. Den exakta arbetsbeskrivningen formas enligt den valda personens kompetensområden.

Företagshälsovården handhas av Mehiläinen. Vi erbjuder också möjlighet att arbeta på distans enligt överenskommelse.

**Behörighetskrav:**

- En högskoleexamen som lämpar sig för uppgiften

- Som språkkrav krävs utmärkta muntliga och skriftliga kunskaper i det ena inhemska språket och goda muntliga kunskaper i det andra


**Vi förväntar oss dessutom:**

- Arbetserfarenhet av datalagerlösningar och/eller av att utnyttja stora datamängder i arbetet

- God samarbetsförmåga och erfarenhet av självständigt arbete inom kunskapsbaserat ledning, rapportering eller ICTutveckling och underhåll


**Vi uppskattar:**

- arbetserfarenhet och kunskaper av kunskapsbaserade ledningens uppgifter

- förmåga att lära sig snabbt

- kännedom om nationella riktlinjer för kund och patientdata inom social och hälsovården

- kunskaper i Azure Databricks, Power BI, SQL- och Pythonspråk


Anställningsvillkoren följer VÄLKA. Arbetet är dagarbete och veckoarbetstiden är 36 h 15 min. Den uppgiftsrelaterade lönen är 4290,9 euro/mån samt eventuella tillägg. Prövotiden är sex månader. Sökanden måste ge sitt samtycke till att en säkerhetsutredning genomförs.

Skicka in din ansökan senast 4.10.2026 kl. 23:59. Mer information ges av kunskapsledningschef Mervi Makkonen, tfn 040 152 8109 tai mervi.makkonen@itauusimaa.fi

Vid tillsättandet av uppgiften beaktas i första hand de anställda som sagts upp av produktionsmässiga och ekonomiska skäl inom Östra Nylands välfärdsområde, förutsatt att de uppfyller behörighetskraven för uppgiften.

title: Control Software Engineer (Embedded Software)
description:
We are looking for a Control software engineer (embedded) for our client.

Youll contribute to:
- Developing advanced control solutions for electrical energy systems, power converters, and industrial drives.
- In this role, you will work at the intersection of embedded software development, power engineering, power electronics and control systems.

What Were Looking For:
We are looking for person with combination of two following expertise areas. Knowledge / experience in both categories is mandatory but position is suitable also for freshly graduated person when background matches.

1) Knowledge of embedded software engineering
a. Must have: 
- Experience in C, C++, Python
- Knowledge of Git version control
- Basic understanding of SW testing methods

b. Seen as an asset: 
- Experience in unit testing, HIL testing, continuous integration
- Knowledge of Azure DevOps, Jenkins, static code analysis
- Embedded SW development in large organizations with multiple teams

2) Knowledge of control engineering in context of electrical power engineering:
- Knowledge of some of following application areas: Power conversion, Solar power systems, Battery energy storage systems, Wind power applications, Microgrids and smart grids
- Understanding concepts of inverters, rectifiers, DC/DC converters, switching power supplies
- Designing of control loops. stability and dynamic performance analysis, understanding feedback and feedforward control principles.

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have hands-on experience developing embedded software in C or C++? *
 - Do you have practical knowledge or experience designing, implementing, or tuning control loops, including feedback/feedforward control and stability or dynamic-performance analysis?*
- Do you have knowledge or practical experience with power electronics and power conversion systems, such as inverters, rectifiers, DC/DC converters, or electrical drives? *
- Do you have experience using Python and Git in software development, testing, simulation, or automation? *
- Do you have experience or academic project experience applying embedded software and control engineering to electrical energy systems (e.g., power converters, solar, battery storage, wind, microgrids, or industrial drives)? *

title: Automekaanikko / autonasentaja
description:

Työtehtäviin kuuluu henkilöautojen huolto ja korjaus, vikojen diagnosointi ja vianmääritys sekä erilaisten mekaanisten ja sähköisten komponenttien tarkastaminen, korjaaminen ja vaihtaminen. Työtehtäviin voi kuulua muun muassa:

- autojen huolto- ja korjaustyöt

- mekaanisten vikojen selvittäminen ja korjaaminen

- ajoneuvojen vianmääritys ja diagnostiikka

- jarru-, alusta-, ohjaus- ja muiden kuluvien osien huolto ja vaihto

- sähköisten ja elektronisten vikojen selvittäminen

- varaosien asentaminen ja vaihtaminen

- ajoneuvojen teknisen kunnon tarkastaminen

- korjaamotyökalujen ja -laitteiden käyttö

- muut autokorjaamon päivittäiset työtehtävät.

Tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisesti autojen parissa ja kehittämään ammattitaitoasi. Aikaisempi työkokemus automekaanikkona tai autonasentajana on tehtävässä tärkeää.

title: Design Engineer, Coctio Oy, remote work /Joensuu / Main capital area
description:
About the role

In this role, you wont just be sitting behind a screen; you'll have a broad impact on the entire process. Working within an expert network, about half of your working time will be spent on machine design—further developing our current products and new equipment, such as pressure vessels and hygienic solutions. Roughly a fifth of your work consists of customer-specific engineering, which includes technical problem-solving, defining equipment specifications, component selection, and managing procurement processes. The remainder of your role involves managing subcontracting and projects. You can primarily work remotely if you wish, but the role requires visiting our production center in Joensuu about once a month, as well as global travel—from Vietnam to the Americas. The final job description will be tailored based on the selected candidate's experience and expertise.

You are offered
- An opportunity to work in a growing and innovative company
- Flexible working arrangements
- A chance to influence product development and the strategic direction of the company
- An international work environment with travel opportunities

Work tasks
- Design and development of industrial food processing equipment and systems
- Management of production schedules and collaboration with external subcontractors
- Review and approval of technical requirements for components
- Procurement and component purchasing activities
- Identifying customer needs, solving technical problems, and ensuring customer satisfaction
- Design and drafting work using Creo software
- Domestic and international customer visits as part of project implementation

We are looking for

- A suitable degree in engineering (Bachelors or Masters level)
- Experience in mechanical or process design, preferably related to food machinery or industrial equipment
- Proficiency in design software (e.g., SolidWorks or Creo)
- Fluent spoken and written English, and good proficiency in Finnish
- Willingness to travel internationally a few times per year

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
- You have good project management and communication skills
- You work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously
- You have experience working with external subcontractors and suppliers
- You have a customer-oriented mindset and strong problem-solving abilities

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Telecom Core Network Expert (PS Core / CS Core)
description:
This is a temporary, project-based assignment supporting a leading telecom consultancy in a mobile core network performance audit. The role is ideal for an experienced consultant, freelancer, or senior telecom professional looking for an interesting short-term engagement with high-impact work.

We are looking for a Senior Telecom Core Network Expert to join a demanding international network audit project through Barona IT Talent.

About the Assignment

You will support a team conducting a comprehensive audit of a mobile operator's core network environment. Your role is to act as a senior subject matter expert, helping identify bottlenecks, analyze root causes, and provide concrete technical recommendations.

The project is expected to start during October and run for approximately two months. The work can be performed primarily remotely, with potential limited travel if required.

We are open to finding:

- One expert with both PS Core and CS Core expertise,
- or Two specialists covering the respective domains separately.

Responsibilities

Depending on your area of expertise, your work may include:

PS Core Network Audit

- Auditing GPRS/EPC core network architecture and performance Analyzing SGSN, MME, GGSN, SGW and PGW performance
- Assessing interfaces, capacity, redundancy and security
- Evaluating DNS and IP backbone implementations
- Reviewing legacy and cloud-native core deployments
- Investigating alarms, faults, logs and performance KPIs
- Analyzing user mobility and session management performance

CS Core Network Audit

- Auditing Circuit Switched Core architecture and topology
- Assessing MSC, MGW, HLR, HSS and related core elements
- Reviewing traffic routing principles and signalling performance
- Analyzing capacity, utilization and service quality KPIs
- Evaluating virtualized and legacy core implementation
- Supporting fault analysis and network optimization recommendations

You will work closely with experienced audit professionals while providing expert guidance throughout the analysis and reporting phases.

What We Are Looking For

We expect you to have:

Extensive experience with mobile core networks (2G/3G/4G/5G environments)

- Strong expertise in either PS Core, CS Core, or both
- Knowledge of both legacy and virtualized/cloud-based core network architectures
- Proven ability to identify network issues, bottlenecks and performance challenges
- Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities
- Previous experience in telecom consulting, auditing, or operator network assessments
- Ability to work independently and provide actionable recommendations
- Professional-level English communication skills
Experience working directly with mobile operators is considered a strong advantage.

What We Offer

- Flexible remote working model
- Collaboration with leading telecom experts
- An interesting, specialist-level project assignment
- Possibility to participate in similar future assignments based on project needs and performance
Interested?

Submit your CV and wanted information to our candidate database as soon as possible. We review candidates continuously and aim to identify suitable specialists quickly.

More information arja.martikainen@barona.fi

title: Project Manager, Industrial projects
description:
Do you want to lead industrial investment projects that contribute to a safer, more efficient and more sustainable future?
We are looking for experienced Project Managers to join Swecos growing industrial projects organisation.
In this role, you will manage demanding multidisciplinary industrial projects from project development and engineering through implementation, commissioning and handover. Your projects may follow EPCM or similar delivery models and can include a broad range of industrial investments, such as process industry and data centre projects.
At Sweco, you will work closely with clients, contractors, system and equipment suppliers, designers and Swecos multidisciplinary project organisation. You will have the opportunity to take responsibility for impactful projects while being supported by a strong network of experts.
The role may require travel within Finland and, depending on the project, internationally.
What helps you succeed in this role
You have a relevant technical degree (BSc, MSc or equivalent engineering qualification) and at least five years of experience in demanding industrial project delivery. This is not a discipline-specific project management role: you have experience leading broad, multidisciplinary project organisations and coordinating interfaces across engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning.
You are able to manage the overall delivery of a complex industrial project, including scope, schedule, budget, risks, reporting and stakeholder collaboration. You can coordinate several technical disciplines and delivery partners, identify and resolve interface issues, and keep the project moving forward towards its objectives.
We expect you to have:
- At least five years of relevant experience in industrial project management or project delivery.
- Demonstrated experience in leading multidisciplinary industrial projects during the implementation phase; experience with EPCM or similar industrial project delivery models is an advantage.
- Understanding of industrial project development, engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning.
- Strong stakeholder-management, communication and collaboration skills.
- Fluent written and spoken English; proficiency in Finnish and/or Swedish is an advantage.

What we offer you
- A curious, courageous and supportive Sweco community. At Sweco, we work together with a low hierarchy and a strong culture of trust. You will be surrounded by experienced colleagues who are ready to share their knowledge, challenge ideas constructively and support you when needed.
- Meaningful and influential projects. You will lead projects that support the renewal of industry and contribute to a more sustainable society. Our work has a concrete impact on the environment where people live, work and move.
- Opportunities to grow and shape your career. We support your professional development through demanding assignments, peer support and the learning opportunities provided by Sweco Academy.
- Flexibility for a balanced everyday life. We believe that work and life should support one another. We combine office-based and remote work flexibly according to the needs of the project and the team. As this is a client- and project-driven leadership role, regular on-site work and travel are expected.
- Comprehensive employee benefits. You can tailor parts of your benefits package to suit your individual needs.

Interested?
Please submit your application via the link provided by Monday, 19 October 2026. We review applications and start initial discussions already during the application period, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Ville Mykrä

title: Service Engineer
description:
**Location: Vantaa, Finland**

At ADB SAFEGATE, we are shaping the future of airport performance. Our solutions help airports operate more safely, efficiently, and sustainably — from aircraft approach to gate departure.

To strengthen our service team in Finland, we are looking for a motivated and hands-on **Service Engineer** to support our customers with advanced airport technology solutions.

**Your Mission**

In this role, you will be an important part of our technical team, ensuring that mission-critical airport systems are commissioned, maintained, and supported to the highest standards.

You will:

- Perform servicing, preventive maintenance, commissioning, and diagnostics of ADB SAFEGATE hardware and software systems, both on-site and remotely.

- Maintain and update technical documentation.

- Provide technical expertise and support to our customers.

- Collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders while independently taking ownership of assigned tasks.

- Conduct on-site surveys and prepare technical reports.

- Represent ADB SAFEGATE professionally in all customer interactions.


**Your Profile**

We are looking for a practical, ambitious, and reliable professional who enjoys solving technical problems, working directly with customers, and taking ownership in an international environment.

**Required qualifications**

- A degree or professional qualification in Electrical Engineering, Automation Technology, Computer Science, IT, or a comparable technical field.

- Hands-on experience with electrical, automation, control, or industrial IT systems, including confidence in using technical tools, test equipment, and diagnostic software.

- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify faults across hardware, software, electrical, and control systems.

- Practical experience with low- or medium-voltage equipment and the ability to read electrical drawings and wiring diagrams.

- Professional working proficiency in Finnish and English, with the ability to communicate technical information clearly to customers and international colleagues.

- Willingness to travel up to 30%, including occasional short-notice assignments. Some commissioning and service activities may take place outside standard working hours.

- A valid Category B driving licence and willingness to travel independently to customer sites.

- Ability to manage assigned service and commissioning tasks independently while collaborating effectively with international engineering, project, and customer support teams.

- Strong customer-facing communication skills and the ability to provide professional technical support, guidance, and updates.

- A proactive and responsible approach, with strong quality awareness, customer focus, and ownership of assigned tasks.


**Preferred qualifications**

- Previous experience as a Field Service Engineer, Commissioning Engineer, System Engineer, Service Technician, or in a similar customer-facing technical role.

- Experience with airport systems, airfield lighting, industrial infrastructure, or other safety- or operationally critical systems.

- Practical knowledge of PLC systems, switchgear, control equipment, and industrial automation.

- Experience administering and troubleshooting Windows and/or Linux operating systems.

- Working knowledge of SQL databases, including basic diagnostics, queries, and system support.

- Familiarity with scripting or programming languages used for diagnostics, configuration, automation, or system integration, such as Python, Bash, batch scripting, C#, or JavaScript.

- Experience with cloud-connected systems, remote monitoring solutions, networking, or remote support tools.

- A relevant Finnish electrical safety qualification. Candidates who are eligible and willing to obtain the required qualification may also be considered.

- Knowledge of other European languages.


**What We Offer**

At **ADB SAFEGATE**, you will join an innovative industry leader where your work directly contributes to safer and smarter airport operations worldwide.

**We offer:**

- A role in a global company setting benchmarks in airport safety, efficiency, and technology.

- A dynamic work environment with challenging and meaningful projects.

- International cooperation with experienced colleagues and customers.

- Flat hierarchies, open communication, and modern working models.

- The friendly atmosphere of a medium-sized company combined with the strength of a global organization.

- Opportunities for personal development, technical training, and professional growth.

- Opportunities to work on customer projects in Finland and across Europe.

- A varied, practical, and engaging role where no two days are the same.


**Ready to Help Airports Move Smarter?**

If you are passionate about technology, enjoy hands-on fieldwork, and want to be part of an international team delivering critical airport solutions, we would like to hear from you.

**Join ADB SAFEGATE and help shape the future of safe, efficient, and sustainable airport operations.**

In this role, you will be the analytical backbone for senior commercial leads and project managers across high-stakes energy deals. Your day-to-day focus will center on hands-on quantitative work, building and running diverse Excel models for investment calculations, deal valuations, and complex partnership structures. You will analyze broad commercial cases - ranging from long-term PPAs and joint ventures to corporate structures and M&A activities and translate your findings into clear presentations for decision-makers. Rather than working in a static setup, you will navigate a fast-moving, agile environment where project priorities evolve quickly. This position is an ideal next step for an ambitious analyst with some experience from transaction advisory, investment banking, or consulting who enjoys quantitative modeling and wants to apply their skills directly inside an industry leader.

You are offered
You will work on high-stakes commercial cases presented directly to executive leadership while receiving close guidance and support from experienced senior professionals. The position offers strong long-term career advancement and internal mobility within the company, along with a balanced hybrid work model including a few remote days per week.

Work tasks

This role focuses on providing quantitative support and financial modeling for large-scale energy projects and strategic business developments.
- Supporting senior leads on large-scale customer and partnership deals
- Building detailed Excel models for investment calculations, valuations and contract structures
- Performing market and corporate finance analysis for joint ventures and M&A projects
- Turning quantitative data into clear slides and presentations for management and clients
- Utilizing AI tools (e.g., Copilot) to speed up analysis and reporting

We are looking for

- University degree in Finance, Economics or a related field
- Some experience in analyst roles (e.g., from consulting, advisory, corporate finance, or M&A)
- Strong Excel skills for hands-on financial modeling and investment calculations
- Solid foundation in Corporate Finance principles and valuation methods
- Strong quantitative abilities and comfort working with complex data
- Ability to present and explain financial findings clearly to stakeholders
- Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken)

Please note that a security clearance will be conducted for the chosen candidate, and any offer of employment is conditional upon a successful security clearance check.

It is meritorious if you have
- Good knowledge of Finnish or Swedish
- Familiarity with the energy industry or large-scale infrastructure investments
- Background in Corporate Finance studies
- Experience with asset or portfolio optimization analysis

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
- Detail-oriented and structured
- Change-oriented
- Stress tolerant
- Proactive
- Collaborative
- Intellectually curious

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Project Director, Industrial projects
description:
Are you ready to lead complex industrial investment projects that shape a safer, more efficient and more sustainable future?
We are looking for experienced Project Directors to join Swecos growing industrial projects organisation.
In this role, you will lead demanding multidisciplinary industrial projects from early project development through execution and handover. Your projects may follow EPCM or similar delivery models and can include a broad range of industrial investments, such as process industry and data centre projects.
As a Project Director, you will take overall responsibility for the successful delivery of large and demanding industrial investment projects, or broader project portfolios. You will lead the project at a strategic and commercial level, from early project development through execution, commissioning and handover.
We are looking for senior professionals with strong experience in leading project delivery, building high-performing project organisations and working closely with clients and partners. At Sweco, you will have the opportunity to make a tangible impact on major industrial investments together with leading experts across disciplines.
The role may require travel within Finland and, depending on the project, internationally.
What helps you succeed in this role
You have a relevant technical degree (BSc, MSc or equivalent engineering qualification) and 10+ years of experience in senior project leadership roles. You have a proven track record of successfully delivering industrial investment projects and strong experience in EPCM, PMC, Owner's Engineering or similar industrial project delivery environments.
You are an experienced project leader with the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, build and develop high-performing project organisations, and manage complex interfaces across engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning. You are comfortable leading large project organisations, managing schedules, budgets, risks and commercial matters, and working effectively with clients and diverse stakeholders.
You communicate and negotiate confidently in English; Finnish and/or Swedish skills are an advantage.
Experience from projects within process industries, energy, manufacturing, mining, chemicals and data centres is particularly valued.
What we offer you
- A curious, courageous and supportive Sweco community. At Sweco, we work together with a low hierarchy and a strong culture of trust. You will be surrounded by experienced colleagues who are ready to share their knowledge, challenge ideas constructively and support you when needed.
- Meaningful and influential projects. You will lead projects that support the renewal of industry and contribute to a more sustainable society. Our work has a concrete impact on the environment where people live, work and move.
- Opportunities to grow and shape your career. We support your professional development through demanding assignments, peer support and the learning opportunities provided by Sweco Academy.
- Flexibility for a balanced everyday life. We believe that work and life should support one another. We combine office-based and remote work flexibly according to the needs of the project and the team. As this is a client- and project-driven leadership role, regular on-site work and travel are expected.
- Comprehensive employee benefits. You can tailor parts of your benefits package to suit your individual needs.

Interested?
Please submit your application via the link provided by Monday, 19 October 2026. We review applications and start initial discussions already during the application period, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
For more information about the role, salary or working at Sweco, please contact:
Ville Mykrä
ville.mykra@sweco.fi
Please submit your application through the application form. Due to GDPR requirements, we do not process or store job applications sent by email.

title: Lähihoitaja, sosiaalihuollon resurssiyksikkö, Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue
description:
Haemme ammattitaitoisia ja motivoituneita lähihoitajia varahenkilöstöön toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen vammaispalveluun, mielenterveys- ja päihdepalvelut sekä vanhuspalveluun. Tarvitsemme tiimiimme joustavia ja sopeutuvia ammattilaisia, jotka pystyvät tukemaan yksiköitämme äkillisissä sijaistarpeissa.

Varahenkilönä työskenteleminen on monipuolista ja vaihtelevaa. Se tarjoaa loistavan mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistaan ja laajentaa kokemusta eri työympäristöissä. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää joustavuutta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä kykyä toimia sekä itsenäisesti että osana tiimiä.

Odotamme, että sinulla on aikaisempaa työkokemusta alalta ja osaamista asiakastyöstä sekä kuntoutuksesta. Erityisesti arvostamme positiivista ja iloista asennetta sekä hyviä yhteistyötaitoja.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Esimiehen täyden tuen ja hyvät työtoverit
- Mahdollisuuden kehittyä monipuolisessa työssä
- Joustavat työajat ja työskentely-ympäristön, joka tukee hyvinvointiasi ja ammatillista kehittymistäsi.

Jos sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaidot, positiivinen asenne ja intoa työskennellä eri ihmisryhmien kanssa, voit olla etsimämme henkilö. Odotamme innolla hakemustasi!

Tervetuloa osaksi tiimiämme!


Kelpoisuusvaatimus:
Lähihoitajan tutkinto tai terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun asetuksen (564/1994) tai valtioneuvoston sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilöistä antaman asetuksen (153/2016) mukainen tutkinto.
Tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito maamme molemmissa kansalliskielissä

Valitulla tulee olla voimassa tartuntatautilain (1227/2016) 48 § mukainen rokotussuoja. Lisäksi valitun tulee esittää rikosrekisterilain 6 § 2. mom. tarkoitettu ote rikosrekisteristä.

Sovelletaan koeaikaa.

title: Auraaja
description:
Haemme auraajia talvikaudelle Helsingin ja Vantaan alueella sijaitseviin omiin asiakaskohteisiimme.

Työ on kutsuttaessa tehtävää lumenaurausta. Työvuorot määräytyvät sää- ja lumiolosuhteiden mukaan, joten kuljettajalta edellytetään hyvää tavoitettavuutta ja valmiutta lähteä töihin tarvittaessa myös aikaisin aamulla, öisin ja viikonloppuisin.

title: Project Procurement Manager
description:
Join us in building a sustainable society powered by clean energy and reliable connections! We are now looking for Project Procurement Manager in Helsinki or Rauma. The position can also be based in any of our other offices in Finland. We offer flexible hybrid working opportunities.

As a Project Procurement Manager, you play a critical role in ensuring successful project delivery. You are responsible for planning and executing procurement activities throughout the project lifecycle, from customer tendering and project kick-off to final delivery and close-out.

Working closely with project teams, category management, suppliers, and business stakeholders, you ensure that projects have the right suppliers, materials, subcontractors, and services available at the right time, cost, and quality. Through proactive procurement leadership, supplier management, and risk mitigation, you contribute directly to project profitability, schedule performance, delivery reliability, and customer satisfaction.

Tasks and responsibilities:
* Lead end-to-end procurement planning and execution
* Act as the main procurement contact for project stakeholders
* Manage sourcing processes (supplier selection, RFQs, negotiations, contracts)
* Ensure optimal total cost of ownership and savings
* Monitor supplier performance and manage supplier issues, claims, and onboarding
* Build and maintain key supplier relationships
* Oversee purchase orders, deliveries, and logistics
* Ensure accurate procurement data in ERP systems
* Identify and mitigate procurement risks
* Ensure compliance with policies, contracts, and regulations
* Maintain proper documentation and audit trails
* Integrate ESG and sustainability into sourcing decisions and promote responsible supplier practices

Requirements:
* Relevant degree (e.g. Supply Chain, Business, Engineering)
* 5+ years of procurement experience in project-based environments
* Strong negotiation, analytical, and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution
* Fluent in English and Finnish

Are you up for the challenge? Come and create the best customer experiences with us!

The application period ends on 11.10.2026. However, please send your application as soon as possible, as we may begin interviews during the application period and fill the position once the right candidate is found.

title: Service Desk Technician
description:
**Service Desk Technician**

JOB PURPOSE

Serve as the first point of contact for Curium employees and partners worldwide, providing timely, high-quality technical assistance through the Global Service Desk. Log, diagnose, resolve and/or escalate incidents and service requests in line with agreed SLAs, while contributing to knowledge and continuous service improvement.

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE ROLE

- Provide first-line support via Freshservice, phone, chat and email; ensure accurate ticket creation and lifecycle updates.

- Troubleshoot and resolve incidents related to end-user devices, operating systems, Microsoft 365, collaboration tools and approved business applications.

- Fulfil service requests (software installation/configuration, access requests, equipment requests) following standard procedures and security policies.

- Support user onboarding/offboarding: account setup coordination, workstation readiness, and user guidance on core tools and security best practices.

- Use remote support tools to assist users; collaborate with local IT/field services when hands-on intervention is required.

- Escalate complex issues to the appropriate resolver groups (workplace, network, server, security, applications) with clear diagnostics and evidence.

- Create and maintain knowledge base articles, procedures and troubleshooting guides; contribute to reducing repeat incidents.

- Maintain accurate asset and user device records in Freshservice and ensure data quality for reporting and compliance.

- Communicate clearly and professionally with users, providing status updates and setting expectations throughout the resolution process.

- Participate in shift coverage and (where applicable) on-call/major incident support according to the Global Service Desk operating model.

- Backfill the field service desk technician on request.


WHAT YOU NEED FOR THIS POSITION

**Must have Experience/Skills:**

- Bachelor's degree in IT (or equivalent professional experience).

- 2+ years in a Service Desk / IT support role in an international environment.

- Demonstrated experience working with ITSM processes (Incident, Request, Knowledge) and SLAs.

- Strong troubleshooting skills on Windows and common end-user hardware/peripherals.

- Good knowledge of Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

- Familiarity with identity and access concepts (Active Directory / Entra ID), MFA and basic security hygiene.

- Experience with remote support tools and endpoint management basics (Intune / Autopilot / SCCM) is advantageous.

- Basic networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, WiFi, VPN, connectivity troubleshooting).

- Excellent customer service mindset; ability to prioritize and work under time pressure.

- Fluent in Finnish and English (written and spoken); additional languages are a plus.


**Nice to have Experience/Skills:**

- Hands-on experience with Freshservice (or equivalent ITSM tool) including knowledge article creation.

- ITIL Foundation certification or practical ITIL experience.

- Experience supporting Teams telephony / conferencing room equipment.

- Exposure to regulated environments (GxP) and validated processes.

title: Perhefutiksen ja kerhojen ohjaaja

title: Training Coordinator
description:
The Wärtsilä Land & Sea Academy (WLSA) is responsible for delivering high-quality learning services to customers and employees around the world. Our training portfolio supports Wärtsilä's innovative technologies and solutions across the marine and energy sectors, helping customers develop the skills needed for a more sustainable future.


We are now looking for an enthusiastic Training Coordinator to join our Training Coordination team in Vaasa, Finland. Whilst we offer hybrid working, the operational nature of our business often requires attendance on site, and occasional flexibility outside normal working hours may be required.

In this role, you will be at the heart of our global training operations, working closely with customers, instructors, sales teams, and business stakeholders to ensure an outstanding learning experience from initial enquiry to training completion. You will combine customer service, operational coordination, digital tools, and continuous improvement to deliver successful training programmes that create value for our customers and Wärtsilä.


If you enjoy working in an international environment, building strong relationships, and coordinating multiple activities simultaneously, this could be your next career opportunity.



What will you be doing?


As a Training Coordinator, you will manage and coordinate the end-to-end training delivery process while ensuring a seamless customer experience.


Your responsibilities will include:


Training Operations



* Coordinate training delivery activities at the Vaasa Training Centre and other assigned learning environments.
* Manage course scheduling, participant registrations, notifications, reporting, and training documentation.
* Maintain training records and related data in SAP, Learning Management Systems, and other digital platforms.
* Coordinate resources (instructors, classrooms, workshop) allocation.
* Support training delivery and help resolve operational challenges quickly and effectively.
* Monitor customer feedback and identify opportunities to improve services and processes.



Customer and Business Support


* Support the planning, promotion, and execution of training activities for internal and external customers.
* Create and maintain training offerings and service packages.
* Collaborate with sales, account management, contract management, and business stakeholders to promote learning solutions.
* Support internal and external communication activities related to training services.


What will help you succeed?



We are looking for someone who combines strong coordination skills with a passion for customer service and continuous improvement.


You will ideally have:



* A Bachelor's or Master's degree, or equivalent relevant work experience.
* Experience with Learning management systems (LMS), training administration, learning operations, customer service, project coordination, or a similar role.
* Experience working with SAP and Salesforce would be considered an advantage.
* Strong digital skills and confidence in learning new systems and technologies.
* Excellent, organisational and multitasking abilities. You will be adept at coordinating evolving requirements and will frequently need to adapt to factors outside your control.
* A structured and detail-oriented way of working.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* A proactive mindset and ability to identify and implement improvements.
* Ability to work under pressure and prioritise tasks effectively. You will be empowered to make decisions within your scope to advance your workload.
* A customer-focused approach and commitment to delivering high-quality service.
* Fluent English skills, both written and spoken.
* Finnish language skills are considered an advantage.


Why join us?


At Wärtsilä Land & Sea Academy, you will become part of a global learning organisation that plays a key role in developing the competencies needed for the future of energy and marine industries. We believe that great results come from empowered people. We encourage ownership, accountability, and collaboration, creating an environment where individuals can contribute, develop, and make a meaningful difference.


As part of our global learning organisation, you will work alongside experienced professionals in a culture built on respect, inclusion, and continuous learning. We value openness, encourage new ideas, and see challenges as opportunities to improve. Everyone is encouraged to bring their authentic self to work and contribute their unique perspective.


We particularly appreciate candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and commitment to professional growth. Experience gained across different functions, projects, or disciplines is highly valued, as it helps us build agile teams capable of supporting a diverse and evolving business environment.

- Monipuoliset autoalan työtehtävät
