If the successful candidate does not have sufficient mastery of a Scandinavian language, equivalent to B2 level, the candidate will be required to learn sufficient Norwegian within  three years of employment.

Desired qualifications:

  • Candidates should be able to establish, lead and conduct research projects, also as a collaborator. A track record in scientific and administrative leadership is an advantage.
  • International network, outreach activities, collegiality, and the ability to create a good working environment will be part of the evaluation.
  • The person appointed will be requested to take on some administrative duties. Hence such experience will be an advantage.

All candidates and projects will have to undergo a check versus national export, sanctions and security regulations. Candidates may be excluded based on these checks. Primary checkpoints are the Export Control regulation, the Sanctions regulation, and the national security regulation.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to create and contribute to a well-functioning, inclusive and productive research environment
  • Networking skills, ability to collaborate and conduct scientific leadership
  • Ability to cooperate and communicate well with other members of staff

The successful candidate should have an international profile with respect to the above criteria. The candidate for this position will be selected based on excellence and fit with the section’s research profile.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Associate Professor (position code 1011) in salary range NOK from 750 000 - to 880 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, two % is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund. 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at 
u io.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

We especially encourage women to apply.
If you have an i mmigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

We hope that you will apply for the position.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.  


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Application letter
  • A research position paper (1–4 pages) describing the applicant’s vision and scientific ambitions for the near future
  • A detailed CV, including a complete list of education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative management, project acquisition and coordination experience, and other qualifying activities.
  • Copies of educational certificates, PhD diploma, transcript of records and letters of recommendation
  • A complete list of publications and academic merits and awards (if not included in the CV)
  • Full text of up to 10 selected scientific publications the applicant wishes to include in the evaluation
  • A document discussing the importance, interrelation, and relevance of the selected papers for this position
  • Educational portfolio of 3–6 pages documenting educational competence and experience, including a reflection note in which your own teaching practice and view of learning is anchored in the SoTL framework (focus on student learning, development over time, a researching approach and a collegial attitude and practice) 
  • List of reference persons: 2–3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

As a general rule an interview will be used in the appointment process, usually supplemented with a trial teaching session. The basis for assessment will be the scientific production of the applicant, the teaching portfolio, pedagogical and educational qualifications, the applicant’s qualifications within leadership and administration, other qualifications as well as general personal suitability for the position. In ranking the competent applicants, the full range of qualifications will be considered and explicitly assessed.

title: Virksomhetsleder Miljø og samferdsel
description:
Vil du lede en virksomhet med ansvar for samferdsel, kommunal infrastruktur og offentlige rom?

Ålesund kommune søker en tydelig og utviklingsorientert virksomhetsleder for Miljø og samferdsel. Vi ser etter deg som vil lede en kompleks og viktig virksomhet med ansvar for forvaltning, myndighetsutøvelse, drift og utvikling innen samferdsel, kommunal infrastruktur og offentlige rom.

Virksomheten har ansvar for forvaltning, myndighetsutøvelse, planarbeid, drift, vedlikehold og utvikling innen samferdsel og kommunal infrastruktur. Ansvarsområdet omfatter blant annet kommunale veger, gang- og sykkelveger, parkeringsplasser, broer, kaier, trapper, parker, grøntområder, friområder, byrom, lekeplasser, offentlige toaletter og enkelte idrettsanlegg. Vinter- og sommerdrift er en sentral del av oppgavene. Virksomheten planlegger og gjennomfører også utviklingsprosjekter på kommunal veg og i offentlige rom, og følger opp kommunens ansvar i Bypakke Ålesund.

Som virksomhetsleder får du et helhetlig ansvar for fag, økonomi, personell og utvikling. Du skal videreutvikle en organisasjon med bredt ansvarsområde, sikre god drift og kvalitet, og bidra til samhandling på tvers av fagmiljø og samarbeidspartnere.

Virksomheten har tre avdelinger i dag:

  • Forvaltning
  • Drift
  • Prosjekt

Stillingen inngår i kommunalområde Samfunn, og du blir en del av ledergruppen. Sammen har ledergruppen ansvar for å videreutvikle og profesjonalisere kommunens tjenester.

Kommunens omdømme skapes av dyktige medarbeidere som hver dag bidrar med kompetanse, engasjement og samfunnsansvar på ulike arenaer.

 


Arbeidsoppgaver

Du vil blant annet få ansvar for:

  • å lede og videreutvikle virksomheten i samsvar med kommunens mål og prioriteringer.
  • å sikre forsvarlig drift, forvaltning og myndighetsutøvelse innen virksomhetens ansvarsområder.
  • økonomi, budsjett, rapportering og ressursbruk innenfor vedtatte rammer.
  • å bidra til god gjennomføring av store investerings- og utviklingsprosjekter.
  • å følge opp kommunens ansvar i Bypakke Ålesund og andre samarbeidsprosjekter.
  • å legge til rette for medvirkning, kompetanseutvikling og et godt arbeidsmiljø.
Kvalifikasjoner

Vi ønsker at du har:

  • høyere utdanning på bachelor- eller masternivå innen tekniske tjenester, samferdsel, ingeniørfag eller andre relevante fagområder.
  • ledererfaring med ansvar for økonomi, personell og fag.
  • erfaring fra kommunal sektor.
  • erfaring med organisasjonsutvikling, endringsarbeid eller komplekse drifts- og forvaltningsmiljø.
  • god forståelse for økonomistyring og offentlig forvaltning.

Det er en fordel med erfaring fra samferdsel, kommunalteknikk, drift av infrastruktur, prosjektgjennomføring eller andre relevante tekniske tjenester.

Personlige egenskaper

Vi søker deg som:

  • er en tydelig og samlende leder.
  • har god gjennomføringsevne og evne til å prioritere.
  • kombinerer strategisk blikk med operativ forståelse.
  • bygger tillit og skaper gode samarbeidsrelasjoner i organisasjonen, med politikere og med innbyggere og næringsliv.
  • er utviklingsorientert og motiveres av et viktig samfunnsoppdrag.
  • har gode samarbeidsevner, tydelig kommunikasjon og endringskompetanse.
Vi tilbyr
  • en sentral lederstilling med stor samfunnsmessig betydning.
  • ansvar for en virksomhet med høy faglig kompetanse og viktige utviklingsoppgaver.
  • mulighet til å påvirke utviklingen av kommunens samferdselsløsninger, infrastruktur og offentlige rom.
  • samarbeid med sterke fagmiljø og støttefunksjoner innen innkjøp, HR, kommunikasjon, juridiske tjenester og økonomi.
  • lønn etter avtale.

Ålesund kommune er den største kommunen mellom Bergen og Trondheim, og et regionsenter for Nordvestlandet. Kommunen har rundt 58.000 innbyggere. Området rundt byr på rike muligheter for et aktivt friluftsliv for alle, jakt og fiske, og kommunen har et rikt og blomstrende kultur- og næringsliv. title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Algal Microbiome Engineering
employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
description:
The position

At the Norwegian College of Fishery Science, Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics (BFE) at UiT The Arctic University of Norway, there is a vacant position as a postdoctoral researcher affiliated with the Microalgae & Microbiomes Research Group. The position is for a fixed term of 3 years. It is a prerequisite that the applicant can carry out the project over the full course of the employment period. No person may hold more than one fixed term position as a Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the same institution.

The postdoctoral project focuses on programmable marine microbiomes and mechanistic interactions within the diatom phycosphere, with particular emphasis on synthetic biology, microbial ecology, and molecular interactions between marine microalgae and associated bacteria. The successful candidate will contribute to the development of experimental model systems for studying metabolite exchange, microbial community interactions, and engineered microbial consortia in marine environments.

The position is affiliated with ongoing research activities in marine microbiology, synthetic biology, and systems biology at UiT. The research combines microbiology, molecular biology, microbial cultivation, genome-informed molecular ecology, synthetic biology, and multi-omics approaches to better understand and engineer marine microbial ecosystems relevant to carbon cycling and marine biotechnology.

As a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, you will have the opportunity to advance your scientific career and further qualify for academic positions. If you do not already have the educational competence that meets the requirements for an Associate Professor position in Norway, UiT will arrange such competence during the employment period.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. You must be able to start in the position within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.


The project/position's field of research

The postdoctoral researcher will develop and apply experimental approaches for studying mechanistic interactions between marine microalgae and associated bacterial communities within the diatom phycosphere. The project will focus on the development of programmable and experimentally tractable microbial model systems using synthetic biology, microbial cultivation, and molecular biology approaches.

The successful candidate will work with cultivation and engineering of marine bacteria and microalgae, construction of synthetic microbial consortia, and investigation of microbial metabolite exchange relevant to nutrient cycling and carbon fixation in marine ecosystems. The project may also involve transcriptomics, genomics, metabolomics, and bioinformatics analyses to investigate molecular interactions between diatoms and associated microorganisms.

The position is part of a broader research program focused on programmable marine microbiomes, marine microbial ecology, and biotechnology applications relevant to climate resilience, sustainable aquaculture, and marine carbon cycling. The postdoctoral researcher will work in an interdisciplinary and international research environment and is expected to contribute actively to scientific publications, collaborative research activities, and external funding development.

You must submit a project proposal (max 2 pages) that describes how you scientifically can contribute to designing diatom phycosphere communities through the uses of engineered genetic circuits or other synthetic biology tools. The proposal should include your view on the state-of-the-art and opportunities for achievable but ground-breaking science with regards to engineering microbial consortia and non-traditional synthetic biology hosts. The proposal must include a progress plan.


Contact

For further information about the position, please contact Group Leader Hans Christopher Bernstein:

  • email: hans.c.bernstein@uit.no 

 or the Head of Department Bjørn Petter Finstad: 

  • email: bjornpetter.finstad@uit.no 

Qualifications

Required qualifications: 

  • A Norwegian doctoral degree or an equivalent foreign doctoral degree recognized as equivalent to a Norwegian PhD in microbiology, molecular biology, biotechnology, synthetic biology, marine biology, microbial ecology, systems biology, chemical engineering, bioengineering, or another relevant discipline. If you're in the final stages of your PhD, you may still apply for the position, provided that you submit parts of your dissertation along with your application. This enables the evaluation committee to assess the quality and likelihood of completion by the desired employment date. You must include a statement from your supervisor or institution stating the expected completion date for your PhD degree. Documentation of your completed PhD degree must be submitted before commencement.
  • Excellent written and oral English language skills. Nordic applicants can document their capabilities by attaching their high school diploma.
  • Documented experience in experimental microbiology, molecular biology, and scientific publishing, including publication of research in peer reviewed international journals. Experience in one or more of the following areas is required:
    • synthetic biology
    • microbial cultivation
    • marine microbiology or marine microbial ecology
    • microalgae research
    • molecular cloning and genetic engineering
    • microbial ecology
    • microbial co-cultivation systems

Desired qualifications: 

  • Experience working with non-model microorganisms and/or developing molecular tools for environmental microorganisms is considered particularly advantageous.
  • Experience with one or more of the following areas is considered an advantage:
    • microbial genomics, transcriptomics, or metagenomics
    • bioinformatics and analysis of omics datasets
    • metabolomics or analytical chemistry
    • microbial community analysis
    • programming/scripting in R, Python, or similar languages
    • systems biology or computational biology
  • Knowledge of a Scandinavian language or willingness to learn Norwegian is considered an advantage.

The successful candidate must be able to work independently and as part of an interdisciplinary research team. Emphasis will also be placed on motivation, potential for research, scientific creativity, organizational skills, communication abilities, and personal suitability for the position.

In the assessment the main emphasis will be attached to the submitted works and the project proposal for the qualifying work. Emphasis shall also be attached to experience from popularization/dissemination and academic policy and administrative activity.

At UiT we put emphasis on the quality, relevance and significance of the research work and not on where the work is published, in accordance with the principles of The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA).


Inclusion and diversity  

UiT The Arctic University i Norway is working actively to promote equality, gender balance and diversity among employees and students, and to create an inclusive and safe working environment. We believe that inclusion and diversity is a strength, and we want employees with different competencies, professional experience, life experience and perspectives.  

If you have a disability, a gap in your CV or immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box for this in your application. If there are qualified applicants, we invite least one in each group for an interview. If you get the job, we will adapt the working conditions if you need it. Apart from selecting the right candidates, we will only use the information for anonymous statistics. 


We offer
  • Involvement in an interesting research project 
  • Good career opportunities 
  • A good academic environment with dedicated colleagues  
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement  
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

More practical information for working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility 


Application

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information submitted by the application deadline via Jobbnorge. It is therefore important that you include all necessary documents demonstrating your qualifications for the position.

Your application must include:

  • Application letter
  • Project proposal (max 2 pages)
  • CV
  • Diplomas and transcripts (all degrees)
  • Documentation of English proficiency
  • Contact information to 2-3 references
  • Documentation of educational competence, if available
  • Description of your academic production, stating which works you consider most important
  • The academic works (published or not) you wish us to take into consideration in the assessment

If you're in the final stages of your PhD, you may still apply for the position, provided that you submit parts of your dissertation along with your application. This enables the evaluation committee to assess the quality and likelihood of completion by the desired employment date. You must include a statement from your supervisor or institution stating the expected completion date for your PhD degree. Documentation of your completed PhD degree must be submitted before commencement.

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. If English proficiency is not documented in the application, it must be documented before starting in the position. 


Assessment

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications based on the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description draw up for the position. A copy of the assessment report will be sent to all applicants. 

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview should among other things, aim to clarify the applicant’s motivation and personal suitability for the position. A trial lecture may also be held.


General information

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants. 

The remuneration for Postdoctoral research fellow is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1352 with a gross annual salary ranging from NOK 650'-760' (in a 100% position). (In special cases, a higher salary may be considered.) A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. You will become a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which gives you many benefits in addition to a lifelong pension. Read more about your employee benefits at: spk.no.

The successful candidate must be willing to get involved in the ongoing development of their department and the university as a whole.

UiT wishes to promote gender equality. If two or more applicants are found to be equally qualified, the university will rank applicants from the underrepresented gender ahead of others.

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is a multi-campus research university and the northernmost university of the world. Our central location in the High North, our broad and diverse research and study portfolio, and our interdisciplinary qualities make us uniquely suited to meet the challenges of the future. At UiT you can explore global issues from a close-up perspective.

Credibility, academic freedom, closeness, creativity and commitment shall be hallmarks of the relationship between our employees, between our employees and our students and between UiT and our partners. 

The Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics (BFE) consists of Department of Arctic and Marine Biology, Norwegian College of Fishery Science (NFH) and School of Business and Economics.The main task of BFE is to conduct teaching and research dissemination at a high national and international level within all relevant fields. Prioritized research areas are aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems, climate, life in the arctic, marine bioprospecting, fish health, seafood products, business and macroeconomics, resources and environment, markets and management of marine resources. The interdisciplinary profile of the faculty provides good opportunity to develop research projects involving several research groups at the faculty according to its strategy.

Experience from pub food, casual dining, à la carte or high-volume kitchens is a strong advantage.

title: Service Engineer- SeaQ Control
description:
VARD Electro is shaping the future of shipbuilding through advanced electrical, automation and integrated technology solutions. Through our SeaQ portfolio, we support our customers worldwide with reliable, intelligent systems that enhance safety, connectivity, and operational performance at sea.

Our Service Department is expanding, and we are looking for a Service Engineer in the SeaQ Control field to join us! SeaQ Control is VARD Electro's automation platform for monitoring and controlling vessel systems. The solution integrates alarm, monitoring and control functions and plays a key role in the safe and efficient operation of advanced vessels worldwide. You will join a specialized and collaborative environment where different disciplines come together to deliver cutting-edge solutions for the global maritime industry.

At VARD we care about nurturing talents and embracing diverse strengths, giving everyone the opportunity to develop and grow. Join us and be part of a community that celebrates your skills, and where together we are shaping the future of shipbuilding. 


Ready to make an impact at VARD?


Duties and responsibilities

As a Service Engineer, you will play a key role in the commissioning and service of our SeaQ Control systems delivered to customers worldwide. You will work hands-on with advanced automation and control systems, both on board vessels and in-house, contributing to projects that ensure safe and efficient vessel operations.
Your responsibilities will include troubleshooting and maintenance activities, and providing technical assistance to customers and colleagues. You will also participate in factory testing, reporting, and other in-house support activities.
This position involves extensive travel, and we are looking for someone who thrives in dynamic environments, enjoys solving technical challenges, works well independently, and has a strong customer-focused mindset.

Qualifications
  • Technical background/education within Automation (Technician Level/ Bachelor/ Master)
  • Experience from commissioning, service, troubleshooting or maintenance of automation and control systems
  • Strong competence in PLC, HMI, SCADA, industrial networks and instrumentation

 

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above. 

This employment may require a background check, or security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority.

Personal qualities
  • Strong technical understanding and interest 
  • Good troubleshooting and analytical skills
  • Customer-oriented mindset and professional communication skills
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian and English
  • Ability to work both independently and in a team
  • Norwegian driver's license
  • Identify yourself with the VARD values Craftmanship, Salesmanship and Fellowship.
Our commitment to you 
  • A good working environment with exciting and important tasks in an international environment 
  • Competitive pension scheme and insurance package 
  • Subsidized lunch in the office canteen 
  • Subsidized membership at the gym 
  • Occupational health service 
  • Free mobile phone usage 
  • Central office location and free parking
  • Geographical / rotation flexibility
  • We understand the importance of continuous learning and we strive to give you the chance to gain new skills and further develop your career

 

VARD recognizes the importance of having fun at work, this is why with VARD Social you will have the chance to bond with colleagues through new experiences and shared interests. The social offer varies throughout the year and includes activities like 'walk and talk' during lunch hours, fjord cruises, cooking lessons, go karting, football practices and wine tasting, just to name a few. 

With the right blend of fun, expertise and hard work, we are creating ships for the future. Join us!

title: Vil du være med å skape trygghet på veiene?

Hvem vi søker

Vi er en sammensatt gjeng med ulik bakgrunn, erfaring og utdanning. Har du erfaring fra bransjen, er det en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det viktigste for oss er at du tar sikkerhet på alvor og forholder deg til gjeldende regler og rutiner som bidrar til at alle kommer trygt hjem hver dag. En jobb hos oss innebærer et viktig ansvar for sikkerheten til både kolleger, trafikanter og andre som ferdes på og langs norske veier.

  • Jobber strukturert og nøyaktig, med høyt fokus på sikkerhet og dokumentasjon.
  • Er fleksibel når det gjelder arbeidstid og kan jobbe både dag, kveld og natt
  • Er praktisk og teknisk anlagt
  • Trives med en fysisk arbeidshverdag som innebærer å stå/gå/løfte utstyr

 

Vi kan tilby 

  • Konkurransedyktig lønn etter tariff
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø og gode kollegaer som har det morsomt sammen på jobb
  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter internt i Ramudden, lokalt og nasjonalt
  • En fleksibel arbeidshverdag som passer godt for deg som trives med varierte arbeidstider
  • 30-60 % stilling

 

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Vi gleder oss til å få flere nye kolleger med på laget, og håper du er en av dem!

Ta gjerne kontakt om du skulle ha noen spørsmål.

Selskapet har hovedkontor i Gävle i Sverige, og består av over 70 avdelinger i 13 land fordelt på 2 kontinenter. Konsernets misjon er å bringe folk hjem trygt hver dag (To get people home safely every day). Ramudden i Norge har vokst siden starten i 2009 og spesielt etter 2015. I dag består selskapet av 13 forskjellige avdelinger fra Steinkjer i nord til Lindesnes i sør. Vi er drøyt 500 medarbeidere og omsetningen nærmer seg 500 millioner kroner, med store ambisjoner om å vokse enda mer. Ramudden leverer sikkerhetstjenester i og rundt veinettet og på byggeplasser i Norge, blant annet rådgivning, utleie av sikkerhetsutstyr, opplæring av personell, og tjenesteleveranser som f.eks. montering av utstyr og trafikkdirigering.

title: PhD Position in Long-term Climate Governance
description:
PhD Position in Long-term Climate Governance

Oslo Business School at Oslo Metropolitan University (OsloMet) invites applications for a temporary position as PhD scholar in long-term climate governance. The position is connected to the ERC-funded research project CAMELOT – Capacities for More Effective Long-term Climate Governance and is expected to start in April 2027.

The position is three years full-time but can be extended to four years if teaching assignments are included. The PhD Research Fellow will be based in the academic unit Public Administration and Governance at Oslo Business School and will be enrolled in OsloMet's PhD programme in Social Sciences, specialization Business Administration, Innovation and Governance (BIG).

The successful candidate is expected to complete the doctoral degree during the period of employment.


About CAMELOT

Many of today's most consequential governance challenges, including climate change and Earth system risks, unfold over decades, centuries, or longer. Yet political institutions and decision-making processes often struggle to engage effectively with such long-term futures.

CAMELOT investigates the capacities that enable individuals, groups, and institutions to think about and govern for the long term. The project develops new theory on long-term governance capacities and studies whether and how such capacities can be strengthened through experimental and participatory research. It brings together insights from political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, futures studies, psychology, and related fields.

CAMELOT is a five-year research project funded by a European Research Council (ERC) Consolidator Grant and led by Associate professor Manjana Milkoreit at OsloMet.

CAMELOT project website


About the PhD project

The PhD scholar will develop an independent research project that contributes to CAMELOT's overarching objective of understanding and strengthening capacities for long-term climate governance.

The project should be theoretically informed and empirically grounded and involve original empirical research designed and conducted by the PhD candidate. The research may build on, extend, or enable comparisons with research undertaken elsewhere in CAMELOT, but should not depend on data collection undertaken in other parts of the project.

We welcome innovative proposals addressing questions related to long-term governance capacities. Possible research directions include, but are not limited to:

  • investigating how narratives and stories about long-term climate futures influence imagination, understanding, attitudes, decision-making, or other capacities relevant to long-term governance
  • examining how engagement with long-term climate futures differs across climate risks, Earth system tipping elements, audiences, social groups, professional communities, or political and cultural contexts
  • studying how scenarios, foresight, simulations, serious games, or other futures-oriented interventions affect capacities for anticipatory and long-term governance
  • developing and evaluating educational or professional interventions designed to strengthen capacities for engaging with long-term climate futures
  • investigating whether and under what conditions changes in long-term governance capacities translate into changes in reasoning, decision-making, or action

Applicants are encouraged to propose original research questions and approaches that extend beyond these examples while demonstrating a clear connection to CAMELOT's overarching research agenda.

A range of methodological approaches may be appropriate, including quantitative, qualitative, experimental, and mixed-methods research. The proposed research must be feasible within the period of employment.

The candidate will conduct their own research while working closely with the CAMELOT team. They will benefit from interaction with CAMELOT's theoretical, experimental, and participatory research and may develop complementary or comparative studies building on concepts, methods, interventions, or findings developed within the project.


Qualification requirements

We are looking for candidates who meet the following requirements:

  • master's degree of 120 ECTS or equivalent in political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, sociology, psychology, futures studies, science and technology studies, human geography, or another field relevant to the position
  • grade of B or better on both the master's thesis and the master's degree overall, or an equivalent academic record
  • demonstrate knowledge of research methods relevant to the proposed PhD project
  • strong analytical and academic writing skills
  • excellent written and spoken English

Candidates who are close to completing their master's degree may apply, provided that the degree is completed before the start of the position.

It will be an advantage

It will be considered an advantage to have knowledge of or previous research experience related to one or more of the following areas: climate or environmental governance; public policy; long-term or anticipatory governance; futures and foresight; environmental or political psychology; narratives and communication; Earth system risks and tipping points; or experimental and intervention-based social science.

Experience with empirical data collection and analysis, participation in research projects, academic publishing, or interdisciplinary research will also be considered an advantage.

General criteria for employment as a Research Fellow are stipulated in the Regulations relating to the Universities and University Colleges Act. 

Admission to the doctoral program is a prerequisite. Admission to the doctoral program is based on a comprehensive assessment of the application, including the relevance and quality of the project description. A finalized project plan for the employment period is required completed and acknowledged within 3 months from the date of employment.

See information about admission criteria to the PhD-programme.

It is important for OsloMet to reflect the diverse and multicultural populationof our region, and all qualified candidates are welcome to apply. We make active endeavors to further develop OsloMet as an inclusive workplace and to adapt the workplace if required. If there are periods where you have not been in work or have been studying or in training, you are also welcome to apply.


We offer

The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary and international research environment working at the intersection of climate governance, public policy, futures research, and the social sciences.

The position offers:

  • exciting job tasks at Norway’s third largest university
  • opportunities for academic development in a professional research environment
  • three-year full-time position with 100% salary; possibility to extend to 4 years with teaching duties
  • beneficial pension arrangements with the Norwegian State Pension Fund

title: Researcher in Applied Mineralogy
description:
About the position and project

The Natural History Museum (NHM) at the University of Oslo invites applications for a two-year, full-time position as a Researcher in applied mineralogy and industrial mineral exploration. The position will be based in the Department of Research and Collections, within the Norwegian Centre for Mineralogy Research Group. The position is part of the innovation industry-research project “PureQ – The Future of the High-Purity Quartz Value Chain for Improved Yield, Quality and Sustainability”, funded by the Research Council of Norway.

The successful and highly motivated candidate will have a strong publication record and demonstrated experience with modern, advanced microanalytical techniques for mineral characterisation, particularly of quartz. Relevant expertise includes crystal chemistry and microtextural characterisation. Experience in mineral exploration, especially geochemical exploration and drill-core logging, is also desirable.


Qualifications requirements 

Required qualifications:
•    A PhD in geology or mineralogy
•    Demonstrated ability to conduct elemental microanalysis using LA-ICP-MS, including data processing and interpretation
•    A recent publication record relevant to the subject area of the position
•    A strong upward academic trajectory

The successful candidate must demonstrate mastery of English as working language. Proficiency in Norwegian is an advantage.

Desirable qualifications:
•    Familiarity with a range of microanalytical and spectrometric techniques used for mineral analysis besides LA-ICP-MS, such as SEM, EPMA, and CL


Personal qualities
  • High motivation to work at the interface between academia and industry
  • Ability to meet project reporting deadlines consistently 
  • Willingness to travel frequently within Norway and abroad as part of the project
  • Ability to create and contribute to a well-functioning, inclusive, and productive research environment
  • Ability to cooperate and communicate well with other staff members
  • Strong networking skills and the ability to collaborate and communicate effectively

The successful candidate should have an international profile with respect to the above criteria. The candidate for this position will be selected based on excellence and fit with the section’s research profile.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • A professionally stimulating work environment
  • Building networks within the national geoscience and mineral industry sectors
  • Onboarding program for new employees
  • Good welfare schemes, in addition to Oslo´s family-friendly environment with its rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities 
  • Salary in position as Researcher (position code 1109) in salary range NOK from 620 000 to 720 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

Application

Your application should include:

  • Application letter
  • CV
  • A complete list of publications
  • Transcripts and certificates
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to  Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Rules for the use of research posts SKO 1108, 1109, 1110 and 1183 at UiO.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Natural History Museum at the University of Oslo is Norway’s most comprehensive natural history collection. For almost 200 years, specimens of animals, fungi, plants, rocks, minerals and fossils have been collected, studied and preserved here. The museum is located at Økern and in the beautiful Botanical Garden, which is not only popular for recreation, but is a scientific collection in itself.

title: PhD Research Fellow in fairness in artificial intelligence
description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in fairness in artificial intelligence, available at the Department of Informatics, in the Scientific Computing and Machine Learning (SCML) research group.

Starting date as soon as possible/by agreement. The fellowship period is three (3) years.

Depending on the candidate and the teaching needs of the department, the fellowship period can be extended either for compulsory work consisting of e.g., teaching and supervision duties and research assistance up top four years.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is the Department of Informatics at Blindern, Oslo. 


Project description

The PhD fellow will be affiliated with the Scientific Computing and Machine Learning (SCML) research group at the Department of Informatics and supervised by associate professor Anne-Marie George.

We are looking for a motivated and academically strong candidate to work on a project within fairness in artificial intelligence and machine learning. The candidate will investigate how to formally define, measure and reconcile different, at times conflicting, notions of fairness in AI systems, as well as the theoretical relationships between them.

Possible directions for the project include (the final scope will be developed together with the candidate, and it is not necessary to cover all topics):

  • Group fairness: developing and analysing algorithms and metrics for ensuring fair treatment of groups defined by protected attributes (e.g. gender, age, ethnicity, …).
  • Theoretical relations between fairness notions: studying the mathematical relationships, trade-offs, and impossibility results connecting different fairness definitions.
  • Intersectional fairness: exploring fairness guarantees for combinations of multiple protected attributes, and addressing the challenges of subgroup fairness, such as computational complexity, statistical reliability and data sparsity for fine-grained subgroups.

What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in informatics/computer science, mathematics, statistics, or a closely related field. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Documented competence in machine learning at Master level
  • Documented programming skills
  • Minimum three documented mathematics or statistics courses with passing grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English

Candidates without a master’s degree have until 30.11.2026 to complete the final exam.

Desired qualifications:

  • Programming experience, e.g. in Python, particularly for machine learning
  • Experience with machine learning theory, evaluation metrics, algorithmic fairness, statistics, or optimization is an advantage

  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:
The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. For more information see:
http://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/

title: Can you combine structured project delivery with a practical understanding of manufacturing and factory operations?
description:
Bergen Engines is entering an important phase of factory development and production ramp-up. To support this, we are strengthening the Special Projects team with one to two Project Managers who can lead cross-functional initiatives and help turn our operational ambitions into practical, executable projects. Reporting to the Head of Special Projects, you will work closely with Manufacturing, Assembly, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, HSE, Facilities and Finance. The project portfolio is expected to include assembly-capacity and ramp-up initiatives, factory layout and material-flow improvements, tooling and facility investments, CAPEX projects and other operational-improvement activities required to increase manufacturing capability towards 2028.     Your key responsibilities
  • Define project scope, objectives, deliverables and success criteria.
  • Develop and maintain credible project plans covering milestones, resources, costs and dependencies.
  • Coordinate cross-functional project teams and ensure clear ownership of actions.
  • Identify and manage project risks, issues, changes and key decisions.
  • Maintain accurate forecasts and escalate constraints or decisions early.
  • Support business cases, investment requests and CAPEX governance where applicable.
  • Work directly with factory teams to understand constraints and implement practical solutions.
  • Drive projects relating to capacity, throughput, assembly flow, material readiness, layout, tooling and process improvement.
  • Provide concise and transparent progress reporting to project sponsors and relevant governance forums.
  • Ensure that projects are delivered safely, on time, within approved cost and with measurable operational benefits.
  • Coordinate effective handover of completed projects into the responsible operational organisation.
Who are we looking for?  We are looking for people who combine structured project delivery with a practical understanding of manufacturing and factory operations. You may already work as a Project Manager, or you may have led substantial projects or workstreams within Manufacturing, Assembly, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Facilities or another relevant area.   Your qualifications: 
  • Education within technical fields and knowledge of manufacturing. If you have particularly long and relevant experience the education requirement may be disregarded. 
  • 8-10 years of experience from related role.
  • Experience from planning and delivering cross-functional projects or significant work packages.
  • A good understanding of complex engineering or manufacturing environments.
  • The ability to convert broad objectives into clear actions, milestones and accountabilities.
  • A practical and visible approach, including working directly with teams on the factory floor.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of project costs, benefits and priorities.
  • A strong commitment to safety, quality and sustainable operational improvement.
  • Clear written and verbal communication.
  • Fluent skills in both writing and orally in English and preferably also in Norwegian.
Knowledge of Bergen Engines’ products, manufacturing processes, assembly operations and internal systems will be an advantage. A formal project-management or relevant technical qualification is beneficial, but a demonstrated record of successful delivery is equally important.   Your personal characteristics
  • Ability to work independently towards goals. 
  • A good team player. 
  • Good cooperative and communicative skills. 
  • Structured and analytical. 
  • Curious and outgoing, not afraid to ask questions and suggest improvements. 
  • The confidence to challenge constructively, resolve obstacles and escalate decisions when necessary.
  • Strong coordination and stakeholder-management skills.
 

Why choose Bergen Engines?

For more than 80 years, Bergen Engines has delivered world-class power and propulsion systems to customers around the globe. Today, we're playing a key role in the maritime industry through innovative and efficient engine technology.

From our headquarters in Bergen, Norway, we work closely with customers worldwide, combining Norwegian engineering expertise with international reach. As part of the Langley Holdings Power Solutions Division, we're investing in growth, new markets, and the people who will help drive our future success.

These positions offer an opportunity to:
  • Contribute directly to Bergen Engines’ future manufacturing capability.
  • Lead visible projects with tangible operational impact.
  • Work across multiple functions and broaden your business experience.
  • Help shape how strategic factory projects are planned, governed and delivered.
  • Develop further within project management and operational leadership.

 

What we offer:

  • At Bergen Engines, you'll have the opportunity to work with advanced technology, international customers and colleagues who are passionate about what they do.
  • Meaningful work that contributes to a more sustainable future.
  • An international environment with exciting growth opportunities.
  • Professional and personal development in a technology-driven company.
  • Competitive salary and company-wide bonus scheme.
  • Flexible working hours and strong work-life balance.
  • Excellent pension and insurance arrangements.
  • Company cabin at Kvamskogen and employee discount programs.
  • Active sports clubs and social activities.
  • Occupational health services.
  • A highly skilled team that supports and challenges each other.

 

Are you ready to join our team?

At Bergen Engines, you'll join one of Norway's leading industrial technology companies and help deliver the power solutions that keep the world moving.

Work location is our headquarters and production facility at Hordvikneset, approximately 20 km north of Bergen city centre.

The position reports to Head of Special Projects- Nanda Kishore. 

For questions please contact: Nanda per mobile +4748286461 or e-mail nanda.kishore@bergenengines.com

Application deadline: 20.09.2026. Applications will be reviewed continuously.


Bergen Engines bygger og utvikler medium speed-motorer til landbaserte anlegg og til applikasjoner i den maritime næringen. title: Cost Estimator HVAC
description:
At VARD, we create innovative and sustainable solutions for the global maritime industry. Combining engineering excellence, cutting-edge technology, and strong teamwork, we design and build some of the world’s most advanced vessels.

At the same time, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We foster an inclusive and supportive environment where talents can grow, ideas are valued, and individuals are empowered to make an impact.

Vard Interiors is a leading supplier of turnkey interior, insulation, piping, and HVAC-R solutions for the maritime industry. As part of the VARD value chain, we work closely with shipowners, designers, and shipyards to create functional, sustainable, and high-quality onboard environments. With a strong focus on innovation, craftsmanship, and customer value, we help bring some of the industry’s most advanced vessels to life.

We are currently looking for a Cost Estimator HVAC to join our team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to apply your expertise, collaborate with skilled colleagues, and contribute to exciting projects across the VARD value chain.

Ready to make an impact at VARD?


Duties and responsibilities
  • Prepare and maintain cost estimates for products, services, and ship interior projects.
  • Analyze drawings, specifications, RFQs and other project documentation.
  • Identify and quantify materials, labour requirements and other project cost drivers.
  • Develop and maintain project calculations and technical proposals.
  • Collaborate with engineers, suppliers, customers and subcontractors to clarify project requirements.
  • Monitor actual costs against estimates and support cost control throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Maintain and continuously improve cost databases and estimation tools.
  • Participate in site visits and gather relevant information to support cost assessments.
Qualifications
  • Relevant higher education, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Knowledge of shipbuilding processes, materials and project costing.
  • Experience from the interior and/or HVAC industry is an advantage.
  • Technical understanding and commercial awareness.
  • Excellent Excel and general software skills.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken

 

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above. 

This employment may require a background check, or security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority.

Personal qualities
  • Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to problem-solving.
  • Able to maintain focus and perform effectively under pressure.
  • Adaptable and flexible in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  • Proactive and committed to delivering high-quality work.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.
  • Identify yourself with the VARD values Craftmanship, Salesmanship and Fellowship.
Our commitment to you
  • A good working environment with exciting and important tasks in an international environment 
  • Competitive pension scheme and insurance package 
  • Subsidized lunch in the office canteen 
  • Subsidized membership at the gym 
  • Occupational health service 
  • Flexible work from home policy 
  • Free mobile phone usage and subsidized internet at home 
  • Central office location and free parking
  • We understand the importance of continuous learning and we strive to give you the chance to gain new skills and further develop your caree

VARD recognizes the importance of having fun at work, this is why with Social by VARD you will have the chance to bond with colleagues through new experiences and shared interests. The social offer varies throughout the year and includes activities like 'walk and talk' during lunch hours, fjord cruises, cooking lessons, go karting, football practices and wine tasting, just to name a few. 

With the right blend of fun, expertise and hard work, we are creating ships for the future. Join us! 

ContactsGunnar Bratland, Vice President Sales, +47 91 80 00 50
LocationPostvegen 2
6018 Ålesund

Reference number: 5181679888
Percentage of full-time: 100%
Regular
Application deadline: 31/10/2026

Vard Interiors AS is a specialized company for interior, insulation, piping, and HVAC-R installation in Vard Group AS. Our company is present in VARD shipyards in Norway, Romania, and Vietnam. We have also established a subsidiary in Romania.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

We are looking for reliable, positive and flexible people who are ready to contribute during a busy and exciting hotel season.

You enjoy working with people, take responsibility and understand the importance of excellent guest service.

Good spoken and written English is required for all positions. Norwegian is a significant advantage, particularly for reception, supervisory and other guest-facing roles.

Relevant experience is required for supervisory and senior kitchen positions. For several other roles, motivation, reliability and the right attitude may be just as important as formal qualifications.

⚠️ RIGHT TO LIVE AND WORK IN NORWAY

All applicants must have the legal right to live and work in Norway throughout the agreed employment period.

Applicants from outside the EU/EEA must hold, or be eligible to obtain, the necessary Norwegian residence permit giving them the right to work in Norway. A residence permit issued by another European country does not automatically give a non-EU/EEA citizen the right to work in Norway.

EU/EEA citizens must comply with applicable Norwegian registration requirements.

Applicants are responsible for providing valid documentation before employment begins. No employee can start work without the necessary legal right and documentation.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

✨ A unique season in beautiful Hardanger

✨ A professional and international working environment

✨ Competitive pay based on experience and responsibility

✨ A proper Norwegian employment contract

✨ Training and support

✨ Staff accommodation available for rent, subject to availability

✨ Staff meal arrangements

✨ Opportunities to develop and return for future seasons

IMPORTANT AVAILABILITY INFORMATION

As we are a seasonal hotel, applicants must be available throughout the agreed employment period.

Employees should not expect to take holidays during the operating season. Any planned holiday or absence must be disclosed during recruitment and discussed and approved in accordance with Norwegian legislation and the hotel's staffing requirements.

HOW TO APPLY

Send your CV and a short application in English.

Please include:

• The position you are applying for

• Relevant experience and references

• Your English and Norwegian proficiency

• Confirmation of your availability for the season

• Confirmation of your legal right to live and work in Norway

• Your nationality and current residence/work permit status, where applicable

title: Konferanse
description:
Er du en stjerne på service som elsker når det skjer ting? 

Vi leter nå etter en Conference Host til teamet vårt på Norefjell Ski & Spa. Du blir ansiktet utad som sørger for at gjestene våre får en topp opplevelse, fra morgenens første kaffekopp til dagens siste presentasjon.

Hva du vil gjøre

Som Conference Host er du helten i møterommene våre. Dagene dine vil blant annet inneholde:

  • Ønske gjester velkommen og sørge for at de har alt de trenger for en god dag.
  • Gjøre klar rommene – du ser til at møbler, mat og teknikk er 100 % klart før gjestene kommer.
  • Løse teknisk krøll – hjelpe gjester med å koble til laptoper og se til at wifi og projektorer bare funker.
  • Være til stede – du er rett i nærheten for å fikse småting raskt, slik at møtet kan fortsette uten avbrudd.
  • Samarbeide – du jobber sammen med kjøkken og resepsjon for at alt skal flyte som det skal.
  • Hjelpe andre avdelinger ved behov

Dette er en midlertidig stilling på 70% med oppstart etter avtale. Stillingen krever varierte arbeidsskift, inkludert kvelder og helger.

Du vil trives hvis du

  • Elsker å hjelpe andre og holder humøret oppe selv når det er mye å gjøre samtidig.
  • Liker teknikk og ikke er redd for å flytte på en kabel eller starte en skjerm på nytt.
  • Snakker og skriver godt på skandinavisk språk slik at du kan forklare ting på en enkel måte for gjestene våre.
  • Har kontroll på detaljene – du merker med en gang om en stol står skjevt eller om kaffen må fylles på.
  • Du trives med å selge inn det lille ekstra på plass for at gjestene skal få et enda bedre opphold
  • Du har en utpreget serviceinnstilling 

Bonuspoeng for:

  • Om du har jobbet med event, hotell eller restaurant før.
  • Om du har kontroll på lyd, lys eller annen møteteknikk.

Vi verdsetter mangfoldet hos Strawberry. Ulike bakgrunner, erfaringer og ideer skaper et unikt og inspirerende arbeidsmiljø.

Hva vi tilbyr:

  • De rette verktøyene og støtten for å vokse både profesjonelt og personlig.
  • Personalrabatter og venner & familie-priser på våre 200+ hoteller.
  • 25 % rabatt på mat og drikke på alle våre restauranter og barer.
  • Gode avtaler på opplevelser, reiser, detaljhandel og mye mer!

    • 50 % rabatt på spabehandlinger

    • 30 % rabatt på spaprodukter.

    • Ansatte med 30% eller høyere stilling får personlig sesongkort fra Norefjell Skisenter.

Om oss

Vi er Strawberry. Et univers av hoteller, restauranter, spa og opplevelser over hele Norden, Litauen og Færøyene. Her samles Comfort Hotel™, Quality Hotel™, Clarion Hotel®, Home Hotel, Stopover, frittstående hoteller og våre fleksible poeng Spenn. Bak det hele: titusenvis av mennesker over hele verden, bygget på energi, mot og entusiasme.

title: Tilkallingsassistent søkes til BPA-team for latterfylt 15 åring
description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA
📅 Tiltredelse: Snarlig
📌 Stillingstype: Tilkalling

⏰ Arbeidstid: Natt og kveld


Lyst til å være tilkallingsassistent i BPA -team til en sprudlende 15 åring?

Jeg er en positiv og glad ungdom/barn som bor sammen med mamma, pappa og to kosete katter. Jeg søker en tilkallingsassistent som også må kunne jobbe ekstra i ferier. Det er viktig at du er komfortabel med mye fysisk trygghet, nærhet og kontakt. En av assistentene i teamet beskriver jobben som BPA slik: «Å være en del av BPA-teamet føles som å være hos sin egen familie - trygt, godt og fullt av latter hver eneste dag.»

Jeg elsker å bli lest for, høre på musikk og finne på ulike tøysete aktiviteter med assistentene. Jeg har litt tale og en digital snakkebok, men du trenger å bli kjent med meg for å forstå hva jeg ønsker å uttrykke. Siden jeg er alvorlig utviklingshemmet så trenger jeg at du er min støtte gjennom hverdagen i alle aktiviteter og gjøremål. Det er mye jeg klarer med din støtte og veiledning, og sammen med mine BPAer lærer jeg mer og mer.

Hva jobben innebærer:

• Være en støtte og trygghet gjennom dagen

• Bistå i hverdagen med personlig hygiene, påkledning og toalettbesøk

• Hente og levere på skolen

• Leke og være aktiv sammen med meg

• Passe på meg om kvelden når jeg sover

• Legge til rette for hvile og struktur i hverdagen

Vi ser etter deg som:

• Liker tull og tøys

• Er strukturert og ryddig – for det gir meg trygghet

• Erfaring fra helse, omsorg eller arbeid med barn er et pluss – men det aller viktigste er personlig egnethet og et varmt hjerte.

Stillingsstørrelse og arbeidstid:

Jeg søker etter en fleksibel tilkallingassistent som kan stille opp ved behov.

For meg er stabilitet og trygghet viktig, så jeg håper du ønsker å være en del av teamet mitt over tid - gjerne i flere år. Mamma og pappa vurderer søknader fortløpende og ansetter så snart de finner den rette personen.

Kvalifikasjoner:

• Førerkort klasse B. Det er en fordel om du har egen bil på grunn av begrenset kollektivtilbud, men det er ikke et krav

• Gode norskkunnskaper og norsk forståelse

• Plettfri vandel

• Du har et ønske og en motivasjon for å jobbe med barn

• Personlig egnethet og kjemi vektlegges

Ved spørsmål angående stillingen, kontakt rekrutterer Jenny Dolven på epost: jenny.dolven@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfylt jobb

  • Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 236,49,-, kveldstillegg på 67,- og helgetillegg på 70,-

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer, nettbutikker etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. Det er viktig for oss å kunne gi våre kunder den aller beste tjenesten og at vi er den beste arbeidsplassen for våre medarbeidere. Mio BPA er en del av Mio-konsernet som er 100 prosent norskeid.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

• Modig: Vi utgjør en forskjell for hvert enkelt menneske vi møter. Vi gir mennesker et bedre liv og frihet til å leve slik de vil.

title: Rådgjevar bedriftsmarknad - pao Voss
description:
Rådgjevar bedriftsmarknad - pao Voss

Likar du å arbeida med folk, økonomi og ha gode kundemøte?
Er du typen som ser ei oppgåve som må gjerast, og berre gjer det?
Då vil me gjerne høyra frå deg.

Voss Sparebank er ein sjølvstendig lokal sparebank med 28 tilsette.

Me kjenner kundane våre, me kjenner kvarandre – og me likar å gjera lokalsamfunnet til ein betre plass å bu og leva.

No ser me etter ein ny kollega som skal vera rådgjevar for bedriftsmarknaden
på Voss og nærområdet vårt.

Hjå oss får du ikkje berre kontorpult, stol og PC i moderne lokale.
Du får høve til å bli kjend med verksemdene i lokalsamfunnet, forstå kva dei driv med og vera ein viktig sparringspartnar når dei skal investera, utvikla seg eller ta nye steg.

Ingen dagar er like. Nokre dagar sit du fordjupa i ein kredittsak. Andre dagar er du ute og møter ein kunde, diskuterer investeringar over ein kaffikopp eller finn ut korleis me kan hjelpe ei lokal bedrift vidare.

Om du trivst med ansvar, relasjonar, tykkjer om samfunnsoppdraget vårt og likar at arbeidsinnsatsen din vert opplevd som meiningsfull. Då er dette kanskje ei stilling for deg?

Arbeidsoppgåver
Som rådgjevar på bedriftsmarknaden får du ansvar for eiga kundeportefølje.
Du vil mellom anna:
  • Rådgje og selja banken sine produkt og tenester til eksisterande og nye bedriftskundar – kreditt, forsikring, leasing, pensjon og sparing/plassering
  • Følgja opp og utvikla gode kunderelasjonar
  • Vurdera kreditt, utarbeida og presentera kredittsaker
  • Vera ein aktiv sparringspartnar for kundane våre og forstå behova deira
  • Oppsøkja nye kundar og byggja nettverk i næringslivet
  • Samarbeida med kollegaer i heile banken for å finne gode og heilskaplege løysingar
Kvalifikasjonar
  • Du har høgare utdanning innan økonomi.
  • Du er tidleg i karrieren, eller er nyutdanna.
  • Det er òg fint om du har interesse for, eller erfaring frå finans, rekneskap
    eller revisjon.
  • Du har interesse for lokalt næringsliv.
  • Du er god til å skriva nynorsk eller villig til å læra det.
  • Det er eit pluss om du har autorisasjonar frå FinAut.
    Om du ikkje har det, må du på sikt vera motivert for å gjennomføra autorisasjon i kredittfaget.
Personlege eigenskapar
  • Du likar å snakka med folk og skapa tillit.
  • Du er nysgjerrig på bedrifter, menneske og økonomi.
  • Du kan analysere tal, men også forstå menneska bak tala.
  • Du ser kva som må gjerast og tek i eit tak når det trengst.
  • Du trivst med kundekontakt og nettverksbygging.
  • Du er ein god kollega som ser dei rundt deg,
Me tilbyr
  • Mange gode og dyktige kollegaer og ein triveleg arbeidsplass.
  • Ei rådgjevarrolle med både ansvar og tillit.
  • Flotte og moderne lokale midt i Voss sentrum.
  • Eige treningsrom – fordi me trur det er viktig å ta vare på både hovudet og kroppen.
Om Voss
Her har du kort veg til fjell, ski, sykling, fjord og andre friluftsaktivitetar – samstundes som Voss har eit rikt idretts- og kulturliv gjennom heile året.
For deg som likar å vere aktiv, møte folk og ha naturen tett på, er Voss ein fin plass å både bu og jobba.

Om Voss Sparebank
Her kan du lesa meir om banken :
www.vossabanken.no

Spørsmål
Har du spørsmål om stillinga, ta kontakt med:
Leiar bedriftsmarknad Kurt Arild Midtun: 479 30 327
Banksjef Jørund Rong: 479 30 335

Ynskjer du å bli vår nye rådgjevar for bedriftsmarknaden på Voss, sender du ein kortfatta søknad med CV til Voss Sparebank på e-post: kam@vossabanken.no. (mrk: «Bedriftsrådgjevar» i emnefeltet) eller bruk søknadsskjemaet via "søk på stilling" knappen på denne siden.

Søknadsfrist er 20.09.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Voss Sparebank vart etablert i 1843.
Sidan starten og fram til i dag, har banken utvikla seg til ein moderne bank som tilbyr eit vidt spekter av produkt og tenester innanfor daglegbank, finansiering, sparing og forsikring.

title: 🏔️ WORK IN THE HEART OF THE NORWEGIAN FJORDS!
description:
🏔️ WORK IN THE HEART OF THE NORWEGIAN FJORDS!

Kinsarvik Fjordhotel, BW Signature Collection is recruiting an international team for the 2027 season.

📅 Season: 26 April--3 October 2027

📍 Kinsarvik, Hardanger, Norway

👥 20 seasonal positions available

WE ARE HIRING

🧹 HOUSEKEEPING

• 4 Housekeeping Attendants

• 1 Housekeeping Supervisor

🍳 KITCHEN

• 1 Breakfast Chef

• 1 Sous Chef / Head Chef

• 2 Chefs

🍽️ RESTAURANT & BAR

• 1 F&B Supervisor

• 5 Waiters

🛎️ RECEPTION

• 2 Receptionists

• 2 Night Receptionists / Night Auditors

Rotation for night team: one week on / one week off

🔧 MAINTENANCE

• 1 Maintenance Employee

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

We are looking for reliable, positive and flexible people who are ready to contribute during a busy and exciting hotel season.

You enjoy working with people, take responsibility and understand the importance of excellent guest service.

Good spoken and written English is required for all positions. Norwegian is a significant advantage, particularly for reception, supervisory and other guest-facing roles.

Relevant experience is required for supervisory and senior kitchen positions. For several other roles, motivation, reliability and the right attitude may be just as important as formal qualifications.

⚠️ RIGHT TO LIVE AND WORK IN NORWAY

All applicants must have the legal right to live and work in Norway throughout the agreed employment period.

Applicants from outside the EU/EEA must hold, or be eligible to obtain, the necessary Norwegian residence permit giving them the right to work in Norway. A residence permit issued by another European country does not automatically give a non-EU/EEA citizen the right to work in Norway.

EU/EEA citizens must comply with applicable Norwegian registration requirements.

Applicants are responsible for providing valid documentation before employment begins. No employee can start work without the necessary legal right and documentation.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

✨ A unique season in beautiful Hardanger

✨ A professional and international working environment

✨ Competitive pay based on experience and responsibility

✨ A proper Norwegian employment contract

✨ Training and support

✨ Staff accommodation available for rent, subject to availability

✨ Staff meal arrangements

✨ Opportunities to develop and return for future seasons

IMPORTANT AVAILABILITY INFORMATION

As we are a seasonal hotel, applicants must be available throughout the agreed employment period.

Employees should not expect to take holidays during the operating season. Any planned holiday or absence must be disclosed during recruitment and discussed and approved in accordance with Norwegian legislation and the hotel's staffing requirements.

HOW TO APPLY

Send your CV and a short application in English.

Please include:

• The position you are applying for

• Relevant experience and references

• Your English and Norwegian proficiency

• Confirmation of your availability for the season

• Confirmation of your legal right to live and work in Norway

• Your nationality and current residence/work permit status, where applicable

📧 Kitchen, Restaurant, Bar & F&B

Karolina@kinsarvikhotel.no

📧 Housekeeping, Reception & Night Team

GroT@kinsarvikhotel.no

📧 Maintenance

hr@kinsarvikhotel.no

Please write the position you are applying for in the email subject line.

Applications will be reviewed continuously.

💙 Come for the job. Stay for the people, the fjord and an unforgettable season!

Kinsarvik Fjordhotel, BW Signature Collection

Operated by Kinsarvik Hotelldrift AS

#KinsarvikFjordhotel #JobsInNorway #HotelJobs #SeasonalJobs #Hardanger #VisitNorway #HospitalityJobs #ChefJobs #HousekeepingJobs #ReceptionJobs #RestaurantJobs #WorkInNorway

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kinsarvik Fjordhotel, BW Signature Collection is a seasonal hotel located in beautiful Hardanger -- one of Norway's most spectacular fjord regions.

With 70 rooms, a restaurant, bar and conference facilities, we welcome guests from Norway and around the world. Our location offers an exceptional combination of fjords, mountains, waterfalls and outdoor experiences right outside the hotel.

We are an international and close-knit team where teamwork, responsibility and good guest service are important. Working with us is an opportunity to gain valuable hospitality experience, meet people from different countries and spend a memorable season in the heart of the Norwegian fjords.

Come to Norway for the experience -- and become part of our team in Hardanger.
