This position is based at the client's premises in Kista. This role requires onsite presence Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 17:00, or 7.30-16.30 depending on business needs. Occasional travel to other locations may be required.

title: Instrumentation Engineer – Project-Based Employment | Nevita | Nynäshamn
description:
Are you an experienced Instrumentation Engineer looking for a hands-on role in a complex process industry environment? Nevita is currently looking for an Instrumentation Engineer for an initial three-month project assignment at our client's site in Nynäshamn, with good opportunities for extension.

Your role

As an Instrumentation Engineer, you will work closely with operations, maintenance, engineering and other technical disciplines at an established process plant. The role combines engineering activities with practical, site-based support and is well suited to someone who enjoys working close to the plant and solving technical challenges in an operational environment.

Your responsibilities may include:

    

Engineering and technical support within instrumentation and control.

    

Working with P&IDs and translating process requirements into instrumentation solutions.

    

Selection and specification of instruments, control valves and associated equipment.

    

Working with pressure, flow, level and temperature measurement.

    

Reviewing I/O, instrument loops, datasheets and technical documentation.

    

Supporting modifications, upgrades and troubleshooting of existing installations.

    

Ensuring instrumentation solutions comply with applicable standards and requirements, including ATEX.

    

Coordinating with process, electrical, automation, maintenance and other engineering disciplines.

    

Supporting commissioning, testing, I/O checks and FAT/SAT activities when required.

    

Providing technical support to site activities, contractors and suppliers.

Your profile

We believe you have:

    

A technical degree in Instrumentation, Automation, Electrical Engineering or a related field.

    

Previous experience working with instrumentation in the process, petrochemical, refinery, energy or similar heavy industry.

    

Good understanding of P&IDs and industrial process systems.

    

Practical experience with instrumentation, I/O, loops, control valves and process measurement.

    

Knowledge of ATEX and instrumentation in hazardous areas.

    

The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with operations and other engineering disciplines.

    

Good communication skills in English.

Experience with SIL/SIS and Functional Safety is considered an advantage. Experience with PLC/DCS systems, commissioning, FAT/SAT, troubleshooting or control systems such as ABB 800xA/AC800M, Emerson DeltaV or Siemens PCS7/TIA Portal is also beneficial.

About us

We are an engineering consultancy with an office in central Gothenburg and a growing presence in Stockholm. As industries transition towards a more sustainable future, we provide specialist engineering expertise to global and well-established clients within the gas, oil, chemical and energy sectors. Our projects often focus on the green transition, circular economy, CCS, hydrogen (H₂), HVO and LNG.

At Nevita, you will have the opportunity to work on large and exciting industrial projects, either on-site with our clients or in projects managed by Nevita. You will become part of a skilled and collaborative team where knowledge sharing and professional development are key values.

What we offer

    

Competitive employment terms and a flexible benefits package

    

Occupational pension, wellness allowance and dedicated time for wellness activities

    

Opportunities to work on large and technically challenging industrial projects

    

Continuous professional development and knowledge sharing

    

A social and inclusive culture where we care about each other and enjoy working together

📧 oscar.sahlin@nevita.se

title: Customs Operations Specialist
description:

Be yourself, a Customs Operations Specialist, and more!

Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Your health, wellbeing, and development matter most to us, and our benefits are designed with you in mind. I rollen ansvarar du för att leda och fördela arbetet för gruppen samt för att kontinuerligt utveckla personal, arbetssätt och metoder för att nå avdelningens uppsatta mål – med kunden i fokus.











Dina arbetsuppgifter








    Leda, fördela och följa upp det dagliga arbetet inom funktionsprovning och orbitalsvets, samt utveckla personal och arbetssätt
    Säkerställa att kontroll av färdig produktenhet och orbitalsvetsning utförs enligt fastställda rutiner, med fokus på säkerhet, kvalitet och kostnadseffektivitet
    Driva ett förebyggande arbetsmiljöarbete och bidra till att avdelningens kvalitets- och miljömål uppnås
    Driva och följa upp avdelningens nyckeltal inom säkerhet, kvalitet, leverans och produktivitet.
    Initiera och leda förbättringsarbete enligt Lean-principer och Getinges arbetssätt.







Rollen är placerad på plats i våra lokaler i Getinge, där ditt ledarskap och din närvaro i produktionen är centrala för uppdraget. Du rapporterar till Produktionschefen för siten.















Vad du har med dig



I den här rollen ser vi att du har följande med dig:








    Teknisk utbildning på lägst gymnasienivå, alternativt lång erfarenhet inom tillverkande industri
    Minst 5 års erfarenhet av tillverkningsindustri samt erfarnhet av personalledning inom produktionsmiljö
    Allmän kunskap inom arbetsmiljö och arbetsrätt
    Erfarenhet av arbete i kvalitetsstyrd industri, exempelvis medicinteknik, läkemedel, processindustri eller liknande, är meriterande
    Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift







Förutom dina erfarenheter värderar vi din personlighet högt. Som person är du proaktiv, drivande och tydlig i din kommunikation. Du är strukturerad, tar ansvar för en säker arbetsplats och agerar när kvalitets- eller miljöbrister upptäcks. Du trivs med att leda och utveckla medarbetare och är van att samarbeta med olika intressenter, både internt och externt.



På Getinge omfamnar vi en lärandekultur där vi tar ansvar för vår utveckling och sätter stort värde på kvalitet och samarbete. Framför allt bryr vi oss om varandra för att vi som team och bolag ska kunna fortsatta utveckla världsledande produkter. Vi är Team Players, Forward Thinkers och Game Changers!







Vi erbjuder



Vi erbjuder ett konkurrenskraftigt kompensations- och förmånspaket, inklusive friskvårdsbidrag, familjeförmåner och gemensamma aktiviteter och föreningsliv. Allt detta för att säkerställa att vi stöder ditt välbefinnande och dina mål.



Vi har en öppen dialog mellan ledare och medarbetare, samt mellan teamen. Vi fokuserar på att utveckla människor och tillsammans skapar vi en plan för lärande och kompetensutveckling när du börjar din karriär hos oss.







Ansökan



Ansökningar kommer att granskas löpande och vi rekommenderar därför att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, dock senast 2026-10-10. Vi ber dig att skicka in din ansökan i vårt rekryteringssystem genom att klicka på knappen "ansök nu". På grund av GDPR tar vi inte emot ansökningar via e-post.



Om du har några frågor angående processen vänligen kontakta ansvarig rekryterare på   Emma.paulsson@getinge.com.







Vi ser fram emot din ansökan. Vi hoppas att du vill följa med oss på vår resa mot att bli världens mest eftertraktade medicintekniska företag.

title: Switchboard/Workplace support Coordinator ( Vikariat )

Stockholm, Sweden

title: Backend developer
description:
About Froda

Froda was founded in 2015 with a clear vision – to revolutionize the banking experience for entrepreneurs by making it easy and affordable to invest in their ideas. Today, we are one of Sweden's fastest-growing fintech companies with large international growth plans. We are a creative tech company with the ambition to turn a historically expensive and unfair industry into something ethical and sustainable by promoting entrepreneurship.

Our mission to revolutionize the banking experience for entrepreneurs is not only reflected in our products but also in our workplace. By fostering a culture of respect, collaboration, and continuous learning, we provide opportunities for personal growth and professional development. Join us in transforming the banking industry and be a part of our journey to empower entrepreneurs.

About the Role

To further develop and scale our tech platform, enabling us to continue improving the banking experience for entrepreneurs, we are expanding our tech department. As a Backend Developer at Froda, you will be part of a cross-functional team working in one of our product areas — either developing features for our partners, improving our credit systems or maintaining our loan and payments core. For each team, the idea is to continuously deliver customer value as well as to improve the technical structure to make sure our systems are stable and healthy. Together with your team, you will design, build, and deliver scalable and maintainable solutions that directly impact our customers.

You will get a unique chance to be a part of a scaling fintech company with strong momentum and a stable foundation, backed by a banking license as a quality stamp.

Who are you?

We believe that you are an experienced and curious developer who thrives in collaborative environments and is passionate about building scalable solutions with real impact. You enjoy working closely with other skilled and open-minded professionals and actively contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. You are a pragmatic problem solver who communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are fluent in English, Swedish is a plus.

We believe that you have experience of:

    

At least 4 years in a similar role, ideally within product-focused teams

    

Programming in C#/.NET with a solid understanding of modern software design principles

    

Working with SQL and NoSQL databases in production environments

    

Cloud platforms such as Azure (or other major providers)

    

Agile methodologies and best practices in software engineering, including testing, CI/CD, and DevOps mindset

    

Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, RabbitMQ, and microservices architecture is a strong plus

What’s in it for you?

At Froda, you’ll be part of a company that combines the best of both worlds – a fast-moving, high-energy culture with the stability and structure to support long-term success. We’re 100+ ambitious self-starters who genuinely care for each other and the work we do, all while having fun together.

Here, you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership of your work, develop your skills, and shape your own growth journey. With big ambitions and a rapidly evolving business, there’s plenty of room to grow, lead initiatives, and make a real impact on both our company and the industry. If you're looking to be part of a success story and contribute to something bigger, this is the place for you.

Furthermore, you’ll get:

    

An opportunity to be part of an exciting journey, shaping the future of our company and transforming the SME financing landscape

    

Fabulous office overlooking Stockholm and a friendly culture that values work/life balance

    

We prioritize working in the office to maximize the positive impact of in-person collaboration, but we offer flexibility with work hours and remote work

    

Competitive compensation package

    

Insurance and pension plan

This role is all about building the tech that powers funding for thousands of entrepreneurs —if you're excited by our mission, apply or tell a friend!

title: Project Planner - HVDC Service
description:
The Opportunity

Join HVDC Service at Hitachi Energy

HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) is a product group in Hitachi Energy, which develops, manufactures and sells DC transmission systems on a global market. HVDC technology is used to transmit electricity over long distances and for power transmission via submarine cables. It is also used to connect power systems. The HVDC market for large scale transmission and offshore wind is booming as an enabler for the global energy transitions. All these projects are classified as very critical infrastructures and hence cyber security requirements and standard compliance is very high.

We are interested to learn more about you and what you can contribute with so don’t hesitate to apply even though you don´t meet all requirements.

A team with great cooperation and with diverse background is waiting for you to join!

    You will lead planning, scheduling and efforts for all project and tender phases.
    To timely provide the Project Manager, and the Line Managers, with Earned Value Management Analysis, with look ahead, reliable and comprehensive information about the project status: schedule, progress, planned, actual, forecast, resources and productivity, trends, and risks.
    Should have strong scope management skills to drive projects and tenders within HVDC service.
    Analyzes project requirements with project/tender team, checks that all essential work activities have been identified in sufficient detail to serve as a basis for developing realistic project schedules.
    Defines, jointly with the project team, project work and cost breakdown structure, develops and maintains properly linked, required resource-loaded/integrated, baseline and current schedules that provide time-phased baseline, actual and forecast data for the project.
    Monitors project progress and regularly analyzes project critical paths to ensure all critical path activities and project milestones are progressed to the plan, notifies the project team of any deviations or scheduling issues, and provides input for optimizing resources.
    Issues progress reports, program updates and productivity data on a regular basis and as requested by customers and stakeholders.
    Contributes to Sales and Operation planning (SOP) at HVDC Service

Your background

    Experience in planning and/or cost control on lump sum projects or equivalent.
    Thorough understanding of logical sequencing and interfacing of project execution activities in EPC projects
    Ability to lead planning and project controls activities in multi-location EPC projects.
    Experience to plan activities and monitoring execution schedules and physical progress in all project phases.
    Experience in cost management, including cost estimate input from departments, comparing estimate input to experience data, ensuring compliance with time schedule.
    Strong communication skills, ability to highlight key issues and communicate them to management and other stakeholders.
    Team player, with team management and leadership skills.
    Engineering degree and proficiency in English are required, additional language skills incl Swedish is an advantage.

LeoVegas Group is building something special – a world-class team dedicated to creating the best Sportsbook platform in the market through cutting-edge technology and innovative gaming experiences.

We are recruiting for our Tiger Sportsbook Team!

● 6+ Years of software development experience with Java, Spring Boot and Event-Driven Architectures.

● Knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases and caching.

● Implementing resilience patterns (e.g., retries, circuit breakers, graceful degradation).

● Designing and maintaining monitoring dashboards (e.g., metrics, logs, traces) and alerts to proactively detect issues.

● Hands-on experience developing highly scalable RESTful end-to-end microservices.

NICE TO HAVES:

● Familiarity with Reactive Programming (e.g. RxJava) and Vert.x would be a big plus.

● Experience in platforms like AWS and Google Cloud Platform.

● Online gaming and gambling experience

    

WHO WE ARE

At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide.

JOIN US!

In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen!

title: System Support Technician, Lund or Stockholm or Linköping
description:
Are you the person colleagues are glad to reach when a system stops cooperating? We're looking for a System Support Technician with Salesforce experience to join our System Support team at our HQ in Lund, or our offices in Linköping or Stockholm - a role where technical problem-solving and genuine service go hand in hand.

Who is your future team?

You'll join our System Support team, ten technicians who maintain and provide first line support for a range of Axis systems, including Salesforce, our own in-house CRM, our intranet, Microsoft 365 and access management. We're part of the internal IT Helpdesk, which supports Axis employees globally.

We're a down-to-earth team where no one is too senior to pick up a ticket. We help each other out without worrying too much about who does what, and we'd rather solve the problem together than protect our own patch.

What you'll do here as System Support Technician

Your day is built around helping colleagues around the world get past whatever is standing in their way. You'll be the first line of support for our own CRM and for Salesforce, and you'll keep access management running smoothly across a range of our systems. Beyond solving what lands in your queue, you'll help make sure fewer problems land there in the first place.

    

Support colleagues globally through our case management system, ServiceNow

    

Handle access management across a range of Axis systems

    

Troubleshoot and resolve issues in the systems we support

    

Create and maintain knowledge articles and workflows

    

Collaboration with other teams on systems that connect to ours



Who are we looking for?

You're service-minded, and you enjoy the moment when a technical problem finally gives way. You're curious about how different systems work and how they connect, and you take a user-centric approach to your work. Sharing what you know comes naturally to you, and you're easy to work with day to day. You know how to prioritize, and you keep your work structured even when several things need attention at once.

You're also an early adopter who is curious about new technical solutions, combined with a pragmatic understanding that not all of them are applicable to our use cases or feasible to implement.

We'd love to hear that you have:

    

Several years of experience providing system support to users

    

Hands-on experience supporting users in Salesforce

    

An IT education, or equivalent experience

    

Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken, since we also provide global support

Bonus points for:

    

Experience working with ServiceNow as a case management system

What Axis has to offer

We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance - developing solutions used worldwide.

Curious to discover more?

We have a host of places where you can learn more about Axis, our products, solutions, company culture, and what working at Axis is really like.

Check out:

Life at Axis blog

Engineering at Axis blog

Innovation at Axis



Ready to Act?

Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications.

We go through applications continuously so don't wait - send in your application today!

title: Customs Compliance Specialist
description:
Company Description

Customs Operations Europe and Africa region in Älmhult, Sweden consists of approximately 47 co-workers. The department includes a dedicated team of Customs Compliance Specialists, alongside operational customs teams, working together to secure well-functioning import and export processes for more than 30 countries in the region. We provide daily support and coordination on customs-related topics, including legal requirements, goods flow, and IT solutions, to secure availability, affordability, and compliance.

Job Description

The Customs Compliance Specialist ensures the efficiency and compliance of the import and export activities in their region and for the countries assigned to their region.

    In conjunction with the Customs Compliance Manager, establish and maintain Compliance procedures and working methods associated with areas of responsibility
    Lead and coordinate customs classification activities within the assigned area of responsibility, ensuring accurate tariff classification, compliance, and alignment with business needs.

    Build strategic relationships with internal and external business partners, including Customs or other Government agencies
    Work with Finance, Accounting, Transport and Purchasing partners on compliance issues
    Maintain regulatory knowledge and analysis skills as business, regulations or systems change to meet the business needs
    Assume responsibility for other tasks and projects as assigned

Qualifications

We are now looking for a new colleague who wants to be a part of our amazing team. We believe you are motivated and inspired by the above assignments. You have plenty of energy and curiosity to learn, and we see that you are a person that is driven and dares to challenge people around you. You are service-minded, with a clear and respectful way of communicating. You enjoy working in a structured way both on your own, within the team and with relevant stakeholders. You have high integrity and the ability to establish relationships at all levels of the organization, based on trust. You can work with both operational and tactical issues, and you possess facilitation and trainer skills. You can prioritize your work to deliver assignments with high quality. You also can analyze the details while keeping focus on the big picture and follow up on relevant goals and deviations.

You should be:

    Comfortable with working and navigating in digital IT solutions
    Fluent in English, both written and verbal

We believe that you have:

    Demonstrated knowledge of Customs Import/Export regulations and compliance management
    Solid knowledge and practical experience in customs classification (tariff classification) and related processes, including the application of customs regulations and maintenance of classification data.  

    Experience and knowledge of Change Management
    Good listening skills and strong ability to document and communicate in a clear way
    Ability to build efficiencies and compliance into operations while meeting the business needs
    Previous experience in working with external authorities

Additional information

Please note this position is based in Älmhult, Sweden.

Please apply in English before the 28th of September 2026.

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. Once competence requirements are met, we will first consider impacted co-workers employed in IKEA Supply Services (Sweden) AB and secondly impacted co-workers at Inter IKEA Group

title: Logistics Operations Developer
description:
In Purchasing Development, we enable purchasing of sustainable and affordable IKEA products by developing a strong global supplier network. We work close to suppliers, partners, Range and Supply Chain Operations to secure quality, availability, sustainability and the lowest possible cost for the many people.

Within Purchasing Development, Category Area Food is part of the Food total value chain transformation. We are shaping a simpler, more connected and more industry-relevant way of working for IKEA Food, with clearer accountability, faster decisions and stronger supplier performance. Food has its own conditions, with limited shelf life, food safety requirements, freshness needs and changing market expectations. This calls for practical, fact-based and close supplier collaboration.

We are now looking for a Logistics Operations Developer who wants to help strengthen supplier logistics performance and capability across an assigned geography. In this role, you will work close to suppliers and business teams to make sure supplier routines, data quality, logistics compliance and execution readiness support reliable, compliant and cost-conscious supply.

This is a role for someone who enjoys turning operational signals into clear improvement actions. You will help suppliers and office teams understand what needs to be improved, follow up progress and make sure repeated issues are solved in a structured way within agreed ways of working.

About the role

As Logistics Operations Developer, you will own and develop supplier logistics performance for assigned suppliers and geographies. You will follow up delivery performance, data quality, logistics compliance and launch or change readiness. You will also support supplier capability development through analysis, training, implementation follow-up and corrective actions.

You will work closely with Business Developers, Business Development Managers, Product Sourcing Leaders, Inventory Planners, suppliers and other internal stakeholders. Your input will help bring supplier-side logistics reality into business decisions, so we can improve availability, reduce recurring issues and support growth at lower cost.

In this role, you will:

    Own supplier logistics performance follow-up for assigned suppliers and geographies.
    Follow up delivery performance, data quality, logistics compliance and execution readiness.
    Translate Category Business Plan, supplier priorities and improvement needs into practical logistics actions.
    Drive supplier improvement plans and corrective actions that strengthen delivery performance, supplier routines and logistics set-ups.
    Provide supplier-side logistics feasibility, risk and readiness input for sourcing, launch, range change and deviation decisions.
    Train and support suppliers and office teams in agreed logistics requirements and routines.
    Identify process, data or digital improvement needs from supplier operations and secure the right escalation.

We are looking for someone who:

    Has experience from supplier operations, logistics, supply planning, supplier development or operational performance improvement.
    Understands supplier delivery performance, data quality, capacity and readiness, logistics set-up and compliance drivers.
    Can analyse performance data, spot recurring deviations and recommend clear corrective actions.
    Is comfortable guiding suppliers and office teams through requirements, routines and practical improvement work.
    Communicates clearly across cultures, roles and locations, with a simple and fact-based way of working.
    Enjoys solving problems structurally and helping others build capability for long-term performance.

At IKEA, low cost has a meaning. It helps us create better products at lower prices and make them available to more people. In this role, your everyday work with supplier logistics helps turn that idea into action.

You will be part of strengthening the Food value chain by making supplier operations more reliable, more compliant and easier to work with. Together, we keep the customer in the centre, act with business acumen and build a Food setup that can grow with speed, care and cost-consciousness.

We look forward to receiving your application by the 28th of September, 2026.

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. Once competence

requirements are met, we will first consider impacted co-workers at Inter IKEA Group.

title: Inventory Planner
description:
In Supply Chain Operations, we lead, plan and execute the supply of IKEA products between suppliers and retailers.

We work across the IKEA value chain to make sure products reach stores and retail partners in a simple, efficient and responsible way. Our shared goals are clear: availability, affordability and sustainability. Together, we help make IKEA products available for the many people.

Within SCO, Category Area Logistics Services secures and develops the logistics services that make the goods flow work in practice. We work with distribution, mid-receiver units and food logistics services. Together with our logistics service providers, we secure the right capacity, cost, service, quality, safety and sustainability.

Category Food Logistics Services is part of CALS and focuses on securing logistics solutions for IKEA Food, including warehousing, cold-chain transportation and goods flow to stores. We work with temperature-controlled flows and everyday follow-up to support availability, food safety, freshness, cost efficiency and sustainability across markets.

IKEA Food is an important part of the total IKEA experience. It helps us welcome people, bring Swedish food traditions to life, support everyday moments in our stores, and make good food available to the many people. Behind every meal, snack and food product, there is a goods flow that needs to be safe, fresh, reliable and cost-conscious. In Category Food Logistics Services, we commit to make that happen.

About the role  

We are now looking for an Inventory Planner who wants to be part of the IKEA Food goods flow, where planning accuracy supports availability, freshness, food safety and a stronger customer experience. In this role, daily planning and execution come together so food products can move safely, reliably and efficiently from supplier to distribution centre and onwards into the IKEA Food experience.

The role works closely with Category, suppliers, service providers, distribution centres and internal planning teams. You will use signals from orders, stock, forecasts, lead times and distribution to take clear inventory actions, supporting the Food transformation ambition to simplify execution, reduce handovers and focus planning where it creates business value.

In this role you will:

    Own supplier-to-DC and/or DC-DC inbound availability for assigned products, DCs and markets.
    Maintain accurate inventory and inbound flow execution, including orders, ERP corrections and physical-flow corrections.
    Act on daily inventory corrections, inbound order handling, flow bookings and deviations within agreed parameters.
    Balance availability, food safety, freshness, cost, sustainability and lead-time adherence when planning and following up the inbound flow.
    Secure supplier and logistics-service-provider execution through confirmations, holiday planning, inbound coordination and invoice follow-up.
    Manage deviations related to quality, blocked goods, shelf life, shortages and inventory accuracy with timely action and escalation.
    Improve ways of working together with suppliers, service providers, DC/LSP operations and internal stakeholders.

We are looking for someone who:

    Has experience from supply-chain operations, inventory-, supply planning, inbound logistics or DC flow.
    Works confidently in ERP e.g. Infor tools, order-management and planning systems.
    Uses operational KPIs, inventory data and deviation follow-up to make clear decisions, including using excel and Power Bi.
    Understands availability at lowest cost, freshness, quality and inventory-accuracy risks, and knows when to act or escalate.
    Communicates well across suppliers, logistics service providers and internal teams.
    Takes pride in accuracy, structure and keeping the inbound goods flow reliable every day.

Reliable availability depends on many small inventory and inbound flow decisions done right, every day.

As Inventory Planner, you help secure the right products in the right place at the right time, with good freshness, compliance, service and cost-conscious flow. You turn supplier, inventory and distribution signals into action so stores and partners can rely on stable availability, and IKEA Food can be enjoyed with trust, quality and care across markets.

For questions about the role, please contact Business Development Managers Irina Kärnsund via, irina.karnsund@inter.ikea.com or Eda Lennartsson via eda.serdar.jonsson1@inter.ikea.com or Shirley Zhang via shirley.zhang@inter.ikea.com

We look forward to receiving your application by the 28th of September, 2026.

If you have any questions regarding the recruitment process contact People & Culture Specialists Samuel Karlsson via samuel.karlsson@inter.ikea.com or Femina Ladhani Karlsson via femina.ladhani.karlsson@inter.ikea.com

requirements are met, we will first consider impacted co-workers at Inter IKEA Group.

title: Business Developer
description:
In Category Food Logistics Services, we source, procure, optimise, manage and operate cold chain transportation, warehousing and logistics services for IKEA Food. Together with our service providers, we secure the storage, handling and delivery of food products across different temperature needs. We develop solutions that support availability, affordability, quality, food safety and sustainability.

About the role

We are looking for a Business Developer who wants to develop our food logistics business together with service providers and colleagues across the IKEA value chain. You will take end-to-end ownership of sourcing and managing relationships with assigned cold chain logistics service providers. You will turn business needs into practical solutions, strengthen long-term partnerships and improve performance across transportation, warehousing and related logistics services. The role reports to the Business Development Manager.

In this role you will:

    Take overall responsibility for the business and performance of an assigned portfolio of service providers and a defined business scope.
    Turn business needs and market insights into logistics solutions and lead the procurement process from business case and tender through negotiation, agreement and development actions.
    Challenge and support service providers to improve cost, capacity, quality, operational performance, food safety, compliance and sustainability together with relevant IKEA colleagues.
    Use facts, market knowledge and cost understanding to find opportunities, manage risks and recommend solutions that create the best total value for IKEA.
    Secure agreements and follow up that service providers meet relevant requirements for IWAY, supply chain security, financial screening, food safety and operational compliance.

We are looking for someone who:

    Has a university degree in logistics, economics or business administration, or a strong track record from a similar role.
    Understands the food logistics value chain end to end and has experience working with the complexity of global sourcing and logistics. Can balance cost, capacity, performance and sustainability when making business decisions.
    Brings strong negotiation, project management, analytical and financial skills. Can work with cash flow, profit and loss, cost breakdowns and fact-based business cases.
    Has a proven entrepreneurial approach in materializing ideas to solutions together with Service Providers.  
    Communicates clearly in written and spoken English and can present complex business topics in a simple, engaging way.
    Shares our IKEA values, enjoys finding new business opportunities and has the curiosity and drive to turn ideas into practical improvements.

Together, we can build food logistics services that keep IKEA Food available, safe and affordable while preparing our network for tomorrow.

The role works across cultures and time zones and includes regular travels.

With us, you will have room to lead your assignment, learn with colleagues and develop business together with experienced service providers. We trust people to take responsibility, test ideas and learn along the way.

We are currently looking for one Business Developer to join our team and welcome your application. We look forward to receiving your application by the 28th of September, 2026.

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. Once competence

requirements are met, we will first consider impacted co-workers employed in IKEA Supply Services (Sweden) AB and secondly impacted co-workers at Inter IKEA Group.

title: Service Provider Operations Developer
description:
Hej Service Provider Operations Developer,

Do you want to go to work and help create a better life at home?

With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our Service Provider Operations Developer, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.

Your new job

As a Service Provider Operations Developer, you’ll play an important part in the team and contribute to a better everyday life for the many by maximizing the optimization potential related to its operational costs. Your primary focus will be securing and continuously improving our service providers' operations performance. The impact of our work will resonate in homes and hearts across the world. On a typical working day, you will:

    Secure operational performance of the service provider as well as securing optimal usage of agreed capacity versus planned/needed capacity
    Work actively with capacity forecasting, identify constraints and find optimal solutions which lead to securing needed capacity at lowest total cost
    Contribute to the development of working methods and other steering documents  
    Ensure execution of signed contracts as well as perform compliance checks at service providers to verify quality of equipment, safety & security etc.  

What we’d like you to bring to the table

The role as a Service Provider Operations Developer requires you to have:

    Worked within logistics or supply chain in an international organisation for at least 2 years
    Knowledge in specific transportation and warehousing aspects as well as know the ins and outs of impacting operational performance
    Experience in working with Excel including performing analysis and putting together reports
    Fluent in English, both in writing and speaking

It’s a plus if you also:

    Analytical and knows how to follow up while managing yourself while driving he operational agenda with stakeholders
    Have strong stakeholder management skills
    Flexible and adaptable in daily work, fast learner and fast adapter
    Ready to act with a spead on every opportunity

Be yourself, a Service Provider Operations Developer, and more!

Your health, wellbeing, and development matter most to us, and our benefits are designed with you in mind. title: Key Account Manager
description:
Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.

As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.



About the job
Ready to make a positive impact? We are glad to present this opportunity to join a great team at a highly innovative company as we are looking for a Key Account Manager. This is a role where you will be responsible for driving profitable growth and strengthening long-term partnerships with some of Alfa Laval's most important customers across Denmark and Sweden within the food and pharmaceutical industries.

You will serve as the customer's trusted advisor and main point of contact, coordinating closely with technical specialists, service teams, inside sales, and other stakeholders across the organization, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction. The customers that you will serve are mainly pharma customers.


Your primary focus will be:

    Proactive sales - developing existing strategic accounts by understanding customer needs.
    Identifying new business opportunities and following up leads.
    Coordination/meeting optimization with internal and external stakeholders.


Success in this role requires a strong commercial mindset, excellent relationship-building skills, and the ability to navigate complex customer organizations and decision-making processes.

You will be part of a team of ten and have a key role in further contributing to our customers' and Alfa Lavals growth. You report to Tina Masini Tarp, a manager who aims to create a collaborative environment where people feel trusted, take ownership, and contribute to shared success.



Who are you

You are a commercially driven and customer-focused professional who enjoys building long-term relationships and creating value for customers. You actively engage and network with stakeholders, understand business challenges, and translate customer needs into opportunities. You are proactive, structured, and comfortable taking ownership while collaborating across functions and cultures. Most importantly, you are motivated by developing strategic partnerships and delivering sustainable business growth.



What you know

We are looking for you with experience within Key Account Management, Technical Sales, Business Development and/or Strategic Sales. You need the ability to understand technical solutions and connect them to customer value as well as being able to work independently while collaborating effectively across functions and countries.



Requirement:

    Experience working with larger industrial customers, preferably within pharma, food, beverage, dairy, or related industries.
    Strong commercial understanding and negotiation skills.
    Experience with CRM systems and sales planning tools.
    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Engineering, Food Technology, Process Engineering, or a related field.
    Excellent communication and presentation skills in English in addition to either Swedish or Danish (depending on your location)
    Driving licence

or Charlotta Lundblad, Talent Acquisition Partner

title: Switchboard/Workplace support Coordinator Fixed position
description:
Stockholm, Sweden


Switchboard/Workplace Support Coordinator

Role summary

As a Switchboard/Workplace Support Coordinator, you will play a key role in delivering workplace services and support to employees, visitors, and stakeholders. Acting as a primary point of contact, you will manage a wide range of workplace-related services including customer service, switchboard operations, issue management, administrative support, and workplace systems.

The role requires a proactive and service-oriented mindset, ensuring that inquiries, requests, and incidents are handled efficiently and professionally. You will collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to enhance the workplace experience and support continuous service improvement.

As the workplace organization evolves, the role may also include responsibilities related to access management and identification services.


Responsibilities

Customer Service & Workplace Support


    Respond to requests and inquiries via phone, email, and other communication channels.

    Deliver outstanding customer service to employees, visitors, and stakeholders.

    Investigate, coordinate, and resolve workplace-related issues, incidents, and service requests.

    Collaborate with internal teams, service partners, and vendors to ensure timely resolution of inquiries and incidents.

    Support workplace services including goods handling, mail-related inquiries, remote reception services, workplace projects, and operational initiatives.

    Maintain accurate records and documentation related to workplace services.

    Perform other duties as assigned.


Switchboard Operations


    Answer incoming calls and direct callers to the appropriate departments or personnel.

    Manage multiple communication channels professionally and efficiently.

    Provide information to callers and take messages when required.

    Support emergency communication procedures when required.



Systems & Administration


    Act as a superuser for workplace systems and support users when required.

    Coordinate and dispatch incoming fault reports to the appropriate teams.

    Perform administrative duties including data entry, filing, correspondence, invoice scanning, and archiving.

    Prepare reports, statistics, and documentation to support operational performance.



Future Scope


    Support access management and identification services, including administration of employee and visitor access solutions.

    Coordinate processes related to workplace access and security requirement




Qualifications, Education and Experience

    Passion for delivering outstanding customer experience with a high level of professionalism and integrity.

    Very good knowledge of Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

    High school diploma or equivalent.

    Experience from customer service, reception, switchboard, administration, or workplace support is an advantage.

    Good digital skills and ability to work effectively across multiple systems and tools.


Communication Skills

    Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

    Ability to communicate professionally with stakeholders at all levels.

    Strong listening, interpersonal, and customer service skills.

    Positive, professional, and solution-oriented approach.


Reasoning Ability

    Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

    Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

    High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and organization.

    Ability to assess situations and take appropriate action.


Health, Safety & Environment

Responsible for personal safety and the safety of others affected by your work. This includes:


    Completing all required QHSE training.

    Following company policies, procedures, and HSE requirements.

    Participating in QHSE activities as required.

    Reporting hazards, unsafe conditions, incidents, and near misses.

    Following safe work practices relevant to the work environment.




Working hours and location

This position is based at the client's premises in Kista. This role requires onsite presence Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 17:00, or 7.30-16.30 depending on business needs. Occasional travel to other locations may be required.

title: Electrical Construction Manager
employer: Global Taxation Services Nordic Sweden AB
description:
Role Purpose

To represent the Project Manager on major construction sites and to take responsibility for all site related activities associated with the construction of a varied range of projects. The Electrical Construction Manager will be expected to take the lead on all on-site activities from pre-mobilisation through to commissioning and eventual demobilisation.

Electrical Construction Manager Responsibilities

In conjunction with your project team, you will be responsible for the execution of various stages of a project as follows:

Project Start-Up:

• Assist PM in development of construction programme, short term look ahead planning

reports, equipment and materials schedules.

• Visit site and develop a site establishment schedule.

• Familiarisation with change management with PM.

• Assist in project validation.

• Put site safety starter pack in place and participate in HSEQ plan.

• Set up site establishment.

• Method statement and Risk Assessment preparation and review with sub-contractor.

• Review construction drawings and sign off

• Assist in benchmarking installation practices and Quality procedures

Project Running Phase:

• Productivity

• Develop a daily key action plan that includes HSEQ, productivity and people management.

• Assist Project team in expediting of major equipment deliveries.

• Maintain a site diary

• Attend/Chair internal meetings with sub-contractors.

• Ensure that all variations are picked up in conjunction with PM and QS.

• Ensure labour allocation sheets are being completed by sub-contractors.

• Produce short term programmes in line with master programme.

• Mark up master programme each week and issues to PM.

• Effectively manage sub-contractor supervision to enable efficient productivity

• Ensure sub-contractor workforce is on site at workface on time.

People

• Liaise with sub-contractors to address available work faces.

• Liaise with our client in co-ordination between building and services.

• Work closely with other supervisors to ensure effective co-ordination between M&E services.

• Integrate with other internal and external supervisors to ensure cross co-ordination of trades and installation processes.

• Take ownership and responsibility of issues to drive out solutions in conjunction with Project Manager.

Safety

• Ensure tool box talks, inductions and safety briefings are being carried out.

• Maintain plant logs and ensure weekly safety checks are carried out.

• Ensure operatives are working safely, wearing appropriate PPE and working to agreed method statements.

• Ensure compliance with Health and Safety Policy in particular to the operation of work

permits, site safety audits and weekly walk arounds.

• Carry out daily walk around adopting a “don’t walk by” approach to safety.

• Implement H&S behaviour/culture and Golden Rules.

Quality

• Plan and co-ordinate delivery of materials and plant.

• Mark up drawings in conjunction with inspection testing.

• Ensure inspection test plan is enforced by snagging works, then offering to client for

inspection at various stages of the installation working to ZERO snags.

• Ensure that free issue equipment is checked, cared for and once accepted confirm to engineer to sign off for payment.

Close Out Activities:

• Liaise with commissioning engineer in ensuring all systems are tested, demonstrated and handover.

• Ensure all site safety devices are proved.

• Ensure all life systems are complete and certified.

• Issue final marked up drawings are correct.

• Liaise with PM on site demobilisation, including plant, labour, materials and site establishment.

• Ensure all statutory notices, schematics, wall charts are in place on site in accordance with project completion checklist.

Other Duties:

• Maintain a site diary.

• Assist QS in his / her duties

• Ensure company’s good image is maintained at all times.

• Integrate with site team.

• Ensure your agreed training plan is enforced

title: CNC-operatör till avancerad bearbetning
description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. With cutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and construction equipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm, Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries. Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:

Vill du arbeta med avancerad bearbetning, moderna maskiner och produkter som används över hela världen?

Hos Epiroc i Kalmar får du mer än bara ett jobb vid maskinen. Du får arbeta i en högteknologisk produktionsmiljö där din yrkesskicklighet värdesätts, där kvalitet och säkerhet alltid går först – och där du som erfaren CNC‑operatör verkligen kan göra skillnad.

Allt börjar med människor. Människor som du.

Bli en del av vårt teamVi befinner oss i en tillväxtfas och söker nu skickliga CNC‑operatörer som vill vara med och bygga framtidens produktion tillsammans med oss. Här finns långsiktighet, stabilitet och utvecklingsmöjligheter för dig som vill ta nästa steg – hos ett företag som satsar på framtiden.

Epiroc i Kalmar tillverkar världsledande hydrauliska produkter till gruv‑ och anläggningsindustrin – och nu breddar och vidareutvecklar vi vårt produktutbud. Det innebär investeringar i ny teknik, automation, och nya metoder för bearbetning och värmebehandling. Nyfiken på att bli med på resan? Läs mer om Epiroc i Kalmar här.

Ditt uppdrag Som CNC‑operatör hos oss får du arbeta med komponenter och produkter där kraven på precision, kvalitet och spårbarhet är höga. Det du tillverkar används i krävande miljöer världen över – vilket ställer höga krav, men också ger en tydlig stolthet i arbetet.

Maskinbearbetningen bedrivs i moderna fleroperationsmaskiner och svarvar, och kommer inom kort även att omfatta slipning. I rollen ingår ett helhetsansvar för dina maskiner och arbeten, vilket bland annat innebär:


    Självständig körning och övervakning av CNC‑maskiner
    Planering av det dagliga arbetet och hantering av tillverkningsorder
    Verktygshantering och processnära kvalitetsarbete
    Daglig tillsyn av maskiner, utrustning och arbetsmiljö

Din profilVi söker dig som är noggrann, ansvarstagande och trivs i en miljö där teknik, problemlösning och ständig utveckling är en naturlig del av vardagen. Ditt intresse och engagemang för bearbetning gör att du gärna delar med dig av din erfarenhet, testar nya arbetssätt och bidrar till ett stabilt och effektivt produktionsflöde, alltid med stort fokus på säkerhet och kvalitet.

Vi ser gärna att du har:


    Erfarenhet av arbete som CNC‑operatör, alternativt relevant CNC‑utbildning kombinerad med praktisk erfarenhet
    God datorvana för dokumentation, rapportering och produktionsuppföljning
    Goda kunskaper i svenska, i både tal och skrift

Vill du utvecklas vidare inom skärande bearbetning och samtidigt vara med och forma framtidens produktion med oss? Då ser vi fram emot din ansökan.

Placering och arbetstiderDenna tjänst är placerad i Kalmar, Sverige. Arbetet är förlagt till kontinuerligt skiftarbete, vilket innebär att du behöver vara flexibel och trivas med ett rullande schema.

Livet på Epiroc När du blir en del av Epiroc kan du förvänta dig en atmosfär av kreativitet, innovation och mångfald. Du kommer att vara en del av en grupp skickliga och hjälpsamma kollegor som alla lever efter våra kärnvärden: samarbete, engagemang och innovation. Vi arbetar i en global miljö med över 113 nationaliteter.

Förutom att vi har en kultur som kännetecknas av utveckling i kombination med en bra balans mellan arbete och fritid, finns det några saker som gör oss lite extra stolta över att arbeta på Epiroc:


    Globala karriärmöjligheter.
    Epiroc University, för din egen kompetensutveckling.
    Samhällsengagemang.
    Förmånspaket, som bland annat inkluderar flexibel arbetstid och bonus.

Ansökan och kontaktinformationDu ansöker på vår karriärsida, genom att ladda upp ditt CV (personligt brev behövs ej) och svara på några korta frågor. Ansökningar granskas löpande och vi uppmuntrar att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, men senast den 30 september 2026.

Har du frågor om tjänsten, välkommen att kontakta oss:

Tekla Brunetto, Rekryteringsspecialist, tekla.brunetto@external.epiroc.com.

Ibro Lindh, Produktionsledare, ibro.lindh@epiroc.com.

Vänligen observera att vi inte kan hantera ansökningar som skickas in via e-post.

Vi är engagerade i en grundlig rekryteringsprocess som inkluderar intervjuer, referenstagning och tester. För att säkerställa en trygg arbetsmiljö genomför vi identitetskontroller och drog- och alkoholtester. Vår process är utformad för att vara rättvis och inkluderande; du kan förvänta dig transparent kommunikation och en balanserad utvärdering av dina färdigheter och erfarenheter.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: IT Lead
description:
Role Summary

As TRATON Financial Services continues to expand its global footprint, the IT organization must evolve alongside the business to ensure technology remains a strategic enabler across all markets. To support this growth, six IT Lead positions will be introduced within the global IT organization, each reporting directly to the Chief Digital & Information Officer (CDIO). One of these roles will be responsible for the Southern Europe region. We are open to candidates located in Sweden, Germany, France, Netherlands, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Bulgaria and Romania. Please expect app. 20% of international travels.

Acting as IT leader, the IT Lead will provide functional leadership to local market IT teams, driving collaboration, alignment, and the adoption of best practices across the region. The role combines strategy, operations, stakeholder management, governance, cybersecurity, vendor oversight, and transformation delivery. This position will play a key part in identifying synergies, optimizing resources, and ensuring the effective delivery of IT initiatives in support of both regional and global business objectives.



Job Responsibilities

    IT Strategy - Translate global IT strategy into regional execution plans aligned with business goals.
    Business Partnership - Act as the main IT partner for regional and market business leaders, ensuring technology supports growth, efficiency, and risk management.
    Governance - Ensure compliance with global policies, cybersecurity standards, regulatory requirements, and audit expectations.
    Budget & Cost Control - Oversee market IT budgets, cost optimization, forecasting, and investment prioritization.
    Transformation - Lead digitalization, automation, cloud adoption, system modernization, and process improvement initiatives.
    People Leadership – Steer market IT teams, capability development, performance, and succession planning.
    Risk & Security - Support markets in cyber resilience, business continuity, disaster recovery, access controls, and data protection.
    Vendor Management – Steer regional technology vendors, outsourcing partners, SLAs, contracts, and escalations.
    Change Management - Drive adoption of new tools, systems, processes, and operating models across the region.

Who you are

    10-15 years of professional experience in a corporate environment, with a strong track record of delivering business and technology outcomes.
    University degree together with fluent English.
    Solid hands-on IT background, with expertise across IT operations, software solutions, and/or data processing environments.
    Recent experience supporting and executing global IT strategies and business transformations within group and/or matrix organization.
    Proven ability to drive change, solve complex challenges, and navigate dynamic business environments with a proactive mindset.
    Strong leadership and people management experience, including at least 3-5 years in a managerial role.
    Experience leading geographically dispersed and remote teams, fostering collaboration and alignment across multiple locations.
    Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across business and IT functions.
    Demonstrated capability to identify synergies, promote best practices, and drive standardization across markets and regions.

Traton Financial Services Offers

Our culture is characterised by openness, collaboration, diversity and respect for the individual. We believe that different experiences and perspectives create a stronger workplace and better results. The right mindset, curiosity and willingness to learn are as important to us as previous experience.

We believe great work starts with feeling supported, both professionally and personally. That’s why we offer a broad range of employee benefits designed to promote wellbeing, flexibility, and a healthy work-life balance. Employees can enjoy flexible working hours and a workplace that supports both collaboration and flexibility. With office Hubs in Södertälje and Stockholm, as well as coworking spaces at Sergels Torg and Kungens Kurva, you will have the best preconditions to pick the best workplace for your activities.

We provide a yearly wellness contribution and you can train at our health center Gröndal, and you will access to occupational health services with doctors, nurses, and ergonomists. Mental health is important to us, therefore we also offer confidential staff support services for guidance related to personal challenges.

In addition, employees benefit from pension plans, profit sharing programs, and extra time off or additional pension contributions. We also support family life through enhanced parental benefits and offer additional perks such as employee car leasing. Together, these benefits help create a workplace where you can thrive both at work and in everyday life.



Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your English CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-09-28. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check is required for this role.

title: Audit Data & AI Solutions Engineer
description:
Role Summary

TRATON Financial Services’ Internal Audit department is looking for an Audit Data & AI Solutions Engineer to help build the next generation of audit technology.

Internal Audit is the third line of defense. We look for things others may have missed — the proverbial needle in the haystack. Our role is to assess whether controls designed to prevent mistakes, fraud, inefficiency, and regulatory breaches are actually working in practice.

For several years, we have successfully used source-system data, analytics, and dashboards to make audits more targeted and data-driven. Building on that foundation, we are now expanding into AI-enabled audit technology: automating parts of audit sample testing by drawing evidence-based conclusions from documents in multiple languages, identifying unusual assets or transactions, and building dashboards and applications that help auditors focus on what matters most.

You will be part of a small team within Internal Audit that builds the solutions to make this happen. The work spans hands-on data mapping, source-system analysis, Power BI or HTML dashboards, anomaly detection, machine learning, and agentic AI solutions for audit sample testing and document review.

This creates both opportunities and challenges. We can move quickly, test ideas, and learn through short feedback loops with auditors. At the same time, we do not have large predefined frameworks, methods, or roadmaps. We need people who enjoy building things in complex environments, can operate between data, software, AI, and business processes, and can create solutions that are structured, documented, trustworthy, and sustainable.

Job Responsibilities

As Audit Data & AI Solutions Engineer, you will build and maintain data, analytics, automation, and AI solutions that help Internal Audit assess controls and identify anomalies. That includes:

    Retrieving, mapping, validating, and structuring data from source systems across brands and markets
    Building analytics and algorithms to identify anomalies, control weaknesses, unusual transactions, approval issues, collateral risks, or financial crime indicators
    Developing AI-enabled and agentic solutions for document analysis and audit sample testing, including prompts, skills, tools, agent workflows, evaluation logic, and evidence-based outputs
    Creating Power BI, HTML, or other dashboards that present complex findings in a clear and useful way
    Ensuring that algorithms, prompts, data flows, and assumptions are documented and built in a modular way so they can be reused.

Who you are:

We are looking for a fast learner and hands-on builder who has:

    Strong Python and SQL skills
    Comfort using AI tools and coding agents such as Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, or similar to write, test, debug, and improve code
    Curiosity to understand business processes, controls, audit logic, and what makes an analysis useful in practice
    The ability to turn unclear business problems into working, tested, and maintainable solutions
    Experience building practical technical solutions such as scripts, data tools, dashboards, applications, automations, or analytics workflows
    Strong analytical and debugging skills, including the ability to investigate data quality issues, logic errors, and unexpected results
    A structured approach to documentation, testing, version control, and reusable code
    Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

It is an advantage if you have experience with:

    Power BI, data modelling, DAX, Power Query, or code-based Power BI development
    Machine learning, anomaly detection, exception reporting, or process monitoring
    LLM applications, document analysis, agents, RAG, prompt/context engineering, tool use, skills, OCR, JSON, APIs, or workflow applications
    Additional languages, data visualization, financial services, audit, risk, compliance, or controls.

This Is Us

At TRATON Financial Services (TFS) we have started the journey to become the provider of Financial Services to all TRATON brands. Our service includes financing for customers, dealers, and distributors as well as insurance solutions. With a presence in over 65 markets, we are already one of the most global actors in the financial services industry and are rapidly growing. Do you want to be part of this journey?

That’s why we offer a broad range of employee benefits designed to promote wellbeing, flexibility, and a healthy work-life balance. Employees can enjoy flexible working hours and a workplace that supports both collaboration and flexibility. With office Hubs in Södertälje and Stockholm, as well as coworking spaces at Sergels Torg and Kungens Kurva, you will have the best preconditions to pick the best workplace for your activities.

We provide a yearly wellness contribution and you can train at our health centre Gröndal, and you will access to occupational health services with doctors, nurses, and ergonomists. Mental health is important to us, therefore we also offer confidential staff support services for guidance related to personal challenges.

In addition, employees benefit from pension plans, profit sharing programs, and extra time off or additional pension contributions. title: Konsult Strategy&
description:
By joining Strategy&, you will become part of a global team of practical strategists, committed to helping our Clients seize key opportunities by working alongside them to solve their toughest problems. We bring 100 years of strategy consulting experience combined with the unrivalled industry and functional capabilities of the PwC network.

A career at Strategy& will provide you with the opportunity to work with some of the world’s largest and most complex companies to understand their unique business issues and opportunities in an ever-changing environment. We work on strategically important and intellectually challenging projects with C-suite Clients. More specifically, we work with leading corporations and Private Equity firms on strategic topics, focused on our core platforms Capabilities-Driven Strategy, Fit for Growth and Deals Strategy. Example assignments with corporate Clients include strategic review, growth strategy, market expansion, profit/margin improvement, and operating model design. For Private Equity firms, we support with commercial due diligence, market study and PortCo value creation strategy and business plan.

What we offer

Strategy& supports your career growth by encouraging continuous learning and by providing a framework for you to acquire new skills at the right time. At Strategy&, we offer mentoring, tailored training programs, and a variety of fun and challenging learning opportunities. You will work on the most strategic topics across a wide range of different industries and have the ability to influence your staffing to align with your passion and interests. You will be surrounded with people who will not only challenge you intellectually, but also inspire and guide you, drive your ambition, and care about your personal and professional development. Our offering includes, but is not limited to the following:

    Pure play strategy consulting work within a wide range of industries
    Part of a top-tier strategy consultancy, both locally and globally
    Access to the resources and capabilities of the global PwC network
    Ability to influence Strategy&’s exciting growth journey
    Humble, friendly and open team atmosphere
    International staffing opportunities (but not a requirement)
    Steep learning curve, with a unique focus on personal and career development
    Generous employee benefits including parental leave policies
    Flexible working model to help balancing the needs of work at home

Responsibilities

We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent and are currently seeking experienced professionals of varying seniority to join our team and become part of our local growth journey.

Senior Associate – 2-5 years of relevant work experience

Senior Associates work with Clients through all stages of consulting projects by identifying major challenges, generating improvement hypotheses, structuring and performing analyses, drawing insights and identifying pragmatic solutions, and making strategic recommendations.

Senior Associates are often end-to-end responsible for a work stream within the project working as a valued and trusted contributor in both internal and Client settings. You will get the opportunity to manage Client team members and/or a team of junior consultants and you will work across a variety of industries and functional areas in a dynamic international setting.

Manager – 5 - 8 years of relevant work experience

Managers directly manage teams as engagement leaders, demonstrating strong project and people management skills. Managers are responsible for driving overall project progress, solving complex Client and business issues, and handling stakeholder communication both internally and externally. They hone their Client management skills as the day-to-day relationship owner, and have the opportunity to coach junior consultants on projects, learning to lead high performing teams

Preferred skills across Senior Associate and Manager candidates

    Strong business acumen and ability to quickly grasp complex problems in a diverse range of industries
    Advanced analytical capabilities with both quantitative and qualitative problem-solving skills
    Exceptional leadership qualities in managing teams, driving change, and collaboratively achieving ambitious goals
    High professional integrity and good relationship builder
    Highly motivated, with a strong personal drive and ambition
    Excellent communication and presentation skills
    Entrepreneurial spirit and a keen interest in contributing to a growing team
    Outstanding academic record from a top-tier academic institution

Application instructions

To apply, please submit a complete application with:

    CV
    Cover letter
    Academic grade transcripts

The interview process usually consists of multiple stages and various types of interviews, where you get to meet multiple members of the Strategy& Stockholm team.

We invite candidates to interviews continuously, and we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: Sr. Project Manager Construction Pharma Environment
description:
Sr. Project Manager Construction Pharma Environment  
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at .  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.  
Cilag AG in Schaffhausen, Switzerland is part of the Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine (J\&J IM) Supply Chain organization and is currently recruiting for a  
Senior Project Manager Construction Pharma  
The Senior Project Manager serves as a senior technical leader on capital projects, ensuring alignment to J\&J standards and regulatory requirements. This role leads large capital projects, partnering with Quality, EHS, Operations, and external A\&E/CM firms.  
Key Responsibilities  
Strategic Project Leadership \& Delivery  
Lead large capital projects across all project phases (planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning).  
Coordinate multi\-functional engineering strategies to meet schedule, budget, quality, and regulatory requirements.  
Technical Authority \& Governance  
Act as the senior technical authority, review and approve engineering design changes, and technical submittals.  
Ensure engineering solutions align with J\&J standards, industry codes, and regulatory expectations.  
Budget \& Cost Management  
Lead multi‑million‑dollar capital budgets for assigned projects, monitor costs, and support procurement and contractor selection and evaluation.  
Participate in contractor bid reviews and support value\-engineering decisions.  
Scheduling, Risk \& Performance Management  
Lead schedule development and integration with program timelines; identify critical path items and drive mitigation.  
Maintain a proactive risk register, recommend mitigations, and track performance metrics.  
Construction Management \& Field Leadership  
Provide senior owner\-side engineering oversight during construction and commissioning; ensure contractor performance aligns with design intent and J\&J EHS standards.  
Promote a strong safety culture and ensure EHS compliance on site.  
Documentation \& Reporting  
Maintain detailed engineering records, design documentation, and as\-built information.  
Prepare and present executive\-level status updates, technical summaries, and risk briefings.  
Education \& Experience  
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management required; Master’s degree preferred.  
10\+ years of experience leading capital projects, preferably in regulated industries (pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or similar).  
Demonstrated owner\-side engineering leadership and experience working with A\&E and Construction Management firms.  
Experience leading multi\-discipline teams and collaborating with quality, EHS, operations, and external consultants.  
Skills \& Competencies  
Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving skills.  
Excellent communication and leadership skills for multi\-functional and executive interactions.  
Proven track record to lead budgets, schedules, and complex contractor relationships.  
Familiarity with regulatory expectations for facilities in regulated industries.  
Proficiency with project management and engineering documentation tools.  
Additional Requirements  
Location of Role: Primary Location: Schaffhausen, Switzerland  
Language Requirements: Proficiency: English \& German  
Travel Requirements: This position will require limited travel (less than 10%) domestic and international travel jpidfb0434cjm jit0729jm jiy26jm

title: System Administrator Microsoft Workplace

per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine:n

Enge Zusammenarbeit mit System Engineers, Network und Security

Solide Praxis im Umfeld von Microsoft 365 sowie Windows Clients und Servern/li\>
